title: Trends in Hepatitis B, Hepatitis C, and HIV Seroprevalence in the Netherlands: Insights From Two Decades of Nationwide PIENTER Serosurveys.
abstract: Hepatitis B (HBV), hepatitis C (HCV), and HIV remain public health challenges despite effective treatments and preventive options. Infections are often asymptomatic, leading to undiagnosed cases, onward transmission, and preventable morbidity and mortality. In the Netherlands, disease burden is concentrated in specific populations, with many undetected infections. We estimated HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence, identified determinants, and assessed trends over 20 years using data from 14,444 participants aged 15-79 years from three nationwide cross-sectional serosurveys (PIENTER: 1995-1996, 2006-2007, and 2016-2017). Participants completed questionnaires on demographics, behaviour, and socio-economic factors, and serum samples were tested for HBV and HCV in all rounds and HIV in 2017. Seroprevalence estimates were weighted to the Dutch population, trends were analysed using weighted Poisson regression, and determinants were evaluated using multivariable Poisson regression. Weighted HBV seroprevalence remained stable across surveys (3%-5% past or present infection; < 0.4% active infection). HBV prevalence was highest among first-generation migrants, with older age, migration background, and STI history as key determinants. HCV seroprevalence remained low (< 0.4%) and was highest among non-Western migrants. HIV prevalence was 0.1% and highest among non-Western migrants and men who have sex with men. Only 9% of active HBV cases were aware of their status. Overall, HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence remain low in the Netherlands but are concentrated in specific groups with limited awareness. These findings support targeted prevention, screening, and linkage-to-care strategies to achieve the 2030 WHO elimination goals and highlight the importance of continued population-based (sero-)monitoring to guide public health policy.

abstract_zh: 尽管有有效的治疗和预防措施,乙型肝炎 (HBV)、丙型肝炎 (HCV) 和艾滋病毒仍然是公共卫生挑战。感染通常无症状,导致未确诊病例、进一步传播以及可预防的发病率和死亡率。在荷兰,疾病负担集中在特定人群,有许多感染未被发现。我们使用来自三项全国性横断面血清调查(PIENTER:1995-1996、2006-2007 和 2016-2017)的 14,444 名 15-79 岁参与者的数据估计了 HBV、HCV 和 HIV 血清流行率,确定了决定因素并评估了 20 年来的趋势。参与者完成了有关人口统计、行为和社会经济因素的调查问卷,并在 2017 年对所有轮次的血清样本进行了 HBV 和 HCV 检测以及 HIV 检测。血清阳性率估计值根据荷兰人群进行加权,使用加权泊松回归分析趋势,并使用多变量泊松回归评估决定因素。加权 HBV 血清阳性率在各项调查中保持稳定(3%-5% 过去或现在的感染;< 0.4% 活动性感染)。第一代流动人口中乙型肝炎病毒感染率最高,年龄、流动背景和性传播感染史是关键决定因素。HCV 血清流行率仍然较低(< 0.4%),并且在非西方移民中最高。艾滋病毒感染率为 0.1%,在非西方移民和男男性行为者中感染率最高。只有 9% 的活动性 HBV 病例知道自己的状况。总体而言,荷兰的 HBV、HCV 和 HIV 血清流行率仍然较低,但集中在认识有限的特定群体。这些发现支持有针对性的预防、筛查和与护理挂钩的战略,以实现世卫组织 2030 年消除目标,并强调持续进行基于人群的(血清)监测以指导公共卫生政策的重要性。

title: Reviewing hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related mortality in Birmingham (2018-2023): The impact of late diagnosis.
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Review hepatitis B (HBV)-related deaths in Birmingham to interrogate higher HBV-related mortality rates, understand causes of death and identify areas for improvement in diagnostic and care pathways to reduce preventable deaths. STUDY DESIGN: Enhanced surveillance - retrospective review of deaths, with linkage to Office for National Statistics (ONS) mortality database for validation. METHODS: Clinicians submitted data on HBV-related deaths occurring in Birmingham (2018-2023) among adults attending for specialist care in the city. Cause of death was obtained from hospital records linked to ONS data. RESULTS: Data were submitted on 44 people who died of HBV-related causes; 86% were male. Eighty percent were non-UK-born; 70% were born in countries with intermediate-high HBV prevalence. The majority likely acquired HBV in early life (83%). Median age at HBV diagnosis in the UK was 52 years (interquartile range (IQR): 39-62 years); 72% had cirrhosis at diagnosis. The most common diagnosis setting was secondary care (70%). Median age at death was 59 years (IQR: 46-72 years); the most common causes were liver cancer (50%; n = 22) and end-stage liver disease (23%; n = 10). CONCLUSIONS: Among those dying of HBV-related causes in Birmingham, there were missed opportunities for earlier diagnosis, particularly in primary care. The majority of people who died were migrants and probably acquired HBV in early life, yet most were diagnosed in secondary care, middle-aged and with advanced disease. To achieve public health targets around HBV mortality, testing offer/uptake and linkage to care must be improved, addressing barriers and awareness among at-risk groups and healthcare professionals.

title_zh: 回顾伯明翰乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 相关死亡率(2018-2023 年):晚期诊断的影响。

abstract_zh: 目标:回顾伯明翰与乙型肝炎 (HBV) 相关的死亡情况,了解较高的 HBV 相关死亡率,了解死亡原因,并确定诊断和护理途径中需要改进的领域,以减少可预防的死亡。研究设计:加强监测——对死亡情况进行回顾性审查,并与国家统计局 (ONS) 死亡率数据库联系起来进行验证。方法:临床医生提交了伯明翰(2018-2023 年)在该市接受专科护理的成年人中发生的 HBV 相关死亡数据。死亡原因是从与国家统计局数据相关的医院记录中获得的。结果:提交了 44 名死于 HBV 相关原因的患者的数据;86%为男性。百分之八十不是英国出生的;70% 出生在乙型肝炎病毒中高流行率的国家。大多数人可能在早年感染乙肝病毒(83%)。英国诊断 HBV 的中位年龄为 52 岁(四分位距 (IQR):39-62 岁);72% 在诊断时患有肝硬化。最常见的诊断环境是二级护理(70%)。死亡中位年龄为 59 岁(IQR:46-72 岁);最常见的原因是肝癌(50%;n = 22)和终末期肝病(23%;n = 10)。结论:在伯明翰死于乙型肝炎相关原因的患者中,错过了早期诊断的机会,特别是在初级保健中。大多数死亡者是移民,可能在早年感染了乙型肝炎病毒,但大多数人是在二级保健机构被诊断为中年和晚期疾病。为了实现围绕乙型肝炎死亡率的公共卫生目标,必须改进检测的提供/采用以及与护理的联系,解决高危人群和医疗保健专业人员的障碍和认识。

title: Serum M2BPGi as a predictor of hepatocellular carcinoma development in chronic hepatitis B and C: a systematic review and meta-analysis
abstract: Background Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) kills about 830,000 people each year, and most cases arise in chronic viral hepatitis. Better risk markers would let clinicians focus surveillance where it matters. Mac-2 binding protein glycosylation isomer (M2BPGi) is a serum glycobiomarker of liver fibrosis. Several cohort studies tie elevated M2BPGi to HCC. No quantitative synthesis has pooled this evidence across viral etiologies. Methods We searched PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, the Cochrane Library, Web of Science, and Scopus through April 2026 for longitudinal studies that reported hazard ratios (HRs) for HCC linked to elevated M2BPGi in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) or C (HCV). We registered the protocol with PROSPERO. The primary pool restricted to longitudinal studies with categorical cutoffs that reported HRs. We used random-effects meta-analysis with restricted maximum likelihood and the Hartung–Knapp adjustment. Results Twenty-three publications (24 study entries) met inclusion criteria. The primary pool of 15 longitudinal categorical HR-reporting studies covered 12,161 participants and at least 1,189 HCC events. The pooled HR was 4.61 (95% CI 3.24–6.54; p < 0.0001) with low heterogeneity (I 2 = 25.6%). The 95% prediction interval ran from 2.08 to 10.18. The effect held across etiology (CHB k = 5 HR 4.12; HCV k = 10 HR 5.07; p_subgroup = 0.62) and across measurement timing (baseline HR 3.21; on/post-treatment HR 5.62; post-SVR HR 5.45; p_subgroup = 0.23). Two sensitivity pools re-introducing OR-based studies gave HR 4.71 ( k = 16) and HR 4.89 ( k = 17). Egger’s test was positive ( p = 0.0003); trim-and-fill imputed six studies and pulled the adjusted HR to 3.53. Conclusion Elevated serum M2BPGi is strongly and consistently associated with HCC development in patients with chronic hepatitis B and C. The effect holds across etiology, treatment status, and measurement timing–including after sustained virological response. Funnel asymmetry suggests the true effect is closer to a 3.5-fold than a 4.6-fold risk increase, still large enough to matter clinically. M2BPGi is a credible candidate to layer onto current viral hepatitis surveillance, particularly for risk stratification after virological control. Systematic Review Registration https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420261372566 , identifier CRD420261372566.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines the association between elevated serum Mac-2 binding protein glycosylation isomer (M2BPGi) levels and the development of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) or C (HCV). The central question is whether M2BPGi can serve as a predictor of HCC development in these populations.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This systematic review and meta-analysis searched PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, the Cochrane Library, Web of Science, and Scopus through April 2026 for longitudinal studies reporting hazard ratios (HRs) for HCC linked to elevated M2BPGi in CHB or HCV. The protocol was registered with PROSPERO. The primary pool included 15 longitudinal studies with categorical cutoffs reporting HRs, covering 12,161 participants and at least 1,189 HCC events. Random-effects meta-analysis with restricted maximum likelihood and the Hartung–Knapp adjustment was used. [A6][A7][A8][A9][A10][A11].
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The pooled hazard ratio (HR) for HCC development in patients with elevated M2BPGi was 4.61 (95% CI 3.24–6.54; p < 0.0001) with low heterogeneity (I2 = 25.6%). The effect was consistent across etiology (CHB HR 4.12; HCV HR 5.07; p_subgroup = 0.62) and measurement timing (baseline HR 3.21; on/post-treatment HR 5.62; post-SVR HR 5.45; p_subgroup = 0.23). Sensitivity analyses re-introducing odds ratio (OR)-based studies yielded HRs of 4.71 (k = 16) and 4.89 (k = 17).
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Funnel plot asymmetry suggested publication bias, with Egger’s test being positive (p = 0.0003). Trim-and-fill imputation adjusted the HR to 3.53, indicating the true effect might be closer to a 3.5-fold risk increase rather than the observed 4.6-fold increase. The review did not find studies that pooled evidence across viral etiologies before this work.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Elevated serum M2BPGi is strongly and consistently associated with HCC development in patients with chronic hepatitis B and C, making it a credible candidate for layered surveillance, particularly for risk stratification after virological control. Future research should address publication bias and validate these findings in diverse populations and clinical settings.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis investigated the association between elevated serum Mac-2 binding protein glycosylation isomer (M2BPGi) levels and the development of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) or C (HCV). The review included 23 publications (24 study entries) and found a pooled hazard ratio (HR) of 4.61 (95% CI 3.24–6.54; p < 0.0001) with low heterogeneity (I2 = 25.6%). The effect was consistent across etiology and measurement timing. Funnel plot asymmetry suggested publication bias, with an adjusted HR of 3.53 after trim-and-fill imputation. The review concludes that M2BPGi is a strong predictor of HCC development and a credible candidate for layered surveillance, particularly for risk stratification after virological control. Future research should address publication bias and validate these findings in diverse populations and clinical settings.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述探讨了慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 或丙型肝炎 (HCV) 患者血清 Mac-2 结合蛋白糖基化异构体 (M2BPGi) 水平升高与肝细胞癌 (HCC) 发展之间的关系。核心问题是 M2BPGi 是否可以作为这些人群中 HCC 发展的预测因子。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析检索了截至 2026 年 4 月的 PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Cochrane 图书馆、Web of Science 和 Scopus,以查找报告 HCC 风险比 (HR) 与 CHB 或 HCV 中 M2BPGi 升高相关的纵向研究。该协议已在 PROSPERO 注册。主要样本库包括 15 项报告 HR 的分类截止纵向研究,涵盖 12,161 名参与者和至少 1,189 起 HCC 事件。使用限制最大似然和 Hartung-Knapp 调整的随机效应荟萃分析。[A6][A7][A8][A9][A10][A11]。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: M2BPGi 升高的患者发生 HCC 的汇总风险比 (HR) 为 4.61 (95% CI 3.24–6.54;p < 0.0001),异质性较低 (I2 = 25.6%)。不同病因(CHB HR 4.12;HCV HR 5.07;p_subgroup = 0.62)和测量时间(基线 HR 3.21;治疗中/治疗后 HR 5.62;SVR 后 HR 5.45;p_subgroup = 0.23)的效果是一致的。重新引入基于比值比 (OR) 的研究的敏感性分析得出的 HR 为 4.71 (k = 16) 和 4.89 (k = 17)。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 漏斗图不对称表明存在发表偏倚,Egger 检验呈阳性 (p = 0.0003)。修剪填充插补将 HR 调整为 3.53,表明真实效果可能更接近风险增加 3.5 倍,而不是观察到的 4.6 倍增加。该综述没有发现在这项工作之前汇集了病毒病因学证据的研究。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 血清 M2BPGi 升高与慢性乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎患者的 HCC 发展密切相关,使其成为分层监测的可靠候选者,特别是病毒学控制后的风险分层。未来的研究应该解决发表偏倚,并在不同人群和临床环境中验证这些发现。

analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: This systematic review and meta-analysis searched PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, the Cochrane Library, Web of Science, and Scopus through April 2026 for longitudinal studies reporting hazard ratios (HRs) for HCC linked to elevated M2BPGi in CHB or HCV. The protocol was registered with PROSPERO. The primary pool included 15 longitudinal studies with categorical cutoffs reporting HRs, covering 12,161 participants and at least 1,189 HCC events. Random-effects meta-analysis with restricted maximum likelihood and the Hartung–Knapp adjustment was used. [A6][A7][A8][A9][A10][A11].
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The pooled hazard ratio (HR) for HCC development in patients with elevated M2BPGi was 4.61 (95% CI 3.24–6.54; p < 0.0001) with low heterogeneity (I2 = 25.6%). The effect was consistent across etiology (CHB HR 4.12; HCV HR 5.07; p_subgroup = 0.62) and measurement timing (baseline HR 3.21; on/post-treatment HR 5.62; post-SVR HR 5.45; p_subgroup = 0.23). Sensitivity analyses re-introducing odds ratio (OR)-based studies yielded HRs of 4.71 (k = 16) and 4.89 (k = 17).
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Funnel plot asymmetry suggested publication bias, with Egger’s test being positive (p = 0.0003). Trim-and-fill imputation adjusted the HR to 3.53, indicating the true effect might be closer to a 3.5-fold risk increase rather than the observed 4.6-fold increase. The review did not find studies that pooled evidence across viral etiologies before this work.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: Elevated serum M2BPGi is strongly and consistently associated with HCC development in patients with chronic hepatitis B and C, making it a credible candidate for layered surveillance, particularly for risk stratification after virological control. Future research should address publication bias and validate these findings in diverse populations and clinical settings.

title_zh: 血清 M2BPGi 作为慢性乙型和丙型肝炎肝细胞癌发展的预测因子:系统评价和荟萃分析
source_body_en: Background Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) kills about 830,000 people each year, and most cases arise in chronic viral hepatitis. Better risk markers would let clinicians focus surveillance where it matters. Mac-2 binding protein glycosylation isomer (M2BPGi) is a serum glycobiomarker of liver fibrosis. Several cohort studies tie elevated M2BPGi to HCC. No quantitative synthesis has pooled this evidence across viral etiologies. Methods We searched PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, the Cochrane Library, Web of Science, and Scopus through April 2026 for longitudinal studies that reported hazard ratios (HRs) for HCC linked to elevated M2BPGi in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) or C (HCV). We registered the protocol with PROSPERO. The primary pool restricted to longitudinal studies with categorical cutoffs that reported HRs. We used random-effects meta-analysis with restricted maximum likelihood and the Hartung–Knapp adjustment. Results Twenty-three publications (24 study entries) met inclusion criteria. The primary pool of 15 longitudinal categorical HR-reporting studies covered 12,161 participants and at least 1,189 HCC events. The pooled HR was 4.61 (95% CI 3.24–6.54; p < 0.0001) with low heterogeneity (I 2 = 25.6%). The 95% prediction interval ran from 2.08 to 10.18. The effect held across etiology (CHB k = 5 HR 4.12; HCV k = 10 HR 5.07; p_subgroup = 0.62) and across measurement timing (baseline HR 3.21; on/post-treatment HR 5.62; post-SVR HR 5.45; p_subgroup = 0.23). Two sensitivity pools re-introducing OR-based studies gave HR 4.71 ( k = 16) and HR 4.89 ( k = 17). Egger’s test was positive ( p = 0.0003); trim-and-fill imputed six studies and pulled the adjusted HR to 3.53. Conclusion Elevated serum M2BPGi is strongly and consistently associated with HCC development in patients with chronic hepatitis B and C. The effect holds across etiology, treatment status, and measurement timing–including after sustained virological response. Funnel asymmetry suggests the true effect is closer to a 3.5-fold than a 4.6-fold risk increase, still large enough to matter clinically. M2BPGi is a credible candidate to layer onto current viral hepatitis surveillance, particularly for risk stratification after virological control. Systematic Review Registration https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420261372566 , identifier CRD420261372566.
abstract_zh: 背景 肝细胞癌(HCC)每年导致约830,000人死亡,大多数病例源于慢性病毒性肝炎。更好的风险标志物将使临床医生能够将监测重点放在关键领域。Mac-2结合蛋白糖基化异构体(M2BPGi)是肝纤维化的血清糖生物标志物。多项队列研究将M2BPGi升高与HCC联系起来。尚未有定量合成将这种证据按病毒病因进行汇总。方法 我们通过2026年4月检索了PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Cochrane Library、Web of Science和Scopus,查找报告慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)或丙型肝炎(HCV)患者中M2BPGi升高与HCC相关联的比值比(HR)的纵向研究。我们在PROSPERO上注册了方案。主要汇总池仅限于报告HR的具有分类截断值的纵向研究。我们使用限制性最大似然法和Hartung–Knapp调整进行随机效应荟萃分析。结果 23篇出版物(24个研究条目)符合纳入标准。15项主要纵向分类HR报告研究汇总池涵盖了12,161名参与者和至少1,189例HCC事件。汇总HR为4.61(95% CI 3.24–6.54;p < 0.0001),异质性较低(I 2 = 25.6%)。95%预测区间从2.08到10.18。该效应在病因学(CHB k = 5 HR 4.12;HCV k = 10 HR 5.07;p_subgroup = 0.62)和测量时机(基线HR 3.21;治疗中/治疗后HR 5.62;SVR后HR 5.45;p_subgroup = 0.23)上均保持一致。重新纳入基于比值比(OR)研究的两个敏感性汇总池分别得出HR 4.71(k = 16)和HR 4.89(k = 17)。Egger检验呈阳性(p = 0.0003);修剪填充法填补了六项研究,并将调整后的HR拉低至3.53。结论 血清M2BPGi升高与慢性乙型和丙型肝炎患者HCC的发生强且一致相关。该效应在病因学、治疗状态和测量时机上均保持一致——包括在持续病毒学应答之后。漏斗不对称表明真实效应更接近3.5倍而非4.6倍的风险增加,但仍足以在临床上产生影响。M2BPGi是一个可信的候选标志物,可叠加到当前的病毒性肝炎监测中,特别是在病毒学控制后的风险分层方面。系统评价注册 https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420261372566,标识符CRD420261372566。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述探讨了慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 或丙型肝炎 (HCV) 患者血清 Mac-2 结合蛋白糖基化异构体 (M2BPGi) 水平升高与肝细胞癌 (HCC) 发展之间的关系。核心问题是 M2BPGi 是否可以作为这些人群中 HCC 发展的预测因子。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析检索了截至 2026 年 4 月的 PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Cochrane 图书馆、Web of Science 和 Scopus,以查找报告 HCC 风险比 (HR) 与 CHB 或 HCV 中 M2BPGi 升高相关的纵向研究。该协议已在 PROSPERO 注册。主要样本库包括 15 项报告 HR 的分类截止纵向研究,涵盖 12,161 名参与者和至少 1,189 起 HCC 事件。使用限制最大似然和 Hartung-Knapp 调整的随机效应荟萃分析。[A6][A7][A8][A9][A10][A11]。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: M2BPGi 升高的患者发生 HCC 的汇总风险比 (HR) 为 4.61 (95% CI 3.24–6.54;p < 0.0001),异质性较低 (I2 = 25.6%)。不同病因(CHB HR 4.12;HCV HR 5.07;p_subgroup = 0.62)和测量时间(基线 HR 3.21;治疗中/治疗后 HR 5.62;SVR 后 HR 5.45;p_subgroup = 0.23)的效果是一致的。重新引入基于比值比 (OR) 的研究的敏感性分析得出的 HR 为 4.71 (k = 16) 和 4.89 (k = 17)。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 漏斗图不对称表明存在发表偏倚,Egger 检验呈阳性 (p = 0.0003)。修剪填充插补将 HR 调整为 3.53,表明真实效果可能更接近风险增加 3.5 倍,而不是观察到的 4.6 倍增加。该综述没有发现在这项工作之前汇集了病毒病因学证据的研究。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 血清 M2BPGi 升高与慢性乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎患者的 HCC 发展密切相关,使其成为分层监测的可靠候选者,特别是病毒学控制后的风险分层。未来的研究应该解决发表偏倚,并在不同人群和临床环境中验证这些发现。

title: Spatiotemporal epidemiology of hepatitis B in Central China: urbanization drivers and implications for adult-targeted control strategies.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a significant global public health challenge. Hubei Province, a historically high-prevalence area in central China, continues to face persistently high rates of adult HBsAg carriers despite effective reduction of childhood transmission through universal vaccination, hindering progress toward HBV elimination goals. This study aims to identify key drivers behind the rising hepatitis B incidence in the region, forecast future trends, and inform targeted control strategies. METHODS: This population-based spatiotemporal epidemiological study analyzed hepatitis B surveillance data from Hubei Province between January 2015 and December 2024, covering 631,361 reported cases across 17 prefecture-level divisions. Spatial clustering was assessed using Global Moran's I statistics. Urbanization-related spatial drivers were identified via geographically weighted random forest modeling with SHAP value interpretation, and future incidence trends were predicted using Holt-Winters time series forecasting. RESULTS: The average annual incidence was 106.19 per 100,000 population, showing a U-shaped temporal trend: declining from 111.75 per 100,000 in 2015 to 83.58 in 2020, then rising to 125.86 in 2024. Adults aged 30-50 years consistently accounted for 40-50% of total cases. Significant spatial clustering was detected (Global Moran's I: 0.124-0.307, P < 0.05), with persistent high-risk zones concentrated in the Wuhan metropolitan area. The geographically weighted random forest model identified urbanization rate as the primary spatial driver (SHAP value ≈2.0), followed by higher education enrollment rate (≈1.0) and passenger traffic volume (≈0.8). Time series forecasting projected monthly incidence rates of 8.98-10.41 per 100,000 over the subsequent 18 months (R2 = 0.892, MAPE = 1.74%). CONCLUSION: In Hubei Province, the hepatitis B burden has concentrated in adults born before the vaccine era, underscoring horizontal transmission risks in this susceptible cohort. Urbanization significantly impacts the spatial distribution of hepatitis B, with high-risk areas mainly concentrated in the Wuhan metropolitan region. It is crucial to address urbanization-related factors affecting HBV transmission and to implement targeted screening and revaccination for adults aged 30-50, particularly among high-risk individuals, mobile populations, and rural residents, to reduce incidence and alleviate the regional disease burden.

abstract_zh: 背景:乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染仍然是一个重大的全球公共卫生挑战。湖北省是中国中部历史上的高流行地区,尽管通过全民疫苗接种有效减少了儿童传播,但成人 HBsAg 携带率仍然居高不下,阻碍了乙肝消除目标的进展。本研究旨在确定该地区乙型肝炎发病率上升的关键驱动因素,预测未来趋势,并为有针对性的控制策略提供信息。方法:本次基于人群的时空流行病学研究分析了湖北省2015年1月至2024年12月的乙型肝炎监测数据,覆盖17个地级市的631,361例报告病例。使用 Global Moran's I 统计数据评估空间聚类。通过地理加权随机森林模型和 SHAP 值解释来确定与城市化相关的空间驱动因素,并使用 Holt-Winters 时间序列预测来预测未来的发病趋势。结果:年平均发病率为106.19/10万,呈U型趋势:从2015年的111.75/10万下降到2020年的83.58,然后上升到2024年的125.86。30-50岁的成年人一直占总病例的40-50%。存在显着的空间聚集性(Global Moran's I:0.124-0.307,P < 0.05),持续高风险区集中在武汉都市圈。地理加权随机森林模型将城市化率确定为主要空间驱动因素(SHAP值约2.0),其次是高等教育入学率(约1.0)和客运量(约0.8)。时间序列预测预计接下来 18 个月内的月发病率为每 100,000 人 8.98-10.41 例(R2 = 0.892,MAPE = 1.74%)。结论:在湖北省,乙型肝炎负担集中在疫苗时代之前出生的成年人,强调了这一易感人群的水平传播风险。城市化进程显着影响乙型肝炎的空间分布,高危地区主要集中在武汉都市圈。解决城市化影响乙肝传播的因素,对30-50岁成年人特别是高危人群、流动人口和农村居民实施有针对性的筛查和再接种,以降低乙肝发病率,减轻区域疾病负担。

title: Recombinant polyclonal antibody GIGA-2339 potently and pan-genotypically neutralizes hepatitis B virus.
abstract: Existing hepatitis B virus (HBV) treatments control viral replication in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients but fail to prevent hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) production; excessive HBsAg production leads to HBV-specific immune tolerance. GIGA-2339 is a first-in-class, recombinant polyclonal antibody (pAb) therapeutic consisting of over 1,000 human IgG1/IgK antibodies targeting HBsAg epitopes developed for the treatment of chronic HBV infection. As Hepatitis D virus (HDV) utilizes HBsAg produced by HBV for viral entry, GIGA-2339 may also provide benefit to HDV/HBV co-infected patients. Memory B cells from HBV vaccinated donors were isolated and HBsAg-specific antibody sequences were enriched using GigaGen's single cell microfluidic antibody capture platform. Full-length antibody sequences targeting HBsAg were cloned and transfected en masse using a targeted integration Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cell line, followed by bulk expression and purification. In vitro, GIGA-2339 bound HBsAg and neutralized live HBV with over 2,000-fold greater potency than a plasma-based hepatitis B immunoglobulin hyperimmune (HyperHEP B) and slightly lower potency than a HBsAg monoclonal antibody (mAb). GIGA-2339 neutralized pan-genotypic HBsAg (A-H) enveloped viral particles, bound clinically significant HBsAg escape mutants, and engaged human Fc receptors on immune cells. In vivo studies showed improved reduction of circulating HBsAg in a chronic stage as compared to HyperHEP B. The novel polyclonal antibody therapeutic GIGA-2339 potently binds and neutralizes HBsAg to prevent viral infection and to reduce circulating antigen. GIGA-2339 represents an important new therapeutic modality for the CHB treatment landscape and is currently in clinical development.

source_records.abstract: Existing hepatitis B virus (HBV) treatments control viral replication in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients but fail to prevent hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) production; excessive HBsAg production leads to HBV-specific immune tolerance. GIGA-2339 is a first-in-class, recombinant polyclonal antibody (pAb) therapeutic consisting of over 1,000 human IgG1/IgK antibodies targeting HBsAg epitopes developed for the treatment of chronic HBV infection. As Hepatitis D virus (HDV) utilizes HBsAg produced by HBV for viral entry, GIGA-2339 may also provide benefit to HDV/HBV co-infected patients. Memory B cells from HBV vaccinated donors were isolated and HBsAg-specific antibody sequences were enriched using GigaGen's single cell microfluidic antibody capture platform. Full-length antibody sequences targeting HBsAg were cloned and transfected en masse using a targeted integration Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cell line, followed by bulk expression and purification. In vitro, GIGA-2339 bound HBsAg and neutralized live HBV with over 2,000-fold greater potency than a plasma-based hepatitis B immunoglobulin hyperimmune (HyperHEP B) and slightly lower potency than a HBsAg monoclonal antibody (mAb). GIGA-2339 neutralized pan-genotypic HBsAg (A-H) enveloped viral particles, bound clinically significant HBsAg escape mutants, and engaged human Fc receptors on immune cells. In vivo studies showed improved reduction of circulating HBsAg in a chronic stage as compared to HyperHEP B. The novel polyclonal antibody therapeutic GIGA-2339 potently binds and neutralizes HBsAg to prevent viral infection and to reduce circulating antigen. GIGA-2339 represents an important new therapeutic modality for the CHB treatment landscape and is currently in clinical development.

abstract_zh: 现有的乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)治疗可以控制慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)患者的病毒复制,但无法阻止乙型肝炎表面抗原(HBsAg)的产生;过量的 HBsAg 产生会导致 HBV 特异性免疫耐受。GIGA-2339 是一种一流的重组多克隆抗体 (pAb) 治疗药物,由 1,000 多种针对 HBsAg 表位的人 IgG1/IgK 抗体组成,专为治疗慢性 HBV 感染而开发。由于丁型肝炎病毒 (HDV) 利用 HBV 产生的 HBsAg 进行病毒侵入,因此 GIGA-2339 也可能为 HDV/HBV 共感染患者带来益处。使用 GigaGen 的单细胞微流控抗体捕获平台,分离了来自 HBV 疫苗接种者的记忆 B 细胞,并富集了 HBsAg 特异性抗体序列。使用靶向整合中国仓鼠卵巢 (CHO) 细胞系克隆并集体转染针对 HBsAg 的全长抗体序列,然后进行批量表达和纯化。在体外,GIGA-2339 结合 HBsAg 并中和活 HBV,其效力比基于血浆的乙型肝炎免疫球蛋白超免疫 (HyperHEP B) 高 2,000 倍,但比 HBsAg 单克隆抗体 (mAb) 的效力略低。GIGA-2339 中和全基因型 HBsAg (A-H) 包膜病毒颗粒,结合具有临床意义的 HBsAg 逃逸突变体,并与免疫细胞上的人类 Fc 受体结合。体内研究表明,与 HyperHEP B 相比,慢性阶段循环 HBsAg 的减少有所改善。新型多克隆抗体治疗剂 GIGA-2339 有效结合并中和 HBsAg,以预防病毒感染并减少循环抗原。GIGA-2339代表了慢性乙型肝炎治疗领域的一种重要的新治疗方式,目前正处于临床开发阶段。

title: Correlates of hepatitis B virus awareness and disease specific knowledge in Uganda: a meta-analysis and meta-regression of studies published between 2018 and 2025.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major public health challenge in Uganda, where prevalence varies by region and population group despite national vaccination and screening initiatives. Understanding awareness and knowledge levels is essential for guiding HBV prevention and control strategies. This study synthesized available evidence on the correlates of HBV awareness and disease specific knowledge among different Ugandan populations. METHODS: We systematically searched PubMed, African Journals Online (AJOL), and Google Scholar for cross-sectional studies reporting on HBV awareness or disease-specific knowledge in Uganda, published between January 2018 and December 2025. Study selection, data extraction, and quality appraisal were conducted independently by two reviewers using the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) Critical Appraisal Checklist for Analytical Cross-Sectional Studies. Eighteen studies meeting the eligibility criteria were included in the final synthesis. Pooled estimates of HBV awareness and correlates of disease-specific knowledge were computed using a random-effects model in MedCalc software (version 10.10), with heterogeneity quantified using the I2 statistic. Sources of heterogeneity were explored through subgroup analysis and sensitivity analysis. Meta-regression was performed to examine trends in HBV awareness by region, year of publication, and study population. Publication bias was assessed using Begg's and Egger's tests. Statistical significance was set at p < 0.05, and all estimates are reported with 95% confidence intervals. RESULTS: Eighteen studies met the inclusion criteria. The pooled prevalence of HBV awareness was 75.3% (95% CI: 61.5%-86.9%), with substantial heterogeneity observed across regions and population groups (I2=99.24%). Subgroup analysis revealed that awareness was significantly higher in Central Uganda compared to the northern, eastern, and western regions (p < 0.05), and among healthcare workers compared to the general population and antenatal care attendees (p < 0.05). Knowledge of specific HBV domains varied considerably: awareness of the causative agent, screening services, and vaccination availability was significantly higher among knowledgeable participants compared to those with no prior HBV knowledge (p < 0.05), whereas awareness of post-exposure prophylaxis and completion of the full HBV vaccination schedule remained low compared to those who had received at least partial vaccination (p < 0.05). Awareness of key transmission routes including sexual contact, needle sharing, and mother-to-child transmission was moderate, though knowledge of transmission through infected body fluids remained poor. Participants who were of higher education level were more likely to take up vaccination compared to lower education level (p < 0.05), and participants with a positive attitude toward vaccine effectiveness were significantly more likely to be vaccinated compared to those with a negative attitude (p < 0.05). The meta-regression analysis further revealed a paradoxical overall decline in HBV awareness over the study period. CONCLUSION: Critical gaps still persist in HBV awareness and key knowledge areas highlighting the need for alternative strategies tailored to the social dynamics of the current generation during the delivery of health messages. CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: Not applicable.

title_zh: 乌干达乙型肝炎病毒认识与疾病特定知识的相关性:对 2018 年至 2025 年发表的研究进行荟萃分析和荟萃回归。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major public health challenge in Uganda, where prevalence varies by region and population group despite national vaccination and screening initiatives. Understanding awareness and knowledge levels is essential for guiding HBV prevention and control strategies. This study synthesized available evidence on the correlates of HBV awareness and disease specific knowledge among different Ugandan populations. METHODS: We systematically searched PubMed, African Journals Online (AJOL), and Google Scholar for cross-sectional studies reporting on HBV awareness or disease-specific knowledge in Uganda, published between January 2018 and December 2025. Study selection, data extraction, and quality appraisal were conducted independently by two reviewers using the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) Critical Appraisal Checklist for Analytical Cross-Sectional Studies. Eighteen studies meeting the eligibility criteria were included in the final synthesis. Pooled estimates of HBV awareness and correlates of disease-specific knowledge were computed using a random-effects model in MedCalc software (version 10.10), with heterogeneity quantified using the I2 statistic. Sources of heterogeneity were explored through subgroup analysis and sensitivity analysis. Meta-regression was performed to examine trends in HBV awareness by region, year of publication, and study population. Publication bias was assessed using Begg's and Egger's tests. Statistical significance was set at p < 0.05, and all estimates are reported with 95% confidence intervals. RESULTS: Eighteen studies met the inclusion criteria. The pooled prevalence of HBV awareness was 75.3% (95% CI: 61.5%-86.9%), with substantial heterogeneity observed across regions and population groups (I2=99.24%). Subgroup analysis revealed that awareness was significantly higher in Central Uganda compared to the northern, eastern, and western regions (p < 0.05), and among healthcare workers compared to the general population and antenatal care attendees (p < 0.05). Knowledge of specific HBV domains varied considerably: awareness of the causative agent, screening services, and vaccination availability was significantly higher among knowledgeable participants compared to those with no prior HBV knowledge (p < 0.05), whereas awareness of post-exposure prophylaxis and completion of the full HBV vaccination schedule remained low compared to those who had received at least partial vaccination (p < 0.05). Awareness of key transmission routes including sexual contact, needle sharing, and mother-to-child transmission was moderate, though knowledge of transmission through infected body fluids remained poor. Participants who were of higher education level were more likely to take up vaccination compared to lower education level (p < 0.05), and participants with a positive attitude toward vaccine effectiveness were significantly more likely to be vaccinated compared to those with a negative attitude (p < 0.05). The meta-regression analysis further revealed a paradoxical overall decline in HBV awareness over the study period. CONCLUSION: Critical gaps still persist in HBV awareness and key knowledge areas highlighting the need for alternative strategies tailored to the social dynamics of the current generation during the delivery of health messages. abstract_zh: 背景:乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)仍然是乌干达的一个主要公共卫生挑战,尽管国家采取了疫苗接种和筛查举措,但其患病率因地区和人群而异。了解意识和知识水平对于指导乙肝预防和控制策略至关重要。这项研究综合了乌干达不同人群对乙肝病毒的认识和疾病具体知识之间的相关性的现有证据。方法:我们系统地检索了 PubMed、非洲期刊在线 (AJOL) 和 Google Scholar,查找 2018 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月期间发表的关于乌干达 HBV 认知或特定疾病知识的横断面研究。研究选择、数据提取和质量评估由两名评审员使用 Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) 分析横断面研究批判评估清单独立进行。最终综合报告中纳入了十八项符合资格标准的研究。使用 MedCalc 软件(版本 10.10)中的随机效应模型计算 HBV 认知度和特定疾病知识相关性的汇总估计,并使用 I2 统计量量化异质性。通过亚组分析和敏感性分析探讨异质性的来源。进行元回归以检查按地区、出版年份和研究人群划分的 HBV 认知趋势。使用 Begg 和 Egger 测试评估发表偏倚。统计显着性设置为 p < 0.05,所有估计值均以 95% 置信区间报告。结果:十八项研究符合纳入标准。乙型肝炎知晓率汇总率为 75.3%(95% CI:61.5%-86.9%),不同地区和人群之间存在显着异质性(I2=99.24%)。亚组分析显示,与北部、东部和西部地区相比,乌干达中部地区的知晓率显着较高(p < 0.05),与一般人群和产前护理人员相比,医护人员的知晓率显着较高(p < 0.05)。对特定 HBV 领域的了解差异很大:与先前没有 HBV 知识的参与者相比,知识丰富的参与者对病原体、筛查服务和疫苗接种可用性的认识显着较高 (p < 0.05),而与至少接受部分疫苗接种的参与者相比,对暴露后预防和完成完整 HBV 疫苗接种计划的认识仍然较低 (p < 0.05)。尽管对通过受感染体液传播的了解仍然很少,但对性接触、共用针头和母婴传播等关键传播途径的了解程度较低。与教育水平较低的参与者相比,受教育程度较高的参与者更有可能接种疫苗(p < 0.05),对疫苗有效性持积极态度的参与者比持消极态度的参与者更有可能接种疫苗(p < 0.05)。荟萃回归分析进一步揭示了研究期间乙肝病毒认知度整体下降的矛盾现象。结论:对乙肝病毒的认识和关键知识领域仍然存在严重差距,这突出表明在传播健康信息时需要针对当代社会动态制定替代策略。临床试验编号:不适用。

title: Texture Analysis of Non-contrast Magnetic Resonance Imaging for Liver Fibrosis Staging in Patients with Chronic Hepatitis B
abstract: Background and Aims: To evaluate the diagnostic performance of texture analysis parameters obtained from non-contrast liver magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) in staging liver fibrosis in patients with chronic hepatitis B. Methods: Non-contrast MRI examinations of 66 patients with chronic hepatitis B were retrospectively evaluated. The protocol included in-phase T1-weighted (IP-T1W), out-of-phase T1-weighted (OP-T1W), fat-suppressed T1-weighted (FS-T1W), fat-suppressed T2-weighted (FS-T2W), and T2-weighted (T2W) sequences. Histogram-based texture features were extracted from regions of interest placed in the liver parenchyma. For each sequence, the most informative features were selected from 20 candidate variables using the minimal-redundancy maximal-relevance (mRMR) algorithm, and multivariable logistic regression models were constructed. Fibrosis was categorized as early fibrosis (F0-F2) or significant fibrosis (F3-F6). Diagnostic performance was assessed using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis and area under the curve (AUC), and model generalizability was evaluated by 10-fold cross-validation. Results: Sixty-six patients were included (early fibrosis, n=43; significant fibrosis, n=23). ROC analysis showed that the highest discriminatory performance was obtained with the OP-T1W sequence (AUC=0.789, 95%CI: 0.677-0.900, p 0.05). Based on the Youden index-derived thresholds, the OP-T1W sequence achieved the highest diagnostic accuracy (72.31%) and sensitivity (79.17%), whereas the FS-T1W sequence demonstrated the highest specificity (83.72%). In 10-fold cross-validation, the highest mean AUC was observed for OP-T1W (0.785±0.168), followed by FS-T2W (0.760±0.168), whereas IP-T1W showed a lower mean AUC (0.653±0.128). Conclusions: Texture analysis parameters derived from routine non-contrast MRI sequences in patients with chronic hepatitis B may provide additional quantitative information for the noninvasive assessment of liver fibrosis. These findings suggest that texture analysis may serve as a complementary tool within routine liver MRI. However, given the single-center design and limited sample size of the present study, further studies with larger cohorts and external validation are needed before clinical application.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis B leads to liver fibrosis, and accurate staging is critical for management, but current non-invasive methods have limitations. The study aimed to evaluate whether texture analysis of non-contrast MRI sequences can improve diagnostic performance for staging liver fibrosis in these patients.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This retrospective single-center study evaluated non-contrast MRI examinations from 66 patients with chronic hepatitis B, categorizing fibrosis as early (F0-F2) or significant (F3-F6).
analysis.methods: Histogram-based texture features were extracted from liver parenchyma regions of interest across five MRI sequences, with feature selection performed using the mRMR algorithm and multivariable logistic regression models built for each sequence. Diagnostic performance was assessed via ROC analysis and AUC, with 10-fold cross-validation used to evaluate generalizability.
analysis.main_results: The out-of-phase T1-weighted (OP-T1W) sequence achieved the highest discriminatory performance (AUC=0.789, 95% CI: 0.677–0.900) and diagnostic accuracy (72.31%), with sensitivity of 79.17% and specificity of 83.72% for significant fibrosis. In 10-fold cross-validation, OP-T1W maintained the highest mean AUC (0.785±0.168).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these findings as evidence that texture analysis of routine non-contrast MRI sequences can provide additional quantitative information for noninvasive liver fibrosis assessment in chronic hepatitis B. The novelty lies in demonstrating that specific MRI sequences, particularly OP-T1W, offer superior diagnostic utility compared to others.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results suggest that texture analysis could complement existing noninvasive methods for liver fibrosis staging, potentially improving diagnostic accuracy in clinical practice without requiring contrast agents.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s single-center design, limited sample size, and lack of external validation constrain generalizability and clinical applicability, warranting larger, multi-center studies with external validation before adoption.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎会导致肝纤维化,准确的分期对于治疗至关重要,但目前的非侵入性方法存在局限性。该研究旨在评估非对比 MRI 序列的纹理分析是否可以提高这些患者肝纤维化分期的诊断性能。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项回顾性单中心研究评估了 66 名慢性乙型肝炎患者的非对比 MRI 检查,将纤维化分类为早期 (F0-F2) 或显着 (F3-F6)。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为证据,表明常规非对比 MRI 序列的纹理分析可以为慢性乙型肝炎的无创性肝纤维化评估提供额外的定量信息。新颖之处在于证明特定的 MRI 序列,特别是 OP-T1W,与其他序列相比,可提供卓越的诊断效用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果表明,纹理分析可以补充现有的肝纤维化分期无创方法,有可能提高临床实践中的诊断准确性,而无需造影剂。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的单中心设计、有限的样本量以及缺乏外部验证限制了普遍性和临床适用性,需要在采用之前进行更大规模的多中心研究并进行外部验证。

title: Outcomes of nucleos(t)ide analogue discontinuation following finite xalnesiran-based therapies in chronic hepatitis B.
abstract: BACKGROUND & AIMS: Novel regimens aimed at achieving functional cure of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) in virologically suppressed participants require the withdrawal of nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA). However, data from clinical trials are limited. METHODS: Piranga is a Phase 2 platform trial that evaluated 4 xalnesiran regimens with or without an immunomodulator in virologically suppressed participants with CHB. All participants continued the established NA therapy until NA stopping criteria were met at the end of treatment or during follow-up. Participants who stopped NA were monitored and restarted NA if restarting criteria were met. This post hoc evaluation reports the NA discontinuation events and outcomes. RESULTS: Among 121 participants, 58 (48%) met NA stopping criteria and 40 (33%) discontinued NA. Of these 40, 17 (43%) met NA restarting criteria, 16 (40%) restarted NA, and 24 (60%) remained off NA by the end of the study (EOS). Among participants who remained off NA, 5 achieved and maintained HBsAg loss (HBsAg <0.05 IU/mL) and HBV DNA undetectable (HBV DNA <10 IU/mL); all were in treatment arms with an immunomodulator. Of the 40 participants who discontinued NA, 19 (48%) experienced virological relapse (VR), 3 (8%) of whom further developed clinical relapse (CR). The majority of participants restarted NA following VR. VR and CR events were associated with preserved liver function and resolved without sequelae. CONCLUSIONS: NA discontinuation after xalnesiran-based therapy was safely managed with the application of prespecified NA stopping and restarting criteria and close monitoring. Five participants achieved and maintained HBsAg loss and undetectable HBV DNA while off NA until EOS. CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: NCT04225715.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) functional cure strategies often require nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) withdrawal, but clinical trial data on outcomes after NA discontinuation are limited. The study aimed to evaluate NA discontinuation events and outcomes following xalnesiran-based finite therapies in virologically suppressed CHB participants.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Piranga is a Phase 2 platform trial evaluating four xalnesiran regimens with or without an immunomodulator in virologically suppressed CHB participants. Participants who met NA stopping criteria discontinued NA and were monitored, with NA restarted if predefined restarting criteria were met.
analysis.methods: The trial applied prespecified NA stopping and restarting criteria, with close monitoring of participants after NA discontinuation. NA discontinuation events and outcomes were reported in a post hoc evaluation of the trial data.
analysis.main_results: Among 121 participants, 58 (48%) met NA stopping criteria and 40 (33%) discontinued NA. Of these 40, 17 (43%) met NA restarting criteria, 16 (40%) restarted NA, and 24 (60%) remained off NA by the end of the study. Five participants achieved and maintained HBsAg loss and undetectable HBV DNA while off NA until the end of the study.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: NA discontinuation after xalnesiran-based therapy was safely managed with prespecified criteria and monitoring, with five participants achieving sustained HBsAg loss and undetectable HBV DNA off NA. The novelty lies in demonstrating that finite xalnesiran-based regimens can facilitate NA discontinuation with careful clinical oversight.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that finite xalnesiran-based therapies may enable safe NA discontinuation in selected CHB patients, potentially reducing long-term NA exposure. This supports further investigation into functional cure strategies and individualized stopping criteria.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is a post hoc evaluation from a Phase 2 trial with a small sample size (n=40 discontinuations), limiting generalizability. The evidence strength is moderate due to the non-randomized design and reliance on predefined stopping/restarting criteria without long-term follow-up beyond the end of the study.

analysis.summary_en: This Phase 2 platform trial evaluated nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) discontinuation following finite xalnesiran-based therapies in virologically suppressed chronic hepatitis B (CHB) participants. Among 121 participants, 40 (33%) discontinued NA, with 24 (60%) remaining off therapy by study end. Five participants achieved sustained HBsAg loss and undetectable HBV DNA off NA, all in arms receiving an immunomodulator. NA discontinuation was managed using prespecified stopping and restarting criteria with close monitoring, and virological or clinical relapses resolved without sequelae. While the approach appears safe in this setting, the post hoc analysis and small sample size limit broader conclusions. The findings support further exploration of xalnesiran-based regimens as part of functional cure strategies for CHB.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 功能性治愈策略通常需要停用核苷(酸)类似物 (NA),但关于停用 NA 后结果的临床试验数据有限。该研究旨在评估病毒学抑制的慢性乙型肝炎参与者接受基于 Xalnesiran 的有限疗法后 NA 停药事件和结果。

elements_zh.methods: 该试验采用了预先指定的 NA 停止和重新启动标准,并在 NA 停止后密切监测参与者。NA 停药事件和结果在试验数据的事后评估中报告。
elements_zh.main_results: 在121名参与者中,58名(48%)符合NA停药标准,40名(33%)停用NA。在这40人中,17名(43%)符合NA重新开始标准,16名(40%)重新开始NA,而24名(60%)在研究结束时仍未使用NA。有5名参与者在停用NA期间实现了并维持了HBsAg阴转和HBV DNA不可检测,直至研究结束。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 基于 Xalnesiran 的治疗后 NA 停药通过预先设定的标准和监测得到安全管理,其中 5 名参与者实现了 HBsAg 持续消失,且 NA 后 HBV DNA 检测不到。新颖之处在于证明有限的基于xalnesiran的方案可以通过仔细的临床监督促进NA的停药。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,基于 xalnesiran 的有限疗法可以使选定的慢性乙型肝炎患者安全停止 NA,从而有可能减少长期 NA 暴露。这支持进一步研究功能性治疗策略和个体化停止标准。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是对 2 期试验的事后评估,样本量较小(n = 40 次停药),限制了普遍性。由于非随机设计和对预先确定的停止/重新启动标准的依赖,在研究结束后没有长期随访,证据强度中等。

title_zh: 慢性乙型肝炎基于 Xalnesiran 的有限疗法后停用核苷(酸)类似物的结果。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND & AIMS: Novel regimens aimed at achieving functional cure of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) in virologically suppressed participants require the withdrawal of nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA). However, data from clinical trials are limited. METHODS: Piranga is a Phase 2 platform trial that evaluated 4 xalnesiran regimens with or without an immunomodulator in virologically suppressed participants with CHB. All participants continued the established NA therapy until NA stopping criteria were met at the end of treatment or during follow-up. Participants who stopped NA were monitored and restarted NA if restarting criteria were met. This post hoc evaluation reports the NA discontinuation events and outcomes. RESULTS: Among 121 participants, 58 (48%) met NA stopping criteria and 40 (33%) discontinued NA. Of these 40, 17 (43%) met NA restarting criteria, 16 (40%) restarted NA, and 24 (60%) remained off NA by the end of the study (EOS). Among participants who remained off NA, 5 achieved and maintained HBsAg loss (HBsAg <0.05 IU/mL) and HBV DNA undetectable (HBV DNA <10 IU/mL); all were in treatment arms with an immunomodulator. Of the 40 participants who discontinued NA, 19 (48%) experienced virological relapse (VR), 3 (8%) of whom further developed clinical relapse (CR). The majority of participants restarted NA following VR. VR and CR events were associated with preserved liver function and resolved without sequelae. CONCLUSIONS: NA discontinuation after xalnesiran-based therapy was safely managed with the application of prespecified NA stopping and restarting criteria and close monitoring. Five participants achieved and maintained HBsAg loss and undetectable HBV DNA while off NA until EOS. CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: NCT04225715.

title: Drug resistance mutations of hepatitis B virus (HBV) influence the yield of the virions of the human hepatitis delta virus (HDV) and their infectivity
abstract: UNLABELLED: This work analyzed 30 drug resistance mutations (DRMs) in the surface antigen of hepatitis B virus (HBV) (i.e., HBsAg) selected by several FDA-approved anti-HBV nucleos(t)ide analogs. All DRM-bearing HBsAg variants supported the formation and secretion of hepatitis delta virus (HDV), and only 13/30 DRMs considerably decreased the yield of secreted HDV virions. However, the majority of DRMs (23/30) greatly reduced HDV infectivity, and four of them even caused the complete loss of infectivity, which was determined by analyzing the levels of HDV RNA genomes in the infected cells, and the fraction of HDV-infected cells. The ability to inhibit HDV infectivity was observed for DRMs located in the large cytosolic loop (LCL), major antigenic loop (MAL), HDV-binding site (HDV-BS), and the transmembrane domains II, III, and IV of HBsAg, which suggested that DRMs mediate their inhibitory influence by both direct and indirect mechanisms that could alter the attachment/entry, post-entry trafficking, and/or subsequent uncoating of the virions. This report also established the transmembrane domains II, III, and IV as critical regulators of the overall infectivity of HDV virions. It became apparent that in the settings of natural HBV/HDV infection, DRMs can therefore greatly reduce the spread/superinfection of HDV and diminish the size of the HDV reservoir in chronically infected livers. Overall, our findings advanced the understanding of how anti-HBV drug treatments influence the HDV life cycle, the roles of HBV envelope proteins in facilitating the assembly and infectivity of HDV, and the mechanism of complex HBV-HDV interactions. IMPORTANCE: The study showed that the drug resistance mutations (DRMs) in the surface antigen of hepatitis B virus (HBsAg) can greatly reduce hepatitis delta virus (HDV) assembly and infectivity. Since most of the tested DRMs considerably reduced HDV infectivity, and four of them resulted in a complete loss of the infectivity, such effects can lead to suppression of HDV spread/superinfection and reduction of the HDV reservoir in the infected liver. If most detrimental for infectivity DRMs are present on the majority of HBsAg molecules, this could facilitate substantial suppression of chronic HDV infection and possibly reduce HDV-associated liver pathogenesis. It was also determined that DRMs located in the transmembrane domains II, III, and IV of HBsAg could critically alter HDV infectivity. Our findings therefore suggest that different HBsAg regions work in the intramolecular coordinating concert, facilitating the assembly and infectivity of the virions, and that certain short- and long-distance interactions between different regions of HBsAg take place.

All DRM-bearing HBsAg variants supported the formation and secretion of hepatitis delta virus (HDV), and only 13/30 DRMs considerably decreased the yield of secreted HDV virions. However, the majority of DRMs (23/30) greatly reduced HDV infectivity, and four of them even caused the complete loss of infectivity, which was determined by analyzing the levels of HDV RNA genomes in the infected cells, and the fraction of HDV-infected cells. The ability to inhibit HDV infectivity was observed for DRMs located in the large cytosolic loop (LCL), major antigenic loop (MAL), HDV-binding site (HDV-BS), and the transmembrane domains II, III, and IV of HBsAg, which suggested that DRMs mediate their inhibitory influence by both direct and indirect mechanisms that could alter the attachment/entry, post-entry trafficking, and/or subsequent uncoating of the virions. This report also established the transmembrane domains II, III, and IV as critical regulators of the overall infectivity of HDV virions. It became apparent that in the settings of natural HBV/HDV infection, DRMs can therefore greatly reduce the spread/superinfection of HDV and diminish the size of the HDV reservoir in chronically infected livers. Overall, our findings advanced the understanding of how anti-HBV drug treatments influence the HDV life cycle, the roles of HBV envelope proteins in facilitating the assembly and infectivity of HDV, and the mechanism of complex HBV-HDV interactions. IMPORTANCE: The study showed that the drug resistance mutations (DRMs) in the surface antigen of hepatitis B virus (HBsAg) can greatly reduce hepatitis delta virus (HDV) assembly and infectivity. Since most of the tested DRMs considerably reduced HDV infectivity, and four of them resulted in a complete loss of the infectivity, such effects can lead to suppression of HDV spread/superinfection and reduction of the HDV reservoir in the infected liver. If most detrimental for infectivity DRMs are present on the majority of HBsAg molecules, this could facilitate substantial suppression of chronic HDV infection and possibly reduce HDV-associated liver pathogenesis. It was also determined that DRMs located in the transmembrane domains II, III, and IV of HBsAg could critically alter HDV infectivity. Our findings therefore suggest that different HBsAg regions work in the intramolecular coordinating concert, facilitating the assembly and infectivity of the virions, and that certain short- and long-distance interactions between different regions of HBsAg take place.

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 还确定位于 HBsAg 跨膜域 II、III 和 IV 中的 DRM 可以严重改变 HDV 感染性。

title: Evaluating the impact of the Hepatitis B Foundation's international storytelling program on empowerment, advocacy, and stigma reduction.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis B remains a major global public health challenge, characterized by low awareness, underdiagnosis, limited access to care, and persistent stigma. Storytelling has emerged as a promising health communication strategy to humanize disease experiences, reduce stigma, and promote advocacy. This study evaluates the Hepatitis B Foundation's International Storytelling Program and its impact on storytellers' empowerment, confidence, stigma experiences, and advocacy engagement. METHODS: A mixed-methods evaluation was conducted among adults who recorded personal hepatitis B stories through the program. Quantitative data were collected via an immediate post-recording survey (n = 25) and a follow-up survey 3-6 months later (n = 11), assessing satisfaction, emotional responses, confidence, stigma experiences, and advocacy activities. Survey instruments were developed by the study team and were not previously validated, which may limit measurement reliability and comparability across studies. Descriptive statistics were calculated. Fifteen participants were interviewed qualitatively; these individuals were part of an eligible pool of storytellers spanning 22 countries. Interviews were transcribed and analyzed using qualitative content analysis with double coding to support coding consistency. Quantitative and qualitative findings were integrated to provide a comprehensive understanding of program impacts. RESULTS: Participants reported high satisfaction and immediate personal benefits, including increased confidence (92%) and perceived preparedness to advocate (96%). At follow-up, participants reported increased comfort discussing hepatitis B (73%) and personal growth (73%), although findings should be interpreted cautiously due to the small sample size. Qualitative findings suggest that storytelling supported emotional processing, identity reframing, and increased willingness to disclose, while also contributing to perceived community awareness and engagement. CONCLUSIONS: The International Storytelling Program is a practical, promising approach for empowering individuals affected by hepatitis B and promoting advocacy and stigma reduction globally. However, results should be interpreted cautiously due to sample size and potential selection bias. Storytelling may serve as a complementary strategy to traditional public health approaches. TRIAL REGISTRATION: Not applicable.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review evaluates the Hepatitis B Foundation's International Storytelling Program, focusing on its impact on empowerment, advocacy, and stigma reduction among adults with hepatitis B across 22 countries, addressing the central question of whether storytelling can humanize disease experiences and promote public health engagement.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: A mixed-methods evaluation was conducted using immediate post-recording surveys (n=25), follow-up surveys 3-6 months later (n=11), and qualitative interviews with 15 participants from an eligible pool of storytellers spanning 22 countries. Survey instruments were developed by the study team and were not previously validated, and descriptive statistics were calculated. Qualitative data were analyzed using content analysis with double coding.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Participants reported high satisfaction and immediate benefits, including increased confidence (92%) and perceived preparedness to advocate (96%). At follow-up, 73% reported increased comfort discussing hepatitis B and personal growth, though these findings should be interpreted cautiously due to the small sample size. Qualitative findings indicate that storytelling supported emotional processing, identity reframing, and increased willingness to disclose, while contributing to perceived community awareness and engagement.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The small sample size (n=25 immediate, n=11 follow-up) and potential selection bias limit the generalizability of findings. Survey instruments were not previously validated, which may compromise measurement reliability and comparability across studies. The lack of a control group and absence of long-term follow-up data further constrain causal inference and sustained impact assessment.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Future research should prioritize larger, controlled studies with validated instruments to assess long-term impacts on stigma reduction, empowerment, and advocacy engagement. Program implementation should integrate standardized evaluation metrics to enable cross-study comparability and inform policy integration as a complementary public health strategy.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates the Hepatitis B Foundation's International Storytelling Program, assessing its impact on empowerment, advocacy, and stigma reduction among adults with hepatitis B across 22 countries. Using mixed-methods (surveys and qualitative interviews), the study reports high participant satisfaction and immediate benefits, including increased confidence (92%) and perceived advocacy preparedness (96%). Follow-up data (3-6 months) showed 73% reported increased comfort discussing hepatitis B and personal growth, though small sample sizes (n=25 immediate, n=11 follow-up) and selection bias limit generalizability. Qualitative findings highlight emotional processing, identity reframing, and perceived community engagement. Key gaps include unvalidated survey tools, lack of control groups, and no long-term follow-up. Future research should focus on larger, controlled studies with validated instruments to assess sustained impacts and inform policy integration.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该审查评估了乙型肝炎基金会的国际讲故事计划,重点关注其对 22 个国家的成人乙型肝炎患者的赋权、宣传和减少耻辱的影响,解决了讲故事是否可以使疾病体验人性化并促进公共卫生参与的核心问题。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 混合方法评估采用录音后立即调查 (n=25)、3-6 个月后的后续调查 (n=11) 以及对来自 22 个国家符合条件的讲故事者的 15 名参与者进行定性访谈进行。调查工具由研究团队开发,之前未经验证,并计算了描述性统计数据。使用双重编码的内容分析来分析定性数据。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 参与者报告了高满意度和直接收益,包括信心增强(92%)和感知准备倡导(96%)。在随访中,73% 的受访者表示在讨论乙型肝炎和个人成长时更加舒适,但由于样本量较小,应谨慎解释这些发现。定性研究结果表明,讲故事支持情感处理、身份重构和增加披露意愿,同时有助于提高社区意识和参与度。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 小样本量(n=25 立即,n=11 后续)和潜在的选择偏差限制了研究结果的普遍性。调查工具之前未经验证,这可能会影响测量的可靠性和研究之间的可比性。缺乏对照组和长期随访数据进一步限制了因果推断和持续影响评估。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 未来的研究应优先考虑使用经过验证的工具进行更大规模的对照研究,以评估对减少耻辱、赋权和倡导参与的长期影响。计划实施应整合标准化评估指标,以实现交叉研究的可比性,并为政策整合提供信息,作为补充性公共卫生战略。

abstract_zh: 背景:乙型肝炎仍然是全球主要的公共卫生挑战,其特点是认识低、诊断不足、获得护理的机会有限和持续存在耻辱。讲故事已成为一种很有前途的健康传播策略,可以使疾病体验人性化、减少耻辱并促进宣传。本研究评估了乙型肝炎基金会的国际讲故事计划及其对讲故事者的赋权、信心、耻辱经历和倡导参与的影响。方法:对通过该计划记录个人乙型肝炎故事的成年人进行了混合方法评估。通过立即进行录音后调查 (n = 25) 和 3-6 个月后的跟踪调查 (n = 11) 收集定量数据,评估满意度、情绪反应、信心、耻辱经历和宣传活动。调查工具是由研究团队开发的,之前未经验证,这可能会限制研究之间的测量可靠性和可比性。计算描述性统计数据。十五名参与者接受了定性访谈;这些人属于跨越 22 个国家的合格讲故事者群体的一部分。使用定性内容分析和双重编码来转录和分析访谈,以支持编码一致性。定量和定性研究结果相结合,以提供对计划影响的全面了解。结果:参与者报告了高满意度和直接的个人利益,包括信心增强 (92%) 和感知的倡导准备度 (96%)。在随访中,参与者报告说,讨论乙型肝炎 (73%) 和个人成长 (73%) 的舒适度有所提高,但由于样本量较小,应谨慎解释研究结果。定性研究结果表明,讲故事支持情感处理、身份重构和增加披露意愿,同时也有助于提高社区意识和参与度。结论:国际讲故事计划是一种实用且有前途的方法,可以增强乙型肝炎患者的权能,并在全球范围内促进宣传和减少耻辱。然而,由于样本量和潜在的选择偏差,应谨慎解释结果。讲故事可以作为传统公共卫生方法的补充策略。试用注册:不适用。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该审查评估了乙型肝炎基金会的国际讲故事计划,重点关注其对 22 个国家的成人乙型肝炎患者的赋权、宣传和减少耻辱的影响,解决了讲故事是否可以使疾病体验人性化并促进公共卫生参与的核心问题。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 混合方法评估采用录音后立即调查 (n=25)、3-6 个月后的后续调查 (n=11) 以及对来自 22 个国家符合条件的讲故事者的 15 名参与者进行定性访谈进行。调查工具由研究团队开发,之前未经验证,并计算了描述性统计数据。使用双重编码的内容分析来分析定性数据。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 参与者报告了高满意度和直接收益,包括信心增强(92%)和感知准备倡导(96%)。在随访中,73% 的受访者表示在讨论乙型肝炎和个人成长时更加舒适,但由于样本量较小,应谨慎解释这些发现。定性研究结果表明,讲故事支持情感处理、身份重构和增加披露意愿,同时有助于提高社区意识和参与度。

analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 未来的研究应优先考虑使用经过验证的工具进行更大规模的对照研究,以评估对减少耻辱、赋权和倡导参与的长期影响。计划实施应整合标准化评估指标,以实现交叉研究的可比性,并为政策整合提供信息,作为补充性公共卫生战略。

title: Hypovitaminosis D-Induced Secondary Hyperparathyroidism With Concomitant Femoral Fracture in a Chronic Hepatitis B Patient: A Case Report.
abstract: Vitamin D deficiency and secondary hyperparathyroidism (SHPT) are preventable causes of metabolic bone disease, yet they may remain clinically silent until catastrophic skeletal events occur. Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection has been increasingly linked to disordered bone and mineral metabolism, even in the absence of cirrhosis. We report a 39-year-old man with chronic HBV infection who presented with a low-trauma subtrochanteric femoral fracture. He had no history of alcohol or tobacco use and had only recently commenced antiviral therapy. Biochemical evaluation revealed severe vitamin D deficiency, markedly elevated parathyroid hormone levels, hypophosphatemia, and raised alkaline phosphatase, consistent with SHPT and metabolic bone disease. There was no clinical or radiological evidence of liver cirrhosis. The patient underwent surgical fixation of the fracture, received vitamin D supplementation, and was initiated on Tenofovir Alafenamide, with good clinical recovery.

title: Predictors of Incident High-Risk Varices in Patients with Hepatitis B-related Cirrhosis Receiving Nucleos(t)ide Analogue Therapy.
abstract: BACKGROUND: In patients receiving nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) therapy for chronic hepatitis B (CHB)-related cirrhosis, routine endoscopic surveillance may be deferred in the absence of high-risk varices (HRV). We aimed to identify predictors of incident HRV in this population. METHODS: This retrospective cohort study included patients with CHB-related cirrhosis who initiated NA therapy between March 2008 and June 2020 and were followed through May 2024. Eligible patients underwent baseline and on-treatment upper endoscopy. Patients with baseline HRV, prior variceal ligation, use of nonselective beta-blockers, other viral hepatitis, alcohol overuse, or malignancy were excluded. The cumulative incidence of HRV and adjusted subdistribution hazard ratios (aSHRs) were estimated using competing-risk methods. A point-based risk prediction model was derived from multivariable regression coefficients. RESULTS: Among the 110 included patients, 14 (12.7%) developed HRV over a median follow-up of 3.6 years (IQR, 2.0-5.6). In multivariable analysis, FIB-4 ≥4.0 (aSHR 9.77; 95% CI, 1.45-65.7), coexisting metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) (aSHR 6.37; 95% CI, 1.84-22.0), and albumin-bilirubin (ALBI) grade >1 (aSHR 3.02; 95% CI, 1.21-7.55) were independently associated with incident HRV and were assigned 3, 2 and 1 point, respectively, in the prediction model. At 3 years, the cumulative incidence of HRV was 1.5% (95% CI, 0-4.5) in the low-risk group (0-3 points) and 21.4% (95% CI, 8.0-34.8) in the high-risk group (4-6 points) (P=0.001). CONCLUSION: MASLD, FIB-4 and ALBI grade predict incident HRV in NA-treated CHB cirrhosis, enabling risk-stratified endoscopic surveillance.

title: Prevalence and Serological Profile of Occult Hepatitis B Virus Infection in Newly Diagnosed Cancer Patients.
abstract: BACKGROUND Occult hepatitis B virus infection (OBI) represents a diagnostic and clinical challenge, particularly among cancer patients who are at risk of viral reactivation during immunosuppressive therapy. Limited data are available from India on the prevalence and characteristics of OBI in malignancy. This study aimed to determine the prevalence and describe the serological profile of OBI among newly diagnosed cancer patients at a tertiary care hospital. MATERIALS & METHODS A cross-sectional study was conducted in 2023, including 100 newly diagnosed cancer patients prior to chemotherapy or radiotherapy. Serum samples negative for Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) were screened for HBV DNA using quantitative real-time PCR. Serological testing for IgM anti-HBc, Total anti-HBc and anti-HBs antibodies was performed on OBI-positive cases. Demographic and clinical variables were analyzed descriptively. RESULTS OBI was detected in 7% (7/100) of patients, with HBV DNA levels ranging from 79 to 64,533 IU/mL (mean: 10,823 IU/mL; median: 519 IU/mL). Among OBI-positive individuals, 42.8% were seropositive (anti-HBc and/or anti-HBs positive) and 57.1% were seronegative. CONCLUSION A 7% prevalence of OBI was observed among treatment-naïve cancer patients, with notably high HBV DNA levels compared to existing data. The presence of OBI in both vaccinated and seronegative individuals highlights the inadequacy of serology-based screening. Incorporating HBV DNA testing into routine pre-chemotherapy and radiation therapy screening is strongly recommended to prevent reactivation and improve safety in cancer management.

abstract_zh: 背景技术隐匿性乙型肝炎病毒感染(OBI)代表了诊断和临床挑战,特别是在免疫抑制治疗期间面临病毒再激活风险的癌症患者中。印度关于恶性肿瘤中 OBI 的患病率和特征的数据有限。本研究旨在确定三级医院新诊断癌症患者中 OBI 的患病率并描述其血清学特征。材料与方法 2023 年进行了一项横断面研究,包括 100 名化疗或放疗前新诊断的癌症患者。使用定量实时 PCR 对乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 阴性的血清样本进行 HBV DNA 筛查。对 OBI 阳性病例进行 IgM 抗 HBc、总抗 HBc 和抗 HBs 抗体的血清学检测。对人口统计学和临床​​变量进行了描述性分析。结果 7% (7/100) 的患者检测到 OBI,HBV DNA 水平范围为 79 至 64,533 IU/mL(平均值:10,823 IU/mL;中位数:519 IU/mL)。在 OBI 阳性个体中,42.8% 为血清阳性(抗 HBc 和/或抗 HBs 阳性),57.1% 为血清阴性。结论 在初治癌症患者中观察到 OBI 患病率为 7%,与现有数据相比,其 HBV DNA 水平明显较高。OBI 在接种疫苗和血清阴性个体中的存在凸显了基于血清学的筛查的不足。强烈建议将 HBV DNA 检测纳入常规化疗前和放疗筛查中,以防止病毒再激活并提高癌症治疗的安全性。

title: HBcAg-Induced IL-17F drives liver fibrosis in occult HBV infection
abstract: ABSTRACT While occult hepatitis B virus infection is a known risk factor for progressive liver diseases, the mechanistic basis for this association is poorly understood. To investigate this, we conducted a comparative study involving 40 OBI blood donors and 100 healthy blood donors to assess clinical parameters of liver fibrosis, including serum biomarkers, the FIB-4 index, and liver stiffness measurement. Transcriptome sequencing of peripheral blood mononuclear cells from these donors identified IL-17F as significantly upregulated in the OBI group. Mechanistically, we found that IL-17F was chiefly secreted by CD4 + T cells upon HBcAg stimulation and functionally promoted the expression of key fibrosis-related cytokines and markers. Collectively, our study unveils a novel pathway wherein HBcAg induces CD4 + T cells to secrete IL-17F, which in turn accelerates liver fibrogenesis, providing a mechanistic basis for OBI-associated liver disease. analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the mechanistic basis for occult hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection (OBI) driving liver fibrosis. A comparative analysis of 40 OBI blood donors and 100 healthy donors assessed liver fibrosis parameters and identified IL-17F as upregulated in OBI via transcriptome sequencing. Mechanistically, IL-17F was shown to be secreted by CD4+ T cells upon HBcAg stimulation and to promote fibrosis-related cytokine expression. The authors propose a novel pathway where HBcAg-induced IL-17F accelerates liver fibrogenesis, offering a mechanistic explanation for OBI-associated liver disease. This finding suggests potential for IL-17F-targeted diagnostics and therapies, though the abstract does not address study limitations or statistical robustness.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对 40 名隐匿性 HBV 感染 (OBI) 献血者和 100 名健康献血者进行了比较研究,以评估肝纤维化的临床参数。
elements_zh.methods: 对血清生物标志物、FIB-4 指数和肝脏硬度测量进行了评估,外周血单核细胞的转录组测序发现 IL-17F 在 OBI 组中显着上调。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这一发现阐明了 OBI 相关肝病进展的关键分子途径,并支持开发针对 IL-17F 的诊断和抗纤维化治疗策略。

title: Long-term incidence of hepatocellular carcinoma after hepatitis B surface antigen seroclearance.
abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) decreases following hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) seroclearance. We examined HCC incidence in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) who cleared HBsAg compared to general population. METHODS: All adults with CHB who cleared HBsAg between 2000-2022 were identified using a territory-wide database in Hong Kong. Annual HCC incidences were estimated and compared to general population. Age- and sex-specific population statistics were retrieved from the Hong Kong Cancer Registry and Census and Statistics Department. RESULTS: Of 13,379 patients with HBsAg seroclearance (mean age 59.7±13.7 years, 59.8% males, 14.6% cirrhosis), 274 (2.0%) developed HCC at a median of 5.6 (IQR 3.1-9.8) years. Annual HCC incidence (95% CI) was 0.43% (0.22%-0.73%) and 0.62% (0.50%-0.76%) among patients with cirrhosis aged <50 years and ≥50 years at HBsAg seroclearance, respectively. In patients without cirrhosis who cleared HBsAg before age 50, the annual HCC incidence was 0.03% (95% CI 0.01%-0.06%), comparable to 0.03% in general population. Annual HCC incidence of male patients without cirrhosis aged <40 and 40-49 years at HBsAg was 0.02% (95% CI 0.002%-0.08%) and 0.09% (0.03%-0.19%), respectively. No HCC cases occurred during 15 years of follow-up among 1,317 female patients without cirrhosis aged <50 years at HBsAg loss; the annual HCC incidence was 0.06% (95% CI 0.02%-0.13%) among those aged 50-59 years. CONCLUSIONS: Patients with CHB who clear HBsAg at younger ages, particularly men <40 years and women <50 years without cirrhosis or additional risk factors, have very low HCC risk and may not require routine surveillance.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a leading cause of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), but the long-term risk after hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) seroclearance is uncertain. The study addressed whether HBsAg seroclearance reduces HCC incidence and identified patient subgroups where surveillance may be unnecessary.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This territory-wide cohort study in Hong Kong identified all adults with CHB who achieved HBsAg seroclearance between 2000 and 2022 using a territory-wide database. The cohort included 13,379 patients (mean age 59.7±13.7 years, 59.8% male, 14.6% with cirrhosis) and compared HCC incidence to age- and sex-specific population statistics.
analysis.methods: HCC incidence was estimated annually and stratified by age, sex, cirrhosis status, and age at HBsAg seroclearance. Age- and sex-specific population data were retrieved from the Hong Kong Cancer Registry and Census and Statistics Department for comparison.
analysis.main_results: Among 13,379 patients, 274 (2.0%) developed HCC at a median of 5.6 years (IQR 3.1–9.8). Annual HCC incidence was 0.43% (95% CI 0.22%–0.73%) and 0.62% (95% CI 0.50%–0.76%) in patients with cirrhosis aged <50 and ≥50 years, respectively. In patients without cirrhosis, annual incidence was 0.03% (95% CI 0.01%–0.06%) for those <50 years, comparable to the general population.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study demonstrates that HBsAg seroclearance at younger ages, particularly in men <40 years and women <50 years without cirrhosis, is associated with very low HCC risk. This challenges the need for routine HCC surveillance in these subgroups, highlighting a novel stratification for clinical decision-making.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that HCC surveillance may be safely deferred in patients who clear HBsAg at a young age without cirrhosis, potentially reducing healthcare burden and improving quality of life. The results support risk-stratified surveillance strategies in post-seroclearance CHB management.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design, reliance on a territory-wide database, and lack of data on antiviral therapy prior to seroclearance. The evidence strength is moderate due to potential unmeasured confounding and generalizability limited to the Hong Kong population.

analysis.summary_en: This territory-wide cohort study in Hong Kong evaluated hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) incidence among 13,379 adults with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) who achieved hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) seroclearance between 2000 and 2022. Annual HCC incidence was 0.43% in patients with cirrhosis and 0.03% in those without cirrhosis aged under 50 years, comparable to the general population. No HCC cases occurred during 15 years of follow-up in 1,317 women without cirrhosis aged under 50 years. The authors conclude that patients who clear HBsAg at younger ages, particularly men under 40 and women under 50 without cirrhosis, have very low HCC risk and may not require routine surveillance. The study highlights a risk-stratified approach to HCC surveillance in post-seroclearance CHB management.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a leading cause of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), but the long-term risk after hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) seroclearance is uncertain. The study addressed whether HBsAg seroclearance reduces HCC incidence and identified patient subgroups where surveillance may be unnecessary.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This territory-wide cohort study in Hong Kong identified all adults with CHB who achieved HBsAg seroclearance between 2000 and 2022 using a territory-wide database. The cohort included 13,379 patients (mean age 59.7±13.7 years, 59.8% male, 14.6% with cirrhosis) and compared HCC incidence to age- and sex-specific population statistics.
analysis_en.methods: HCC incidence was estimated annually and stratified by age, sex, cirrhosis status, and age at HBsAg seroclearance. Age- and sex-specific population data were retrieved from the Hong Kong Cancer Registry and Census and Statistics Department for comparison.
analysis_en.main_results: Among 13,379 patients, 274 (2.0%) developed HCC at a median of 5.6 years (IQR 3.1–9.8). Annual HCC incidence was 0.43% (95% CI 0.22%–0.73%) and 0.62% (95% CI 0.50%–0.76%) in patients with cirrhosis aged <50 and ≥50 years, respectively. In patients without cirrhosis, annual incidence was 0.03% (95% CI 0.01%–0.06%) for those <50 years, comparable to the general population.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study demonstrates that HBsAg seroclearance at younger ages, particularly in men <40 years and women <50 years without cirrhosis, is associated with very low HCC risk. This challenges the need for routine HCC surveillance in these subgroups, highlighting a novel stratification for clinical decision-making.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that HCC surveillance may be safely deferred in patients who clear HBsAg at a young age without cirrhosis, potentially reducing healthcare burden and improving quality of life. The results support risk-stratified surveillance strategies in post-seroclearance CHB management.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design, reliance on a territory-wide database, and lack of data on antiviral therapy prior to seroclearance. The evidence strength is moderate due to potential unmeasured confounding and generalizability limited to the Hong Kong population.

title_zh: 乙型肝炎表面抗原血清清除后肝细胞癌的长期发病率。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) decreases following hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) seroclearance. We examined HCC incidence in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) who cleared HBsAg compared to general population. METHODS: All adults with CHB who cleared HBsAg between 2000-2022 were identified using a territory-wide database in Hong Kong. Annual HCC incidences were estimated and compared to general population. Age- and sex-specific population statistics were retrieved from the Hong Kong Cancer Registry and Census and Statistics Department. RESULTS: Of 13,379 patients with HBsAg seroclearance (mean age 59.7±13.7 years, 59.8% males, 14.6% cirrhosis), 274 (2.0%) developed HCC at a median of 5.6 (IQR 3.1-9.8) years. Annual HCC incidence (95% CI) was 0.43% (0.22%-0.73%) and 0.62% (0.50%-0.76%) among patients with cirrhosis aged <50 years and ≥50 years at HBsAg seroclearance, respectively. In patients without cirrhosis who cleared HBsAg before age 50, the annual HCC incidence was 0.03% (95% CI 0.01%-0.06%), comparable to 0.03% in general population. Annual HCC incidence of male patients without cirrhosis aged <40 and 40-49 years at HBsAg was 0.02% (95% CI 0.002%-0.08%) and 0.09% (0.03%-0.19%), respectively. No HCC cases occurred during 15 years of follow-up among 1,317 female patients without cirrhosis aged <50 years at HBsAg loss; the annual HCC incidence was 0.06% (95% CI 0.02%-0.13%) among those aged 50-59 years. CONCLUSIONS: Patients with CHB who clear HBsAg at younger ages, particularly men <40 years and women <50 years without cirrhosis or additional risk factors, have very low HCC risk and may not require routine surveillance.
abstract_zh: 背景和目的:乙型肝炎表面抗原(HBsAg)血清清除后,肝细胞癌(HCC)的风险降低。我们比较了清除 HBsAg 的慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者与普通人群的 HCC 发病率。方法:使用香港全港数据库对 2000 年至 2022 年期间清除 HBsAg 的所有慢性乙型肝炎成人进行识别。估算年度 HCC 发病率并与一般人群进行比较。特定年龄和性别的人口统计数据取自香港癌症登记处和政府统计处。结果:在 13,379 名 HBsAg 血清清除患者中(平均年龄 59.7±13.7 岁,59.8% 男性,14.6% 肝硬化),274 名 (2.0%) 患者在中位 5.6 (IQR 3.1-9.8) 岁时发展为 HCC。HBsAg 血清清除时年龄<50 岁和≥50 岁的肝硬化患者的年 HCC 发病率 (95% CI) 分别为 0.43% (0.22%-0.73%) 和 0.62% (0.50%-0.76%)。在 50 岁之前清除 HBsAg 的无肝硬化患者中,年 HCC 发病率为 0.03%(95% CI 0.01%-0.06%),与普通人群的 0.03% 相当。HBsAg 检测结果显示,年龄 <40 岁和 40-49 岁的无肝硬化男性患者的 HCC 年发病率分别为 0.02%(95% CI 0.002%-0.08%)和 0.09%(0.03%-0.19%)。对 1,317 名年龄 <50 岁且 HBsAg 消失的无肝硬化女性患者进行 15 年随访期间,没有发生 HCC 病例;50-59岁人群中HCC年发病率为0.06%(95% CI 0.02%-0.13%)。结论:在较年轻时清除 HBsAg 的慢性乙型肝炎患者,特别是没有肝硬化或其他危险因素的 40 岁以下男性和 50 岁以下女性,HCC 风险非常低,可能不需要常规监测。

title: Isolated HBc IgM false reactivity in the absence of acute Hepatitis B: a case report
abstract: Abstract Serological markers and their possible combinations are still used for diagnosis, to distinguish between acute and chronic infection, and to assess therapy efficacy, in association with molecular hepatitis B viremia levels. Isolated HBc IgM seropositivity is a distinctive serological pattern that warrants further investigation. We present a 28-year-old male case with a recent diagnosis of multiple sclerosis, for which in-depth analyses have been carried out. The patient’s laboratory testing showed positivity only for HBc IgM. Therefore, a complete hepatitis B serological panel was performed, confirming the first unexpected result. Hepatitis B viremia was undetectable. The sample was also analyzed using another commercial assay, which yielded a negative HBc IgM result. The presence of heterophile antibodies was suspected; therefore, a heterophilic blocking tube was used. The results after the serum’s treatment confirmed that the initial HBc IgM positivity was a false-positive result, attributed to heterophile antibodies. This case report highlights the importance of clinical and laboratory interpretation of hepatitis B markers for accurate diagnosis.
