title: High Rates of Advanced Chronic Liver Disease in Patients With Chronic Hepatitis D Virus Infection in Uzbekistan.
abstract: ABSTRACT Background and Aims Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is endemic in Uzbekistan. Previous data showed a high prevalence of anti‐hepatitis D virus (HDV) antibodies in HBsAg‐positive individuals. Limited data are available on disease severity, treatment availability and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) prevalence in patients with chronic HDV infection in Uzbekistan. Methods The Scientific Research Institute of Virology (SRIoV) is the leading medical and scientific reference centre for viral hepatitis in Uzbekistan. In this retrospective study, epidemiological, clinical and laboratory data were collected and analysed from all HBsAg‐positive patients presenting to the SRIoV between June 2023 and May 2024. Data from HDV‐coinfected and HBV‐monoinfected patients were compared. Results Data of 1393 individual patients were included. HDV coinfection was more prevalent than HBV‐monoinfection (73.9% [ n = 1030/1393]) vs. 26.1% [ n = 363/1393]. HDV‐infected patients were significantly younger (41.9 vs. 45.4, p p n = 4/1030). Consecutively, HDV RNA was detectable in 78.9% (812/1023) of patients. Quantitative HDV RNA was independently associated with ALT elevation > upper limit of normal. The HCC detection rate was low in both patient groups due to insufficient screening measures (HDV: n = 7/1030, HBV: n = 11/363). Conclusions In this retrospective cohort of 1393 individual patients, HDV coinfection exceeds HBV monoinfection in prevalence and disease severity. Most HDV‐infected patients present with advanced liver disease and currently lack access to HDV‐directed therapy.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis D virus (HDV) infection is a neglected public-health problem in Uzbekistan where HBV is endemic, yet disease severity, treatment access and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) prevalence in HDV-coinfected patients remain poorly documented.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective cohort study was conducted at the Scientific Research Institute of Virology (SRIoV), the national reference centre for viral hepatitis in Uzbekistan, enrolling all HBsAg-positive patients presenting between June 2023 and May 2024.
analysis.methods: Epidemiological, clinical and laboratory data were collected and analysed; HDV-coinfected and HBV-monoinfected patients were compared, and HDV RNA was quantified with association to ALT elevation assessed.
analysis.main_results: Among 1393 patients, HDV coinfection was more prevalent than HBV monoinfection (73.9% [1030/1393] vs 26.1% [363/1393]); HDV-infected patients were younger (41.9 vs 45.4 years), HDV RNA was detectable in 78.9% (812/1023), and HDV RNA was independently associated with ALT elevation > ULN.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors conclude that HDV coinfection exceeds HBV monoinfection in prevalence and disease severity in Uzbekistan, highlighting advanced liver disease at presentation and lack of HDV-directed therapy access as novel findings.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings underscore an urgent need for improved HDV screening, HCC surveillance and access to HDV-specific antiviral therapy in Uzbekistan.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The retrospective single-centre design, low HCC detection due to insufficient screening and absence of HDV-directed therapy data limit causal inference and generalisability, warranting a moderate confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study at Uzbekistan’s national viral hepatitis reference centre assessed 1393 HBsAg-positive patients presenting from June 2023 to May 2024 to compare HDV-coinfected and HBV-monoinfected individuals. HDV coinfection was far more prevalent (73.9%) than HBV monoinfection (26.1%), with HDV-infected patients younger and most showing detectable HDV RNA (78.9%), which was independently associated with elevated ALT. The authors interpret these data as evidence that HDV coinfection predominates and is associated with greater disease severity in Uzbekistan, noting that most HDV-infected patients present with advanced liver disease and lack access to HDV-directed therapy. The study highlights critical gaps in screening and treatment access and calls for strengthened HDV surveillance and care.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,在乌兹别克斯坦,丁型肝炎病毒合并感染的患病率和疾病严重程度超过了乙型肝炎病毒单一感染,这突显了目前出现的晚期肝病和缺乏针对丁型肝炎病毒的治疗方法是新发现。

title_zh: 乌兹别克斯坦慢性丁型肝炎病毒感染患者的晚期慢性肝病发病率很高。
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Background and Aims Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is endemic in Uzbekistan. Previous data showed a high prevalence of anti‐hepatitis D virus (HDV) antibodies in HBsAg‐positive individuals. Limited data are available on disease severity, treatment availability and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) prevalence in patients with chronic HDV infection in Uzbekistan. Methods The Scientific Research Institute of Virology (SRIoV) is the leading medical and scientific reference centre for viral hepatitis in Uzbekistan. In this retrospective study, epidemiological, clinical and laboratory data were collected and analysed from all HBsAg‐positive patients presenting to the SRIoV between June 2023 and May 2024. Data from HDV‐coinfected and HBV‐monoinfected patients were compared. Results Data of 1393 individual patients were included. HDV coinfection was more prevalent than HBV‐monoinfection (73.9% [ n = 1030/1393]) vs. 26.1% [ n = 363/1393]. HDV‐infected patients were significantly younger (41.9 vs. 45.4, p p n = 4/1030). Consecutively, HDV RNA was detectable in 78.9% (812/1023) of patients. Quantitative HDV RNA was independently associated with ALT elevation > upper limit of normal. The HCC detection rate was low in both patient groups due to insufficient screening measures (HDV: n = 7/1030, HBV: n = 11/363). Most HDV‐infected patients present with advanced liver disease and currently lack access to HDV‐directed therapy.
abstract_zh: 摘要 背景和目的 慢性乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染在乌兹别克斯坦流行。先前的数据显示,HBsAg 阳性个体中抗丁型肝炎病毒 (HDV) 抗体的患病率很高。关于乌兹别克斯坦慢性 HDV 感染患者的疾病严重程度、治疗可用性和肝细胞癌 (HCC) 患病率的数据有限。方法 病毒学科学研究所 (SRIOV) 是乌兹别克斯坦领先的病毒性肝炎医学和科学参考中心。在这项回顾性研究中,收集并分析了 2023 年 6 月至 2024 年 5 月期间所有就诊于 SRIoV 的 HBsAg 阳性患者的流行病学、临床和实验室数据。比较了 HDV 合并感染和 HBV 单一感染患者的数据。结果 纳入 1393 名患者的数据。HDV 合并感染比 HBV 单一感染更为普遍 (73.9% [ n = 1030/1393]) vs. 26.1% [ n = 363/1393]。HDV 感染患者明显更年轻(41.9 vs. 45.4,p p n = 4/1030)。连续地,78.9% (812/1023) 的患者可检测到 HDV RNA。HDV RNA 定量与 ALT 升高>正常上限独立相关。由于筛查措施不足,两个患者组的 HCC 检出率均较低(HDV:n = 7/1030,HBV:n = 11/363)。结论 在这个由 1393 名患者组成的回顾性队列中,HDV 合并感染的患病率和疾病严重程度超过了 HBV 单一感染。大多数丁型肝炎病毒感染患者均患有晚期肝病,目前缺乏针对丁型肝炎病毒的治疗。

title: NGS-diagnosed HBV encephalitis with isolated left parietal lobe involvement: a case report.
abstract: Abstract Background Viral encephalitis refers to the inflammation of the brain parenchyma caused by viral infection, usually manifested as fever, unconsciousness, seizures, and meningeal irritation symptoms. The non-specific clinical manifestations, combined with incomplete medical history, often lead to missed diagnoses and inappropriate treatments. Case presentation We present a case of Hepatitis B virus (HBV) encephalitis, manifesting as isolated left parietal lobe involvement. The patient is a chronic hepatitis B virus carrier who did not receive antiviral therapy. Upon onset, the main symptoms were unconsciousness, fever, and seizures. He was diagnosed with HBV encephalitis thru next-generation sequencing (NGS) testing of the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). After antiviral treatment with entecavir and general symptomatic treatment, the patient’s clinical symptoms disappeared, and a follow-up brain MRI showed that the lesion had almost completely resolved. Conclusions Central nervous system (CNS) infections caused by HBV are incredibly uncommon in clinical practice. This case highlights that the clinical manifestations of HBV encephalitis are nonspecific and prone to being missed, while neuroimaging often reveals an isolated lesion. Early application of NGS for accurate pathogen diagnosis is crucial to reduce misdiagnosis.

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景病毒性脑炎是指病毒感染引起的脑实质炎症,通常表现为发热、神志不清、癫痫发作和脑膜刺激症状。临床表现的非特异性,加上病史不完整,常常导致漏诊和不适当的治疗。病例介绍 我们介绍一例乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 脑炎病例,表现为孤立的左顶叶受累。患者为慢性乙型肝炎病毒携带者,未接受抗病毒治疗。发病时主要症状为意识不清、发烧和癫痫发作。通过脑脊液(CSF)的下一代测序(NGS)检测,他被诊断患有乙型肝炎脑炎。经过恩替卡韦抗病毒治疗和一般对症治疗后,患者的临床症状消失,后续脑部MRI显示病变几乎完全消退。结论 HBV 引起的中枢神经系统 (CNS) 感染在临床实践中极为罕见。该病例凸显乙型肝炎脑炎的临床表现非特异性且容易被漏诊,而神经影像学往往显示孤立性病变。早期应用NGS进行准确的病原诊断对于减少误诊至关重要。

title: Viral Hepatitis B in the Kyrgyz Republic: Epidemiological Trends and the Role of Vaccination (Literature Review)
abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major public health problem in the Kyrgyz Republic, contributing significantly to the burden of chronic liver diseases, including cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. The aim of this study was to assess the epidemiological trends of HBV infection and evaluate the impact of vaccination on disease patterns. A systematic review of scientific publications (2015–2023), WHO reports, and national regulatory documents was conducted. The results demonstrate that the introduction of neonatal vaccination has led to a substantial decline in acute HBV incidence and the near elimination of infection among children. However, a high prevalence of chronic HBV persists among adults, particularly in cohorts born before the implementation of universal immunization. Regional disparities in vaccination coverage and incomplete vaccination schedules were also identified. The current epidemiological pattern is characterized by a shift of the disease burden toward adult populations. Achieving WHO elimination targets by 2030 requires the expansion of adult vaccination programs, strengthening epidemiological surveillance, and the integration of vaccination and disease monitoring systems.

abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染仍然是吉尔吉斯共和国的一个主要公共卫生问题,严重加重慢性肝病的负担,包括肝硬化和肝细胞癌。本研究的目的是评估乙型肝炎病毒感染的流行病学趋势并评估疫苗接种对疾病模式的影响。对科学出版物(2015-2023)、世卫组织报告和国家监管文件进行了系统审查。结果表明,新生儿疫苗接种的引入导致急性乙型肝炎发病率大幅下降,儿童感染几乎消除。然而,成人中慢性乙型肝炎的患病率仍然很高,特别是在实施全民免疫接种之前出生的人群中。还发现了疫苗接种覆盖率的地区差异和不完整的疫苗接种计划。当前流行病学模式的特点是疾病负担向成年人群转移。到2030年实现世卫组织消除目标需要扩大成人疫苗接种规划、加强流行病学监测以及疫苗接种和疾病监测系统的整合。

title: Supramolecular Self-Assembly of Lycorine with Glycyrrhizic Acid into a Nanodrug for Safe and Sustained Anti-HBV Therapy.
abstract: Achieving a functional cure for chronic hepatitis B remains a major challenge, as conventional therapies struggle to eliminate the hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) and subsequently restore adaptive antiviral immunity. Lycorine (LY), a compound with broad-spectrum antiviral activity, has shown particular promise inhibiting HBsAg secretion. However, its clinical application is severely limited by significant cytotoxicity, the induction of apoptosis, a short half-life, and adverse in vivo effects. To overcome these barriers and enhance its therapeutic potential, we designed a self-assembled nanomedicine (LGN) by co-assembling LY with glycyrrhizic acid, a natural anti-HBV agent. This strategy not only protected LY from premature degradation and enabled its sustained release in the colon but also markedly attenuated LY-induced systemic toxicity. Notably, LGN effectively suppressed HBsAg secretion (IC50 = 2.15 ± 0.09 μM) with a selectivity index (SI > 93) over two-fold higher than that of LY alone (SI = 39.26). Furthermore, LGN concurrently inhibited HBV DNA replication, pgRNA transcription, and the expression of viral protein HBc and HBx, indicating a multitargeted, host-dependent mechanism distinct from nucleos(t)ide analogs. Treatment with this nanomedicine in the HDI model further demonstrated its therapeutic potential against HBV with apparent safety. Further transcriptomic study confirmed that LGN induces a distinct host transcriptional program that disrupts multiple critical stages of the HBV life cycle including viral entry, covalently closed circular DNA maintenance, gene transcription, and immune evasion. Collectively, these findings provide valuable insights into exploiting natural products like LY for antiviral therapy and underscore the potential of self-assembly technology in improving drug safety and pharmacokinetic profiles.

title_zh: 石蒜碱与甘草酸超分子自组装成纳米药物,用于安全、持续的抗乙肝治疗。
source_body_en: Achieving a functional cure for chronic hepatitis B remains a major challenge, as conventional therapies struggle to eliminate the hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) and subsequently restore adaptive antiviral immunity. Lycorine (LY), a compound with broad-spectrum antiviral activity, has shown particular promise inhibiting HBsAg secretion. However, its clinical application is severely limited by significant cytotoxicity, the induction of apoptosis, a short half-life, and adverse in vivo effects. To overcome these barriers and enhance its therapeutic potential, we designed a self-assembled nanomedicine (LGN) by co-assembling LY with glycyrrhizic acid, a natural anti-HBV agent. This strategy not only protected LY from premature degradation and enabled its sustained release in the colon but also markedly attenuated LY-induced systemic toxicity. Notably, LGN effectively suppressed HBsAg secretion (IC50 = 2.15 ± 0.09 μM) with a selectivity index (SI > 93) over two-fold higher than that of LY alone (SI = 39.26). Furthermore, LGN concurrently inhibited HBV DNA replication, pgRNA transcription, and the expression of viral protein HBc and HBx, indicating a multitargeted, host-dependent mechanism distinct from nucleos(t)ide analogs. Treatment with this nanomedicine in the HDI model further demonstrated its therapeutic potential against HBV with apparent safety. Further transcriptomic study confirmed that LGN induces a distinct host transcriptional program that disrupts multiple critical stages of the HBV life cycle including viral entry, covalently closed circular DNA maintenance, gene transcription, and immune evasion. Collectively, these findings provide valuable insights into exploiting natural products like LY for antiviral therapy and underscore the potential of self-assembly technology in improving drug safety and pharmacokinetic profiles.
abstract_zh: 实现慢性乙型肝炎的功能性治愈仍然是一个重大挑战,因为传统疗法难以消除乙型肝炎表面抗原(HBsAg)并随后恢复适应性抗病毒免疫。Lycorine (LY) 是一种具有广谱抗病毒活性的化合物,在抑制 HBsAg 分泌方面表现出特别的前景。然而,其临床应用因显着的细胞毒性、诱导细胞凋亡、半衰期短和体内不良反应而受到严重限制。为了克服这些障碍并增强其治疗潜力,我们通过将 LY 与天然抗 HBV 药物甘草酸共组装来设计了一种自组装纳米药物 (LGN)。这种策略不仅可以保护 LY 免于过早降解并使其能够在结肠中持续释放,而且还可以显着减弱 LY 引起的全身毒性。值得注意的是,LGN 有效抑制 HBsAg 分泌 (IC50 = 2.15 ± 0.09 μM),其选择性指数 (SI > 93) 比单独 LY (SI = 39.26) 高出两倍多。此外,LGN 同时抑制 HBV DNA 复制、pgRNA 转录以及病毒蛋白 HBc 和 HBx 的表达,表明与核苷(酸)类似物不同的多靶点、宿主依赖性机制。在 HDI 模型中使用这种纳米药物进行治疗进一步证明了其针对 HBV 的治疗潜力且具有明显的安全性。进一步的转录组学研究证实,LGN 诱导独特的宿主转录程序,破坏 HBV 生命周期的多个关键阶段,包括病毒进入、共价闭合环状 DNA 维持、基因转录和免疫逃避。总的来说,这些发现为利用 LY 等天然产物进行抗病毒治疗提供了宝贵的见解,并强调了自组装技术在改善药物安全性和药代动力学特征方面的潜力。

title: B/F/TAF in people with both HIV-1 and hepatitis B: outcomes from the ALLIANCE open-label extension phase.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Data on bictegravir/emtricitabine/tenofovir alafenamide (B/F/TAF) in people with both HIV-1 and HBV are limited, particularly for treatment-experienced people. METHODS: ALLIANCE was a randomized, double-blind, active-controlled, phase 3 study of B/F/TAF versus dolutegravir (DTG) + emtricitabine/tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (F/TDF) in treatment-naïve adults with HIV-1 RNA ≥ 500 copies/mL and HBV DNA ≥ 2000 IU/mL. Participants received continuous B/F/TAF through 144 weeks (≥ 96 weeks of blinded treatment plus 48-week optional open-label extension [OLE]) or switched to B/F/TAF after ≥ 96 weeks of DTG + F/TDF through 48 weeks of OLE. Here we report outcomes from the OLE. RESULTS: 121 participants were included in the continuous B/F/TAF group; 89 in the switch group. Median B/F/TAF exposure was 186.4 and 48 weeks, respectively. HIV-1 and HBV suppression rates (missing = excluded) were maintained in both groups (B/F/TAF Week 144: 99.0% and 80.2%; switch OLE Week 48: 95.4% and 86.6%, respectively). Both groups had improved alanine aminotransferase normalization. HBV envelope antigen loss and seroconversion occurred in 44.8% and 29.3%, respectively, of participants receiving continuous B/F/TAF (Week 144) and 17.0% and 12.8% in the switch group (OLE Week 48). HBV surface antigen loss and seroconversion occurred in 22.5% and 15.5% (continuous B/F/TAF), and 4.3% and 0% (switch group) of participants, respectively. One participant (continuous B/F/TAF) discontinued due to study drug-unrelated treatment-emergent adverse event. No treatment-emergent resistance was reported. CONCLUSION: B/F/TAF was effective in HIV-1 and HBV suppression and well tolerated in treatment-naïve individuals for ≤ 3 years and ≤ 1 year after switching from a TDF-based regimen. Trial registration ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03547908 (first registration 2018-05-24).

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the outcomes of bictegravir/emtricitabine/tenofovir alafenamide (B/F/TAF) in people with both HIV-1 and hepatitis B, focusing on treatment-naïve individuals and those who switched from a TDF-based regimen. The ALLIANCE open-label extension phase included 210 participants, with 121 receiving continuous B/F/TAF and 89 switching from DTG + F/TDF. HIV-1 and HBV suppression rates were maintained in both groups, with no treatment-emergent resistance reported. HBV envelope and surface antigen loss and seroconversion were observed in a significant proportion of participants, particularly in the continuous B/F/TAF group. The study demonstrates the efficacy and tolerability of B/F/TAF for up to 3 years of continuous use and 1 year after switching from a TDF-based regimen, providing valuable insights for managing co-infection.

analysis_zh.main_results: 121名参与者被纳入连续B/F/TAF组;开关组89。HIV-1 和 HBV 抑制率保持不变(B/F/TAF 第 144 周:99.0% 和 80.2%;转换 OLE 第 48 周:95.4% 和 86.6%)。HBV 包膜抗原丢失和血清转化发生率分别为 44.8% 和 29.3%(连续 B/F/TAF)以及 17.0% 和 12.8%(转换组)。HBV 表面抗原丢失和血清转化发生率分别为 22.5% 和 15.5%(连续 B/F/TAF)以及 4.3% 和 0%(转换组)。没有报告出现治疗耐药。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: B/F/TAF 可有效抑制 HIV-1 和 HBV,并且在未接受治疗的个体中耐受性良好,耐受性良好,持续时间为 ≤ 3 年,从基于 TDF 的方案转换后≤ 1 年。该研究提供了有关该人群中 HBV 包膜和表面抗原丢失以及血清转化的新数据。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持使用 B/F/TAF 来维持 HIV-1 和 HBV 抑制并改善初治和既往治疗个体的肝酶正常化。乙型肝炎病毒抗原丢失和血清转化的数据可以为合并感染患者的长期管理策略提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于开放标签扩展,样本量相对较小(210 名受试者),并且转换组的随访期较短(48 周)。由于缺乏长期数据且 OLE 阶段缺乏对照组,证据强度中等。

title: Longitudinal Patterns of Chronic Hepatitis B Care and Treatment Adherence in Australia: A National Linked Data Cohort Study.
abstract: Current uptake of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) treatment and care in Australia is well below target levels, leading to an ongoing burden of preventable liver disease and cancer. Understanding individual-level trajectories of care engagement and variation by sociodemographic factors is essential to guide efforts to improve access to and retention in care. This study analysed records of hepatitis B viral load (VL) testing and antiviral treatment provided through Australia's national health insurance system, which were linked to migration, death, and sociodemographic data from various government datasets. Treatment and VL testing by population group were assessed, and uptake was calculated using modelled estimates of the number living with CHB. VL testing frequency and treatment adherence based on scripts dispensed were also assessed. Of the estimated 219,800 people living with CHB in Australia in 2023, 118,334 (53.8%) received either VL testing or treatment during 2014-2023. Estimated uptake of VL testing and treatment uptake were lower among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and also varied by region of birth. Of the 81,360 who received any VL testing, only 17,352 (21.3%) received it regularly, while 31,715 (39.0%) had evidence of prior monitoring but no VL testing since 2019. The majority of those who initiated treatment continued therapy and received supply sufficient for adherence. This study shows that substantial gaps exist in CHB care in Australia, particularly in continued monitoring among those not on treatment. Disparities in uptake are evident by priority population. Re-engaging those lost to follow-up should be prioritised.

title: Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk Between Untreated Immune Tolerant Vs. Treated Immune Active Chronic Hepatitis B Patients.
abstract: The risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) between chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients in the untreated immune tolerant (U-IT) vs. treated immune active (T-IA) phases is not clear, and most data are in Asian populations. We aim to evaluate long-term risks of cirrhosis, HCC, and overall mortality between U-IT vs. T-IA CHB patients among a national cohort of U.S. We conducted a propensity score weighted analysis of Veterans with CHB who met criteria for U-IT or T-IA from 1/1/2010 to 12/31/2021 (with follow-up through 12/31/2024). Incidence of cirrhosis, HCC, or death were compared between U-IT and T-IA groups. A total of 591 U-IT and 555 T-IA CHB patients were identified (mean age 56.4-57.5 years, 45%-50% non-Hispanic white, 37%-40% African American, 9%-10% Asian, 25%-29% concurrent diabetes, 35%-39% with FIB-4 > 3.25). Over a median follow up of 6.4 years (IQR 3.0-10.4), incidence of HCC was significantly lower in U-IT patients vs. T-IA patients (0.28 vs. 0.54 per 100 person-years; HR 0.52, 95% CI 0.32-0.83, p = 0.007). However, the risk of cirrhosis or all-cause mortality was similar between both T-IA and U-IT CHB patients. Among a predominantly non-Asian cohort of adults with CHB, we observed that HCC risk was lower in U-IT patients compared to T-IA patients. While this contrasts with some studies in Asian countries, these data do emphasize the importance of prioritizing and ensuring timely therapy for CHB patients in the IA phase. However, routine treatment in IT patients remains controversial and more data are needed to better understand long-term outcomes.

title: Programmable Nanobody-Targeting Chimeras Enable Intracellular Viral Protein Degradation.
abstract: ABSTRACT Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major global health challenge, largely because current antiviral therapies seldom achieve sustained clearance of the viral surface antigen (HBsAg), a central driver of immune tolerance and viral persistence. Here, we present a programmable, nanobody‐based targeted protein degradation platform, termed Nanobody‐Targeting Chimera (Nab‐TAC), designed for the intracellular clearance of HBV antigens. To systematically identify functional degradation modules, we developed a split‐luciferase complementation‐based quantitative screening platform that benchmarks degron motifs and proximity‐inducing effectors, enabling comprehensive ranking of proteasome‐ and lysosome‐targeting elements across diverse cellular contexts and subcellular compartments. By coupling phage display‐derived nanobodies and single‐chain variable fragments with these optimized degradation modules, we engineered a panel of Nab‐TAC constructs that efficiently degrade viral HBsAg in hepatocytes. Notably, the lead construct, E3‐FCGR3B, achieved robust intrahepatic antigen clearance and markedly reduced circulating HBsAg levels in an HBV hydrodynamic injection mouse model. Together, these findings establish Nab‐TAC as a modular and versatile platform for targeted antiviral protein degradation and highlight its potential as a therapeutic strategy toward a functional cure for chronic HBV infection.

source_records.abstract: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major global health challenge, largely because current antiviral therapies seldom achieve sustained clearance of the viral surface antigen (HBsAg), a central driver of immune tolerance and viral persistence. Here, we present a programmable, nanobody-based targeted protein degradation platform, termed Nanobody-Targeting Chimera (Nab-TAC), designed for the intracellular clearance of HBV antigens. To systematically identify functional degradation modules, we developed a split-luciferase complementation-based quantitative screening platform that benchmarks degron motifs and proximity-inducing effectors, enabling comprehensive ranking of proteasome- and lysosome-targeting elements across diverse cellular contexts and subcellular compartments. By coupling phage display-derived nanobodies and single-chain variable fragments with these optimized degradation modules, we engineered a panel of Nab-TAC constructs that efficiently degrade viral HBsAg in hepatocytes. Notably, the lead construct, E3-FCGR3B, achieved robust intrahepatic antigen clearance and markedly reduced circulating HBsAg levels in an HBV hydrodynamic injection mouse model. Together, these findings establish Nab-TAC as a modular and versatile platform for targeted antiviral protein degradation and highlight its potential as a therapeutic strategy toward a functional cure for chronic HBV infection.

abstract_zh: 摘要:慢性乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染仍然是全球主要的健康挑战,很大程度上是因为当前的抗病毒治疗很少实现病毒表面抗原 (HBsAg) 的持续清除,而病毒表面抗原 (HBsAg) 是免疫耐受和病毒持久性的核心驱动因素。在这里,我们提出了一个可编程的、基于纳米抗体的靶向蛋白质降解平台,称为纳米抗体靶向嵌合体(Nab-TAC),专为乙型肝炎病毒抗原的细胞内清除而设计。为了系统地识别功能降解模块,我们开发了一个基于分裂荧光素酶互补的定量筛选平台,该平台以降解决定子基序和邻近诱导效应子为基准,从而能够对不同细胞环境和亚细胞区室中的蛋白酶体和溶酶体靶向元件进行全面排名。通过将噬菌体展示衍生的纳米抗体和单链可变片段与这些优化的降解模块耦合,我们设计了一组 Nab-TAC 构建体,可以有效降解肝细胞中的病毒 HBsAg。值得注意的是,在 HBV 水动力注射小鼠模型中,先导构建体 E3-FCGR3B 实现了强大的肝内抗原清除并显着降低了循环 HBsAg 水平。总之,这些发现确立了 Nab-TAC 作为靶向抗病毒蛋白降解的模块化和多功能平台,并强调了其作为慢性 HBV 感染功能性治愈的治疗策略的潜力。

title: Droplet Digital PCR Measurement of HBV DNA in On-Treatment Chronic HBV Patients: Association With HCC Development and Outcomes.
abstract: Low-level residual viremia can be present in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients on nucleos(t)ide analogues (NUCs). Due to the detection limits of current HBV DNA assays, the association between residual viremia and HBV-related HCC has not been well studied. This study included NUC-treated HBV-related HCC patients with unquantifiable serum HBV DNA by the conventional Cobas-Taqman assay (< 20 IU/mL) at HCC diagnosis. The HCC patients were matched in a 1:1 ratio with NUC-treated non-HCC controls. Serum samples at the time of HCC diagnosis, 1 year before, and 2 years before diagnosis were retrospectively retrieved and tested for residual viremia by a validated high-sensitivity droplet digital polymerase chain reaction assay (lower limit of detection 1.6 IU/mL). Among 208 patients (104 HCC vs. 104 controls; mean age 63.1, 80.8% male, 54.3% cirrhosis), residual viremia within 2 years was observed in 82.7% of HCC patients and 49.0% of controls (p < 0.001), and was independently associated with HCC occurrence (OR 7.243, 95% CI 1.862-28.170, p = 0.004). In HCC patients, residual viremia was associated with histological microvascular invasion (44.4% vs. 9.1% in patients without residual viremia, p = 0.033) and lower probability of presenting with Barcelona Clinic Liver Cancer stage 0 HCC (OR 0.281, 95% CI 0.094-0.838, p = 0.023). After median follow-up for 7.2 years, residual viremia within 2 years before HCC diagnosis was independently associated with liver-related mortality (HR 4.472, 95% CI 1.212-16.504, p = 0.025). Residual viremia in NUC-treated CHB patients is associated with a higher risk of HCC development, more advanced tumour staging and poorer outcomes. High-sensitivity HBV DNA assays may be utilized for monitoring in NUC treatment.

title: Bridging Gaps in Hepatitis B Virus Prevention: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Knowledge, Attitudes and Preventive Practices in Ethiopia.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection continues to pose a significant global health challenge, with prevention efforts heavily dependent on individuals' knowledge, attitudes, and practices. Recognizing the critical role of comprehensive data in shaping policy, we sought to pool estimates from primary studies conducted across various regions of Ethiopia. METHODS: Full text studies published in English from December 31st 2010 to May 31st, 2025 were identified through searches in the PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, African Journals Online, Google Scholar, and Scopus databases using the medical subject headings and text words. The protocol was registered in the PROSPERO and the results were reported accordance with the PRISMA 2020. The heterogeneity was evaluated graphically and using statistical methods. Publication bias was assessed with a funnel plot and Egger's regression (significant at P ≤ 0.05). A random-effects meta-analysis was performed to calculate the pooled estimates. RESULTS: The search identified 980 records and 26 studies met the eligibility criteria and were included. The pooled prevalence of a good level of knowledge, favorable attitudes, and good prevention practices was 47.45% (95% confidence interval (CI) 36.53, 58.36), 50.48% (95% CI 38.65, 62.30), and 36.22% (95% CI 27.22, 45.23), respectively. In the subgroup analysis, a good level of knowledge among barbers was only 11.14% (95% CI 8.55-13.74). Being a rural resident (pooled odds ratio (pOR) = 2.25, 95% CI 1.39, 3.63), illiterate (pOR = 2.22, 95% CI 1.30, 3.76), having poor knowledge (pOR = 2.13, 95% CI 1.56, 2.91), and having unfavorable attitudes (pOR = 3.56, 95% CI 1.17, 10.81) were significantly associated with poor HBV prevention practices. CONCLUSIONS AND RECOMMENDATIONS: The results revealed elevated gaps in knowledge, attitudes, and practices related to the prevention of HBV infection. These results highlight the urgent need to strengthen public awareness campaigns, integrate HBV modules into adult literacy programs, and develop culturally sensitive communication strategies to counter cultural myths that hinder positive attitudes and practices toward HBV prevention and care, establish mobile clinics for rural communities, promote adult education programs for rural communities in local languages.

title: Quality of life and self-reported stigma following hepatitis B surface antigen loss: A multi-site study by the Canadian Hepatitis B Network
abstract: Abstract Background: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) imposes adverse health outcomes but may also cause psychosocial and quality-of-life (QOL) challenges. Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss, whether spontaneous or due to treatment (ie, a functional cure), is associated with improved clinical outcomes, but the impact of HBsAg clearance on patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) is poorly understood. Methods: Two surveys (hepatitis B self-stigma and hepatitis B–related QOL [HBQOL]) were administered to adults with a history of CHB with documented HBsAg clearance from six Canadian hepatology clinics. Results: Eighty-four participants were enrolled (median age: 60 years; 53.6% male). Nearly three quarters (72.6%) of patients reported never feeling self-stigma. HBQOL scores improved across all six domains ( p < 0.001 for each), with the largest relative gains in psychological well-being (60% reduction), transmission concerns (55%), and stigma (53%). Conclusions: HBsAg loss was associated with significant improvements in patient-reported stigma and QOL. These findings highlight the importance of incorporating PROMs into hepatitis B virus clinical care to better capture treatment experiences.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) poses both clinical and psychosocial burdens, and while hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss is linked to improved clinical outcomes, its effect on patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) such as quality of life (QOL) and self-stigma remains unclear.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This multi-site study recruited adults with documented HBsAg clearance from six Canadian hepatology clinics and administered two surveys assessing hepatitis B self-stigma and hepatitis B–related QOL.
analysis.methods: Two validated surveys—one measuring hepatitis B self-stigma and the other hepatitis B–related QOL—were administered to participants with a history of CHB and confirmed HBsAg clearance.
analysis.main_results: Among 84 participants (median age 60 years; 53.6% male), 72.6% reported never experiencing self-stigma, and HBQOL scores improved significantly across all six domains (p < 0.001 for each), with the largest relative gains in psychological well-being (60% reduction), transmission concerns (55%), and stigma (53%).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret HBsAg loss as being associated with substantial improvements in patient-reported stigma and QOL, highlighting a previously underappreciated benefit of functional cure in hepatitis B management.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that incorporating PROMs into hepatitis B clinical care could better capture treatment experiences and inform patient-centered care strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to an abstract-only report, lacks detailed methodology, and does not address potential selection bias or generalizability beyond the surveyed cohort, warranting cautious interpretation.

analysis.summary_en: This multi-site Canadian study assessed patient-reported outcomes in adults with chronic hepatitis B who achieved hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss, a functional cure. Using two validated surveys administered across six hepatology clinics, the study found that 72.6% of 84 participants reported no self-stigma, and quality-of-life scores improved significantly across all domains, particularly in psychological well-being, transmission concerns, and stigma. The authors conclude that HBsAg loss is associated with meaningful improvements in stigma and quality of life, advocating for the integration of patient-reported outcome measures into hepatitis B clinical care. However, the evidence is derived solely from an abstract, limiting methodological detail and generalizability.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项多中心研究从加拿大六个肝病诊所招募了有 HBsAg 清除记录的成年人,并进行了两项评估乙型肝炎自我耻辱和乙型肝炎相关生活质量的调查。
elements_zh.methods: 对有慢性乙型肝炎病史并已确认 HBsAg 清除的参与者进行了两项经过验证的调查,一项是测量乙型肝炎的自我污名,另一项是乙型肝炎相关的生活质量。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 84 名参与者(中位年龄 60 岁;53.6% 为男性)中,72.6% 的人表示从未经历过自我耻辱,HBQOL 评分在所有六个领域均显着改善(每个领域 p < 0.001),其中心理健康(减少 60%)、传播担忧(55%)和耻辱(53%)方面的相对收益最大。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将 HBsAg 消失解释为与患者报告的耻辱感和生活质量的显着改善相关,这突显了乙型肝炎管理中功能性治愈的先前被低估的益处。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,将 PROM 纳入乙型肝炎临床护理可以更好地获取治疗经验并为以患者为中心的护理策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于摘要报告,缺乏详细的方法论,并且没有解决受调查群体之外的潜在选择偏差或普遍性,需要谨慎解释。

analysis_en.main_results: Among 84 participants (median age 60 years; 53.6% male), 72.6% reported never experiencing self-stigma, and HBQOL scores improved significantly across all six domains (p < 0.001 for each), with the largest relative gains in psychological well-being (60% reduction), transmission concerns (55%), and stigma (53%).
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret HBsAg loss as being associated with substantial improvements in patient-reported stigma and QOL, highlighting a previously underappreciated benefit of functional cure in hepatitis B management.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings suggest that incorporating PROMs into hepatitis B clinical care could better capture treatment experiences and inform patient-centered care strategies.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to an abstract-only report, lacks detailed methodology, and does not address potential selection bias or generalizability beyond the surveyed cohort, warranting cautious interpretation.

title_zh: 乙型肝炎表面抗原丧失后的生活质量和自我报告的耻辱:加拿大乙型肝炎网络的多中心研究
source_body_en: Abstract Background: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) imposes adverse health outcomes but may also cause psychosocial and quality-of-life (QOL) challenges. Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss, whether spontaneous or due to treatment (ie, a functional cure), is associated with improved clinical outcomes, but the impact of HBsAg clearance on patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) is poorly understood. Methods: Two surveys (hepatitis B self-stigma and hepatitis B–related QOL [HBQOL]) were administered to adults with a history of CHB with documented HBsAg clearance from six Canadian hepatology clinics. Results: Eighty-four participants were enrolled (median age: 60 years; 53.6% male). Nearly three quarters (72.6%) of patients reported never feeling self-stigma. HBQOL scores improved across all six domains ( p < 0.001 for each), with the largest relative gains in psychological well-being (60% reduction), transmission concerns (55%), and stigma (53%). Conclusions: HBsAg loss was associated with significant improvements in patient-reported stigma and QOL. These findings highlight the importance of incorporating PROMs into hepatitis B virus clinical care to better capture treatment experiences.

title: Hepatitis B knowledge, attitudes and practices among health-care workers in Vanuatu, 2024.
abstract: Objective: The prevalence of chronic hepatitis B in Vanuatu is high, at approximately 9%. While immunization has been available for infants since 1989, subsets of the adult population remain susceptible, including health-care workers. Prior to a planned roll-out of hepatitis B vaccination for health-care workers, we conducted a knowledge, attitudes and practices survey to inform education programmes aimed at promoting vaccine uptake. Methods: Clinical and non-clinical health-care professionals at risk of occupational exposure to hepatitis B were invited to complete an online survey from April to June 2024. The survey sought information on hepatitis B knowledge (10 questions), attitudes (6 questions) and clinical practices (3 questions), as well as participant demographics. Participant knowledge scores were calculated and potential associations with demographic factors explored using Fisher's exact test. Results: Most of the 50 respondents were female (73%) and worked in either hospitals or the Ministry of Health (82%). Knowledge was high, with a median score of 9 (range: 3-10); 21 participants scored 100%. The proportion of incorrect responses was highest for questions related to treatment availability and transmission risks. We found no evidence of associations between demographic factors and knowledge scores. Most participants believed that hepatitis B vaccines were useful (88%) and prevention and control measures would protect them from infection (96%). Discussion: Our survey revealed high levels of knowledge and generally positive attitudes towards people with hepatitis B and infection control practices. While our respondents are unlikely to be representative of all health-care workers in Vanuatu, findings offer useful insights into specific knowledge gaps that could be addressed in planned health-care worker education sessions ahead of the vaccination roll-out.

title: Structural barriers drive the intention-action gap in hepatitis B prevention among migrants in Shandong Province, China: a triangulated study of serological, spatial, and behavioral data.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major public health challenge in China. Migrant workers constitute a highly vulnerable population due to high geographic mobility and occupational vulnerability. Despite public health education efforts, a notable intention-action gap disrupts the HBV care cascade. This study integrates serological, spatial, and behavioral data to investigate whether this gap is primarily driven by cognitive deficits or interrupted by underlying structural barriers. METHODS: A triangulated cross-sectional study was conducted in Yantai, China, involving structured questionnaire surveys (N = 1,184) and serological testing (N = 2,364). The spatial distribution of regional anti-HBs positive rates was mapped using Geographic Information Systems (GIS). An adapted Health Belief Model was tested using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) with a Robust Maximum Likelihood estimator to evaluate the disruptive effects of objective structural constraints-specifically, time poverty, economic constraints, and systemic lack of medical insurance. RESULTS: The serologically confirmed anti-HBs positive rate was 51.10% (1,208/2,364), substantially lower than the 70% threshold recommended by the World Health Organization. Spatial analysis revealed significant geographic heterogeneity (χ2 = 74.38, P < 0.001), with higher immunity concentrated in large-scale industrial belts (67.33%) and lower immunity clustered in dispersed service-sector districts (36.81%). SEM results indicated that while external cues strongly predicted HBV knowledge (β = 0.894), knowledge had only a marginal effect on preventive intention (β = 0.192). Preventive intention significantly predicted actual behavior (β = 0.655). However, this motivational process was severely undermined by structural barriers, predominantly time poverty (β = -0.563, P < 0.001), followed by economic constraints (β = -0.278, P < 0.001) and lack of medical insurance (β = -0.056, P = 0.030). CONCLUSIONS: The intention-action gap in HBV prevention among migrant workers is primarily driven by socioeconomic structural barriers-most notably time poverty-while basic HBV knowledge remains a foundational but insufficient condition for preventive action. Achieving the goal of viral hepatitis elimination requires a shift from individual cognitive persuasion to structural interventions, emphasizing workplace-based service delivery, spatially targeted resource allocation, and insurance reforms to alleviate out-of-pocket and opportunity costs.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染仍然是中国的一个重大公共卫生挑战,特别是对于面临高度地域流动性和职业脆弱性的农民工而言。尽管做出了公共卫生教育努力,但明显的意图与行动差距扰乱了乙型肝炎护理级联,促使该研究调查这种差距是否是由认知缺陷或结构性障碍造成的。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在中国烟台进行了一项三角横断面研究,对农民工进行了结构化问卷调查(N = 1,184)和血清学检测(N = 2,364)。该研究整合了血清学、空间和行为数据来检查乙型肝炎预防行为。
elements_zh.methods: 使用地理信息系统 (GIS) 绘制区域抗 HBs 阳性率的空间分布。使用结构方程模型 (SEM) 和鲁棒最大似然估计器测试了改编后的健康信念模型,以评估客观结构约束的破坏性影响,包括时间贫困、经济约束和缺乏医疗保险。
elements_zh.main_results: 血清学确诊的抗-HBs阳性率为51.10%(1,208/2,364),远低于世界卫生组织建议的70%阈值。空间分析显示,地理异质性显着(χ2 = 74.38,P < 0.001),免疫力较高的地区集中在规模较大的工业带(67.33%),免疫力较低的地区集中在分散的服务业区(36.81%)。SEM 结果表明,虽然外部线索强烈预测 HBV 知识(β = 0.894),但知识对预防意图(β = 0.192)只有边际影响,而预防意图又显着预测实际行为(β = 0.655)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 农民工乙肝预防的意向与行动差距主要是由社会经济结构性障碍造成的——最明显的是时间贫困(β = -0.563,P < 0.001)——而基本的乙肝知识仍然是预防行动的基础但不充分的条件。该研究明确地将认知因素与结构性决定因素进行对比,强调仅以知识为中心的干预措施是不够的。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,实现消除病毒性肝炎需要从个人认知说服转向结构性干预,强调基于工作场所的服务提供、有针对性的空间资源分配以及保险改革,以减轻自付费用和机会成本。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横断面设计的限制,它排除了因果推断,而且它对单一地理环境(烟台)的依赖,可能限制了对其他流动人口的普遍适用性。由于血清学、空间和行为数据的三角测量,证据强度中等,但由于缺乏纵向随访而受到限制。

abstract_zh: 背景:乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染仍然是中国的一个重大公共卫生挑战。由于地域流动性大和职业脆弱性,农民工构成高度弱势群体。尽管做出了公共卫生教育努力,但明显的意图与行动差距扰乱了乙肝护理级联。这项研究整合了血清学、空间和行为数据,以调查这种差距是否主要是由认知缺陷造成的,还是被潜在的结构性障碍所中断。方法:在中国烟台进行了一项三角横断面研究,包括结构化问卷调查(N = 1,184)和血清学检测(N = 2,364)。使用地理信息系统 (GIS) 绘制区域抗 HBs 阳性率的空间分布。使用结构方程模型 (SEM) 和鲁棒最大似然估计器对改编后的健康信念模型进行测试,以评估客观结构约束(特别是时间贫困、经济约束和系统性缺乏医疗保险)的破坏性影响。结果:血清学确诊的抗-HBs阳性率为51.10%(1,208/2,364),远低于世界卫生组织推荐的70%阈值。空间分析显示,地理异质性显着(χ2 = 74.38,P < 0.001),免疫力较高的地区集中在规模较大的工业带(67.33%),免疫力较低的地区集中在分散的服务业区(36.81%)。SEM 结果表明,虽然外部线索强烈预测 HBV 知识(β = 0.894),但知识对预防意图只有边际影响(β = 0.192)。预防意图显着预测实际行为(β = 0.655)。然而,这种激励过程受到结构性障碍的严重破坏,主要是时间贫困(β = -0.563,P < 0.001),其次是经济约束(β = -0.278,P < 0.001)和缺乏医疗保险(β = -0.056,P = 0.030)。结论:农民工乙肝预防的意向与行动差距主要是由社会经济结构性障碍(尤其是时间贫困)造成的,而基本的乙肝知识仍然是预防行动的基础但不充分的条件。实现消除病毒性肝炎的目标需要从个人认知说服转向结构性干预,强调基于工作场所的服务提供、有针对性的空间资源分配以及保险改革,以减轻自付费用和机会成本。

title: Safety and efficacy of libevitug in patients with chronic hepatitis B and D virus coinfection: A single-center, open-label, phase IIa trial in China
abstract: Background: Chronic HBV and HDV coinfection represents the most severe form of viral hepatitis. This study aimed to assess the safety and efficacy of libevitug (HH-003), a novel human monoclonal antibody targeting the PreS1 domain of the HBV large envelope protein, in patients with chronic HBV and HDV coinfection. Methods: This single-center, open-label, proof-of-concept phase IIa clinical trial enrolled 9 participants who received i.v. infusion of 20 mg/kg libevitug every 2 weeks for 24 weeks, followed by a 24-week follow-up period. Results: At week 24, 8 participants (88.9%) exhibited a reduction in HDV RNA ≥1 log 10 from baseline, with 4 (44.4%) achieving undetectable levels. 7 participants (77.8%) achieved virological response (undetectable HDV RNA or ≥2 log 10 decline from baseline). Among the 5 participants with elevated baseline ALT, 3 (60.0%) achieved a combined virological and biochemical response (ALT normalization). At week 48, 6 participants (66.7%) maintained the virological response achieved at the end of treatment (week 24), with 3 (33.3%) maintaining undetectable HDV RNA levels. Among the 7 participants with quantifiable HBV DNA at baseline, 2 (28.6%) achieved undetectable HBV DNA or ≥1 log 10 reduction at week 24. Serum HBsAg levels remained unchanged throughout the study period. Treatment-emergent adverse events were reported in 8 participants (88.9%), with only 1 participant (11.1%) experiencing treatment-related adverse events. No grade 3 or serious adverse events were reported, and no discontinuations due to adverse events occurred. Conclusions: Libevitug demonstrated promising antiviral activity, achieving substantial HDV RNA reduction, a high rate of ALT normalization, and favorable safety and tolerability in participants with chronic HBV and HDV coinfection.

title_zh: libevitug 在慢性乙型肝炎和丁型肝炎病毒合并感染患者中的安全性和有效性:中国的单中心、开放标签、IIa 期试验
source_body_en: Background: Chronic HBV and HDV coinfection represents the most severe form of viral hepatitis. This study aimed to assess the safety and efficacy of libevitug (HH-003), a novel human monoclonal antibody targeting the PreS1 domain of the HBV large envelope protein, in patients with chronic HBV and HDV coinfection. Methods: This single-center, open-label, proof-of-concept phase IIa clinical trial enrolled 9 participants who received i.v. infusion of 20 mg/kg libevitug every 2 weeks for 24 weeks, followed by a 24-week follow-up period. Results: At week 24, 8 participants (88.9%) exhibited a reduction in HDV RNA ≥1 log 10 from baseline, with 4 (44.4%) achieving undetectable levels. 7 participants (77.8%) achieved virological response (undetectable HDV RNA or ≥2 log 10 decline from baseline). Among the 5 participants with elevated baseline ALT, 3 (60.0%) achieved a combined virological and biochemical response (ALT normalization). At week 48, 6 participants (66.7%) maintained the virological response achieved at the end of treatment (week 24), with 3 (33.3%) maintaining undetectable HDV RNA levels. Among the 7 participants with quantifiable HBV DNA at baseline, 2 (28.6%) achieved undetectable HBV DNA or ≥1 log 10 reduction at week 24. Serum HBsAg levels remained unchanged throughout the study period. Treatment-emergent adverse events were reported in 8 participants (88.9%), with only 1 participant (11.1%) experiencing treatment-related adverse events. No grade 3 or serious adverse events were reported, and no discontinuations due to adverse events occurred. Conclusions: Libevitug demonstrated promising antiviral activity, achieving substantial HDV RNA reduction, a high rate of ALT normalization, and favorable safety and tolerability in participants with chronic HBV and HDV coinfection.
abstract_zh: 背景:慢性 HBV 和 HDV 合并感染是最严重的病毒性肝炎。本研究旨在评估 libevitug (HH-003)(一种针对 HBV 大包膜蛋白 PreS1 结构域的新型人单克隆抗体)在慢性 HBV 和 HDV 合并感染患者中的安全性和有效性。方法:这项单中心、开放标签、概念验证 IIa 期临床试验招募了 9 名接受静脉注射的参与者。每2周输注20 mg/kg libevitug,持续24周,然后是24周的随访期。结果:第 24 周时,8 名参与者 (88.9%) 的 HDV RNA 较基线降低≥1 log 10,其中 4 名参与者 (44.4%) 达到不可检测的水平。7 名参与者 (77.8%) 实现了病毒学应答(HDV RNA 检测不到或较基线下降≥2 log 10)。在基线 ALT 升高的 5 名参与者中,3 名 (60.0%) 实现了病毒学和生化综合反应(ALT 正常化)。在第 48 周,6 名参与者 (66.7%) 维持了治疗结束时(第 24 周)所达到的病毒学应答,其中 3 名参与者 (33.3%) 维持了不可检测的 HDV RNA 水平。在基线时具有可量化 HBV DNA 的 7 名参与者中,2 名 (28.6%) 在第 24 周时实现了检测不到 HBV DNA 或 ≥1 log 10 降低。在整个研究期间,血清 HBsAg 水平保持不变。8 名参与者 (88.9%) 报告了治疗引起的不良事件,只有 1 名参与者 (11.1%) 经历了与治疗相关的不良事件。未报告 3 级或严重不良事件,也未发生因不良事件而停药的情况。结论:Libevitug 在慢性 HBV 和 HDV 合并感染的参与者中表现出良好的抗病毒活性,可显着降低 HDV RNA,提高 ALT 正常化率,并具有良好的安全性和耐受性。

title: Antiviral activity of novel chemical compound 0411, derived from FUBP1-IN-1 against hepatitis B virus by upregulation of DUSP5.
abstract: Current first-line drugs rarely achieve functional curesfor chronic hepatitis B patients, which urges us to explore novel anti-HBV therapeutic strategies. In this study, we found that the novel chemical compound 0411, a derivative of the FUBP1 inhibitor, FUBPI-IN-1, significantly suppressed HBV transcription both in vitro and in vivo. Transcriptome sequencing demonstrated that 0411 treatment markedly upregulated the expression of the dual-specificity phosphatase 5 (DUSP5) gene, a crucial regulator of the MAPK pathway. Further functional studies illustrated that the antiviral activity of compound 0411 was dependent on DUSP5. Mechanismly, 0411 treatment in HepG2-NTCP cells enhances the deposition of active histone modifications on the promoter of DUSP5 significantly. In conclusion, our findings demonstrate the potential of 0411 as an effective agent against HBV transcription.

title: Hepatitis B virus in Pakistan: serological marker prevalence, clinical correlates, and genotype-informed interpretation
abstract: Abstract Hepatitis B virus (HBV) remains a major contributor to chronic liver disease, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Pakistan is considered an intermediate-burden country with heterogeneous regional prevalence and genotype distribution. This study summarizes clinical, demographic, serological, and treatment-related patterns in a Pakistani HBV dataset and interprets the findings in the context of known genotype distribution in Pakistan. De-identified electronic health-record data were reviewed for age, gender, body mass index (BMI), disease duration, smoking status, treatment response, adverse effects, and HBV markers, including hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), hepatitis B e antigen (HBeAg), hepatitis B e antibody (HBeAb), hepatitis B core immunoglobulin M (HBc IgM), and hepatitis B surface antibody (HBsAb). Descriptive analysis showed a mean age of 45.3 years, near-balanced gender distribution, mean BMI of 27.5 kg/m2, and mean disease duration of 12.7 years. Smoking was reported in 35% of the study population. HBsAg positivity was 1.85%, whereas HBeAg positivity was 21.62%, suggesting an important active-replication subgroup among those tested. HBeAb and HBsAb positivity were each 18.92%, and HBc IgM positivity was 13.51%, indicating a mixture of immune, active, and recent-infection signals. Correlation analysis highlighted strong relationships between age and age of onset, and between weight and BMI. Systemic antiviral care showed a modestly higher mean response score than supportive/local care, while most adverse effects were mild or moderate. These findings underscore the need for improved vaccination, early diagnosis, confirmatory molecular testing, genotype-aware surveillance, and long-term management of chronic HBV in Pakistan.

title: Hepatitis B Vaccination in People Living with HIV: Bridging the Immunological Gap
abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major driver of liver-related morbidity and mortality among people living with HIV (PLWH), yet vaccine-induced protection is frequently suboptimal. HIV-associated immune dysfunction, including CD4+ T-cell depletion, altered antigen presentation, impaired T follicular helper cell support, and B-cell dysregulation, reduces seroprotection after standard recombinant HBV vaccines and may limit durability of antibody responses. Vaccine response is further influenced by HIV viral suppression, age, comorbidities, prior vaccine history, and baseline HBV serologic status, including isolated hepatitis B core antibody (anti-HBc) and occult HBV infection (OBI) considerations. Although antiretroviral therapy (ART) improves vaccine responsiveness, many PLWH fail to achieve protective hepatitis B surface antibody (anti-HBs) titers (≥10 mIU/mL) after conventional schedules, or experience antibody waning over time. Current guidelines recommend HBV vaccination for all susceptible PLWH with post-vaccination serologic testing and revaccination for nonresponders. Persistent implementation barriers, including incomplete series, vaccine hesitancy, stigma, and logistical constraints, continue to limit real-world impact. Emerging clinical trial data support CpG-adjuvanted HBV vaccines (HepB-CpG/Heplisav-B) and intensified dosing and schedules (double-dose or four-dose regimens) to improve seroprotection and generate higher peak anti-HBs titers, which may enhance durability. This review synthesizes guideline recommendations, immunologic mechanisms of hyporesponsiveness, predictors of vaccine response, and practical strategies to optimize HBV vaccination in PLWH.

abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染仍然是艾滋病毒感染者 (PLWH) 肝脏相关发病率和死亡率的主要驱动因素,但疫苗诱导的保护往往不理想。HIV 相关的免疫功能障碍,包括 CD4+ T 细胞耗竭、抗原呈递改变、滤泡辅助 T 细胞支持受损和 B 细胞失调,会降低标准重组 HBV 疫苗后的血清保护作用,并可能限制抗体反应的持久性。疫苗反应进一步受到 HIV 病毒抑制、年龄、合并症、既往疫苗史和基线 HBV 血清学状态的影响,包括分离的乙型肝炎核心抗体(抗 HBc)和隐匿性 HBV 感染 (OBI) 考虑因素。尽管抗逆转录病毒治疗 (ART) 可以提高疫苗反应性,但许多感染者在常规治疗后未能达到保护性乙型肝炎表面抗体 (抗 HBs) 滴度 (≥10 mIU/mL),或者随着时间的推移抗体逐渐减弱。目前的指南建议对所有易感感染者进行乙型肝炎疫苗接种,并进行疫苗接种后血清学检测,并对无反应者重新接种疫苗。持续存在的实施障碍,包括不完整的系列、疫苗犹豫、耻辱和后勤限制,继续限制现实世界的影响。新的临床试验数据支持 CpG 佐剂 HBV 疫苗 (HepB-CpG/Heplisav-B) 和强化剂量和方案(双剂量或四剂量方案),以改善血清保护并产生更高的峰值抗 HBs 滴度,这可能会增强耐久性。本综述综合了指南建议、低反应性的免疫机制、疫苗反应的预测因素以及优化 PLWH 乙型肝炎疫苗接种的实用策略。

title: Surveillance of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) patients using Protein Induced by Vitamin K (PIVKA-II): A cost-utility analysis for Hong Kong
abstract: BACKGROUND & AIMS: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a leading cause of cancer-related death in Hong Kong. Common risk factors include chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection and/ or liver cirrhosis (LC). Routine HCC surveillance using ultrasound plus alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) for patients with these conditions is recommended, but many patients still face limited access to ultrasound. For these, biomarker-based surveillance using a combination of protein induced by vitamin K absence or antagonist-II (PIVKA-II) plus AFP could provide a valuable alternative. METHODS: This study compared the cost-utility of routine HCC surveillance using 'PIVKA-II + AFP' to the recommended standard-of-care in Hong Kong: surveillance using 'US + AFP'. A health economic model using a Markov-microsimulation framework was adapted using published local data and settings. The model was used to compare diagnostic outcomes, overall costs, quality-adjusted life years (QALYs), and cost-utility of the alternative HCC surveillance methods. RESULTS: Compared to the current recommended standard-of-care, the results suggested that HCC surveillance using 'PIVKA-II + AFP' could improve detection of HCC during early-stage disease by 4.6 percentage points, thus enabling access to more effective treatment options for some patients. It could also reduce false positive diagnoses by 7.2%, which could alleviate the need for costly confirmatory testing. Overall, PIVKA-II + AFP' was associated with a gain of 0.019 QALYs and cost savings of HK $ 4,144 per individual. The results were particularly favorable for non-cirrhotic CHB patients. CONCLUSIONS: HCC surveillance using 'PIVKA-II + AFP' could be a feasible option for patients with CHB and/ or LC who face limited access to ultrasound-based surveillance. The combination has the potential to improve early-stage HCC detection, facilitating timely intervention and improving both survival outcomes and patient quality of life.

abstract_zh: 背景与目的:肝细胞癌(HCC)是香港癌症相关死亡的主要原因。常见的危险因素包括慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 感染和/或肝硬化 (LC)。建议对患有这些疾病的患者使用超声加甲胎蛋白 (AFP) 进行常规 HCC 监测,但许多患者接受超声检查的机会仍然有限。对于这些情况,使用维生素 K 缺乏或拮抗剂 II (PIVKA-II) 诱导的蛋白质与 AFP 的组合进行基于生物标志物的监测可以提供一种有价值的替代方案。方法:本研究将使用“PIVKA-II + AFP”的常规 HCC 监测与香港推荐的护理标准:使用“US + AFP”的监测进行了成本效益比较。使用马尔可夫微观模拟框架的健康经济模型是根据已发布的当地数据和设置进行调整的。该模型用于比较替代 HCC 监测方法的诊断结果、总体成本、质量调整生命年 (QALY) 和成本效益。结果:与目前推荐的护理标准相比,结果表明使用“PIVKA-II + AFP”进行 HCC 监测可以将早期疾病期间 HCC 的检出率提高 4.6 个百分点,从而使一些患者能够获得更有效的治疗选择。它还可以将假阳性诊断减少 7.2%,从而减少对昂贵的确认性检测的需求。总体而言,PIVKA-II + AFP' 与每人 0.019 QALY 的增益和 4,144 港元的成本节省相关。结果对于非肝硬化慢性乙型肝炎患者尤其有利。结论:对于超声监测机会有限的 CHB 和/或 LC 患者,使用“PIVKA-II + AFP”进行 HCC 监测可能是一种可行的选择。该组合有可能改善早期 HCC 检测,促进及时干预并改善生存结果和患者生活质量。

title: Shear wave elastography-based intrahepatic heterogeneity quantification predicts prognosis in patients with hepatitis B virus-related acutely decompensated cirrhosis
abstract: Abstract Purpose To quantify intrahepatic heterogeneity (IHH) across biomechanical and morphological dimensions using two-dimensional (2D) shear wave elastography (SWE) images, and integrate it into a multimodal model for predicting 5-year mortality in patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related acutely decompensated cirrhosis (ADC). Methods This retrospective study included 239 patients with HBV-ADC, randomly allocated into a training (n = 144) and a validation cohort (n = 95). Baseline clinical data, 2D SWE images, mean elasticity values, and 5-year outcomes were collected. Unsupervised K-means clustering was applied to local radiomic features extracted from spatially co-registered SWE and gray-scale regions of 2D-SWE images to derive dual-modality IHH scores. Using the training cohort, a multimodal model was developed via multivariate Cox regression, integrating independent clinical predictors, mean SWE values, and dual-modality IHH and radiomic scores. Result In the validation cohort, both the SWE- and gray-scale-derived IHH scores demonstrated robust prognostic value for 5-year mortality, achieving time-dependent areas under the curve (AUCs) of 0.826 and 0.795, and concordance indices (C-indices) of 0.736 and 0.692, respectively. For the multimodal model, SHAP analysis identified these IHH scores as the most critical determinants for individual risk stratification. Notably, this model elevated the AUC and C-index to 0.904 and 0.801, respectively, significantly outperforming all unimodal predictive models (all p

title: Metabolic comorbidities affect the survival of hepatitis B virus-related hepatocellular carcinoma in Chinese patients: a retrospective cohort study with propensity score matching
abstract: Objective Recent literature has confirmed the roles of metabolic comorbidities as risk factors for the incidence of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). In China, most HCC cases are attributed to chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV). However, the relationships between metabolic comorbidities and the prognosis of Chinese patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related HCC remain uncertain. Methods A total of 164 patients with HBV-related HCC from eight hospitals affiliated with Sun Yat-sen University were enrolled in this cohort study from 2011 to 2021. The patients were divided into the MC group (metabolic comorbidities: at least one metabolic comorbidity from among type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), hypertension, and low high-density lipoprotein (HDL) levels) and the NMC group (without these factors). In this manuscript, “MC” refers to metabolic comorbidity, rather than metabolic syndrome. Propensity score matching (PSM) and multivariate Cox regression were used to analyse overall survival (OS). Results After PSM, 60 patients each in the MC and NMC groups were included in the study. Overall survival was significantly worse in the MC group than in the NMC group before and after PSM. T2DM was an independent risk factor for OS. T2DM, hypertension, and low HDL levels were independent risk factors for the presence of intrahepatic multifocal lesions at diagnosis. The presence of all three metabolic comorbidities was associated with significantly worse OS (p=0.043). Conclusion Metabolic comorbidities were associated with poor prognosis and the progression of HBV-related HCC. The presence of three metabolic comorbidities (T2DM, hypertension, and low HDL levels) was associated with poor OS, suggesting that metabolic burden may negatively affect survival once a certain number of factors accumulate.

title_zh: 代谢合并症影响中国乙型肝炎病毒相关肝细胞癌患者的生存:一项倾向评分匹配的回顾性队列研究
source_body_en: Objective Recent literature has confirmed the roles of metabolic comorbidities as risk factors for the incidence of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). In China, most HCC cases are attributed to chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV). However, the relationships between metabolic comorbidities and the prognosis of Chinese patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related HCC remain uncertain. Methods A total of 164 patients with HBV-related HCC from eight hospitals affiliated with Sun Yat-sen University were enrolled in this cohort study from 2011 to 2021. The patients were divided into the MC group (metabolic comorbidities: at least one metabolic comorbidity from among type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), hypertension, and low high-density lipoprotein (HDL) levels) and the NMC group (without these factors). In this manuscript, “MC” refers to metabolic comorbidity, rather than metabolic syndrome. Propensity score matching (PSM) and multivariate Cox regression were used to analyse overall survival (OS). Results After PSM, 60 patients each in the MC and NMC groups were included in the study. Overall survival was significantly worse in the MC group than in the NMC group before and after PSM. T2DM was an independent risk factor for OS. T2DM, hypertension, and low HDL levels were independent risk factors for the presence of intrahepatic multifocal lesions at diagnosis. The presence of all three metabolic comorbidities was associated with significantly worse OS (p=0.043). Conclusion Metabolic comorbidities were associated with poor prognosis and the progression of HBV-related HCC. The presence of three metabolic comorbidities (T2DM, hypertension, and low HDL levels) was associated with poor OS, suggesting that metabolic burden may negatively affect survival once a certain number of factors accumulate.

title: PD-1 blockade unleashes local hepatitis B virus-related B cell response inhibiting hepatocellular carcinoma.
abstract: The prevailing notion is that effector T cell activation mediates anti-PD-1 efficacy in cancer. Here, we conducted a mechanistic study parallel to our phase 2 trial of perioperative anti-PD-1 therapy in patients with resectable recurrent hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) (NCT04615143) to study its mechanism of action. Late-recurrence patients present two distinct subtypes characterized by T cell or B cell dominant responses in the tumor microenvironment by dynamic single-cell multi-omics analysis. Clonal antibody repertoire analysis and spatially paired scRNA-seq/BCR-seq reveal somatic hypermutation promoting antibody binding against hepatitis B virus core antigen (HBcAg) within tumor tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs) in these type B-late recurrence patients. Mechanistically, HBcAg is exported into the extracellular space, triggering local B cell and antibody responses and complement activation. In mice, these high-affinity HBcAg-reactive antibodies lead to complement-mediated antitumor activity with enhanced anti-PD-1 efficacy. Thus, we uncover enhanced anti-virus B cell immunity within the TLS as a mechanism to anti-PD-1 in HCC.

title: Tissue-based detection of macrophage-associated YAP1-positive material in human acute liver injury: an exploratory immunopathological biopsy series.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Yes-associated protein 1 (YAP1), a downstream effector of the Hippo pathway, is implicated in hepatocellular stress, ductular reaction, and tissue repair. Experimental studies suggest that injured YAP1-activated hepatocytes can be cleared by Kupffer-cell phagocytosis, but corresponding human biopsy evidence remains limited. METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed seven adults who underwent clinically indicated liver biopsy within 10 days of initial presentation or referral admission for acute liver injury. Liver biopsy sections were assessed by hematoxylin and eosin staining, periodic acid-Schiff-diastase staining, YAP1 immunohistochemistry, and double immunofluorescence for YAP1 and CD68. Macrophage-associated YAP1-positive structures were operationally defined as YAP1-positive signals located within or immediately adjacent to CD68-positive macrophages in portal or periportal areas. The definition was intended to capture spatial association and was not intended to prove intracellular phagocytosis, molecular co-expression, or endogenous YAP1 expression by macrophages. Associations with peak Model for End-Stage Liver Disease (MELD) score and days to alanine aminotransferase (ALT) normalization were evaluated as exploratory analyses. RESULTS: The median age was 52 years, and etiologies included autoimmune hepatitis, primary biliary cholangitis-autoimmune hepatitis overlap, drug-induced liver injury, acute hepatitis B, and idiopathic acute liver injury. Liver biopsy was performed at a median of 5 days (range, 2-10 days) after initial presentation or referral admission. A median of nine portal tracts and five macrophage-associated YAP1-positive structures were evaluated per biopsy, yielding a median YAP1/CD68-positive portal-tract index of 58.3%. ALT normalized after a median of 26 days. The index showed a nominal inverse association with days to ALT normalization (Spearman rho = -0.86, p = 0.014; Pearson r = -0.79, p = 0.034), whereas MELD score was not significantly associated with the index or recovery time. Leave-one-out analyses retained the inverse direction but showed unstable significance because of the very small sample size. CONCLUSIONS: In this small exploratory biopsy series, YAP1-positive material was observed in spatial association with CD68-positive macrophages in early human acute liver injury. The YAP1/CD68-positive portal-tract index showed a hypothesis-generating relationship with biochemical recovery but should not be interpreted as a validated prognostic marker or proof of macrophage-mediated phagocytosis. Larger, etiology-specific studies with standardized biopsy timing, lineage markers, multiplex immunofluorescence, high-resolution imaging, and digital pathology are warranted.

abstract_zh: 背景:Yes 相关蛋白 1 (YAP1) 是 Hippo 通路的下游效应子,与肝细胞应激、导管反应和组织修复有关。实验研究表明,受损的 YAP1 激活肝细胞可以通过库普弗细胞吞噬作用清除,但相应的人体活检证据仍然有限。方法:我们回顾性分析了 7 名成人,他们在因急性肝损伤首次就诊或转诊入院后 10 天内接受了有临床指征的肝活检。通过苏木精和伊红染色、高碘酸希夫淀粉酶染色、YAP1 免疫组织化学以及 YAP1 和 CD68 双重免疫荧光对肝活检切片进行评估。巨噬细胞相关的 YAP1 阳性结构在操作上被定义为位于门脉或门脉区域 CD68 阳性巨噬细胞内或紧邻 CD68 阳性巨噬细胞的 YAP1 阳性信号。该定义旨在捕捉空间关联,并非旨在证明巨噬细胞的细胞内吞噬作用、分子共表达或内源性 YAP1 表达。作为探索性分析,评估了终末期肝病模型 (MELD) 评分峰值和丙氨酸转氨酶 (ALT) 正常化天数之间的关联。结果:中位年龄为52岁,病因包括自身免疫性肝炎、原发性胆汁性胆管炎-自身免疫性肝炎重叠、药物性肝损伤、急性乙型肝炎和特发性急性肝损伤。初次就诊或转诊入院后平均 5 天(范围为 2-10 天)进行肝活检。每次活检评估了 9 个汇管束和 5 个巨噬细胞相关 YAP1 阳性结构的中位数,得出中位 YAP1/CD68 阳性汇管束指数为 58.3%。平均 26 天后 ALT 恢复正常。该指数与 ALT 正常化天数呈名义负相关(Spearman rho = -0.86,p = 0.014;Pearson r = -0.79,p = 0.034),而 MELD 评分与指数或恢复时间没有显着相关。留一法分析保留了相反的方向,但由于样本量非常小,因此显示出不稳定的显着性。结论:在这个小型探索性活检系列中,在人类早期急性肝损伤中观察到 YAP1 阳性物质与 CD68 阳性巨噬细胞存在空间关联。YAP1/CD68 阳性汇管指数显示与生化恢复存在假设生成关系,但不应被解释为经过验证的预后标志物或巨噬细胞介导的吞噬作用的证据。有必要进行更大规模、针对病因的研究,包括标准化活检时间、谱系标记、多重免疫荧光、高分辨率成像和数字病理学。

title: Trends in the etiology of acute insult and underlying chronic liver disease in patients with acute-on-chronic liver failure: A retrospective study in Southwest China (2020-2023).
abstract: The etiology of acute insults and underlying chronic liver disease in acute-on-chronic liver failure has evolved in recent years. This study examined etiological patterns and trends from 2020 to 2023 in Southwest China. This study is a retrospective analysis that included 346 patients diagnosed with acute-on-chronic liver failure according to the Asian pacific association for the study of liver criteria at our hospital from 2020 to 2023. The etiology of acute insult and chronic liver disease and changing trends from 2020 to 2023 were analyzed. The top 5 etiologies of acute insult were spontaneous hepatitis B virus (HBV) reactivation (45.4%), HBV reactivation due to nucleot(s)ide analog withdrawal (16.2%), drug-induced liver injury (16.2%), unknown (6.1%), and alcoholic hepatitis (4.6%). The top 5 etiologies of chronic liver disease were chronic hepatitis B (53.2%), HBV-associated cirrhosis (22.00%), chronic hepatitis B plus alcoholic hepatitis (6.6%), HBV plus alcoholic hepatitis-associated cirrhosis (6.4%), and alcoholic hepatitis-associated cirrhosis (3.8%). From 2020 to 2023, the percentage of patients with viral hepatitis initially declined and then increased. The percentage of patients with alcoholic hepatitis showed a slight declining trend. The proportion of HBV-associated cirrhosis increased from 18.8% to 29.9%. The percentage of patients with chronic hepatitis B plus alcoholic hepatitis decreased from 11.8% to 2.6%, respectively. Viral hepatitis, especially chronic hepatitis B, remains the leading cause of acute insult and underlying chronic liver disease in Southwest China. These findings underscore the need for targeted HBV management strategies.

This study is a retrospective analysis that included 346 patients diagnosed with acute-on-chronic liver failure according to the Asian pacific association for the study of liver criteria at our hospital from 2020 to 2023. The etiology of acute insult and chronic liver disease and changing trends from 2020 to 2023 were analyzed. The top 5 etiologies of acute insult were spontaneous hepatitis B virus (HBV) reactivation (45.4%), HBV reactivation due to nucleot(s)ide analog withdrawal (16.2%), drug-induced liver injury (16.2%), unknown (6.1%), and alcoholic hepatitis (4.6%). The top 5 etiologies of chronic liver disease were chronic hepatitis B (53.2%), HBV-associated cirrhosis (22.00%), chronic hepatitis B plus alcoholic hepatitis (6.6%), HBV plus alcoholic hepatitis-associated cirrhosis (6.4%), and alcoholic hepatitis-associated cirrhosis (3.8%). From 2020 to 2023, the percentage of patients with viral hepatitis initially declined and then increased. The percentage of patients with alcoholic hepatitis showed a slight declining trend. The proportion of HBV-associated cirrhosis increased from 18.8% to 29.9%. The percentage of patients with chronic hepatitis B plus alcoholic hepatitis decreased from 11.8% to 2.6%, respectively. Viral hepatitis, especially chronic hepatitis B, remains the leading cause of acute insult and underlying chronic liver disease in Southwest China. These findings underscore the need for targeted HBV management strategies.

title_zh: 慢加急性肝衰竭患者急性损伤和潜在慢性肝病的病因学趋势:中国西南地区的回顾性研究(2020-2023年)。
source_body_en: The etiology of acute insults and underlying chronic liver disease in acute-on-chronic liver failure has evolved in recent years. This study examined etiological patterns and trends from 2020 to 2023 in Southwest China. This study is a retrospective analysis that included 346 patients diagnosed with acute-on-chronic liver failure according to the Asian pacific association for the study of liver criteria at our hospital from 2020 to 2023. The top 5 etiologies of chronic liver disease were chronic hepatitis B (53.2%), HBV-associated cirrhosis (22.00%), chronic hepatitis B plus alcoholic hepatitis (6.6%), HBV plus alcoholic hepatitis-associated cirrhosis (6.4%), and alcoholic hepatitis-associated cirrhosis (3.8%). From 2020 to 2023, the percentage of patients with viral hepatitis initially declined and then increased. The percentage of patients with alcoholic hepatitis showed a slight declining trend. The proportion of HBV-associated cirrhosis increased from 18.8% to 29.9%. The percentage of patients with chronic hepatitis B plus alcoholic hepatitis decreased from 11.8% to 2.6%, respectively. abstract_zh: 近年来,慢性肝衰竭急性损伤和潜在慢性肝病的病因学有所发展。本研究调查了 2020 年至 2023 年中国西南地区的病因模式和趋势。本研究为回顾性分析,纳入2020年至2023年在我院根据亚太肝病研究协会标准诊断为慢性肝衰竭的346例患者,分析2020年至2023年急性损伤和慢性肝病的病因及变化趋势。急性损伤的前5位病因是自发性乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)再激活(45.4%)、核苷类似物戒断引起的HBV再激活(16.2%)、药物性肝损伤(16.2%)、不明原因(6.1%)和酒精性肝炎(4.6%)。慢性肝病病因前5位依次为慢性乙型肝炎(53.2%)、乙型肝炎相关性肝硬化(22.00%)、慢性乙型肝炎合并酒精性肝炎(6.6%)、乙型肝炎合并酒精性肝炎相关性肝硬化(6.4%)、酒精性肝炎相关性肝硬化(3.8%)。2020年至2023年,病毒性肝炎患者比例先下降后上升。酒精性肝炎患者比例呈小幅下降趋势。HBV相关肝硬化的比例从18.8%上升至29.9%。慢性乙型肝炎加酒精性肝炎患者比例分别从11.8%下降至2.6%。病毒性肝炎,尤其是慢性乙型肝炎,仍然是中国西南地区急性损伤和潜在慢性肝病的主要原因。这些发现强调了有针对性的乙肝治疗策略的必要性。

title: Optimizing Hepatitis B screening: A comparison of ELISA and rapid tests
abstract: Hepatitis B remains a major global public health problem, particularly in areas of high endemicity such as Madagascar, where prevalence exceeds 8%. Diagnosis relies primarily on the ELISA immunoenzymatic technique, which is recognized for its reliability but is not widely available in resource-limited laboratories. Rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) offer a practical alternative, but their performance in this context has yet to be evaluated. This prospective descriptive and analytical study compared the performance of the Virucheck® rapid test and the Wantai Bio Pharm ELISA for the detection of hepatitis B virus surface antigen (HBsAg). The sample consisted of 74 serum samples from patients with sickle cell disease and subjects followed at the JRA University Hospital. The results showed a seroprevalence of 6.75% by TDR versus 9.45% by ELISA. The TDR had a sensitivity of 71.41% and a specificity of 100%, while the ELISA confirmed its superiority with sensitivities exceeding 95% and specificities close to 98%. Beyond technical performance, the study highlighted a predominantly young population, reflecting the significance of mother-to-child transmission, as well as a notable seroprevalence among young adults linked to risky sexual behaviors. These findings underscore the urgency of early and targeted screening, combined with a strengthened vaccination strategy. In conclusion, optimizing hepatitis B screening in Madagascar relies on the complementary use of rapid tests—suitable for community-based screening—and ELISA, which is essential for diagnostic confirmation and clinical follow-up. This approach represents a strategic pathway to reduce transmission, improve vaccination coverage, and strengthen the fight against hepatitis B in a context of high endemicity.

abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎仍然是一个主要的全球公共卫生问题,特别是在马达加斯加等高流行地区,其患病率超过 8%。诊断主要依靠 ELISA 免疫酶技术,该技术因其可靠性而得到认可,但在资源有限的实验室中并未广泛使用。快速诊断测试(RDT)提供了一种实用的替代方案,但其在这方面的性能尚未得到评估。这项前瞻性描述性和分析性研究比较了 Virucheck® 快速检测和万泰生物 Pharm ELISA 在检测乙型肝炎病毒表面抗原 (HBsAg) 方面的性能。该样本由来自镰状细胞病患者和 JRA 大学医院随访受试者的 74 份血清样本组成。结果显示,TDR 的血清阳性率为 6.75%,而 ELISA 的血清阳性率为 9.45%。TDR的敏感性为71.41%,特异性为100%,而ELISA证实了其优越性,敏感性超过95%,特异性接近98%。除了技术性能之外,该研究还强调了年轻人口占主导地位,反映了母婴传播的重要性,以及与危险性行为相关的年轻人中显着的血清流行率。这些发现强调了早期和有针对性的筛查以及强化疫苗接种策略的紧迫性。总之,马达加斯加优化乙型肝炎筛查依赖于快速检测(适合基于社区的筛查)和 ELISA 的互补使用,这对于诊断确认和临床随访至关重要。这种方法代表了在乙型肝炎高流行的情况下减少传播、提高疫苗接种覆盖率和加强乙型肝炎防治工作的战略途径。

title: Establishment of prognostic nomogram in cervical cancer with hepatitis B virus infection: a retrospective study
abstract: Background This study aimed to identify prognostic factors and establish a nomogram for predicting overall survival (OS) in hepatitis B surface antigen-positive (HBsAg-positive) cervical cancer (CC) patients. Methods A retrospective analysis of 149 HBsAg-positive CC patients treated at Yunnan Cancer Hospital (2015–2017) was performed. Cox regression identified independent prognostic factors for nomogram development. The nomogram’s predictive accuracy and discriminative capability were evaluated through Harrell’s concordance index (C-index), calibration plots, and decision curve analysis, and its performance was compared to the International Federation of Gynecology and Obstetrics (FIGO) staging system. Internal validation was conducted using the bootstrap resampling method. Results Multivariate Cox regression analyses identified tumor stage, baseline serum AST levels, antiviral therapy, lymph node status, and treatment modality as independent prognostic factors for patients with HBsAg-positive CC, all of which were incorporated into the nomogram for OS. The Harrell’s C-index of nomogram was 0.817 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.762–0.873), which was higher than that of FIGO staging system 0.700 (95% CI, 0.637–0.764, P < 0.001). Moreover, the nomogram showed superior performance in decision curve analysis (DCA) and a higher area under the curve (AUC) compared to the FIGO staging system. The calibration curve for survival probability exhibited good consistency between the probabilities and observed values. Grouping based on the nomogram’s cutoff value showed that the high-risk group experienced significantly poorer OS than the low-risk group ( P < 0.001). Conclusions This study established a nomogram for the preliminary prognostic evaluation of OS in HBsAg-positive CC patients. Further validation is required prior to its clinical application.

title: Novel HBx-interacting host cellular factors regulate dynamic nuclear and cytoplasmic localization of Hepatitis B virus X protein (HBx).
abstract: The hepatitis B virus (HBV) X protein (HBx) is a key player in viral transcription, replication, and HBV-associated hepatocarcinogenesis. Several novel HBx-interacting host cellular factors: DDX1, DDX3, MOV10 RNA helicases, INI1/hSNF5 chromatin-remodeling factor, Rad18 DNA repair enzyme, and CPSF6 cleavage factor were identified. DDX1, DDX3, and MOV10 colocalized with HBx in cytoplasmic foci or aggregates. In contrast, INI1/hSNF5 and CPSF6 relocalized with HBx in nuclear speckles, interchromatin granule clusters (IGCs), and/or PML-nuclear bodies. Rad18 sequestered HBx in the nucleoli. Importantly, DDX3, MOV10, and INI1/hSNF5 restricted HBV replication, whereas CPSF6 facilitated HBV replication. Furthermore, DDX1 enhanced HBx-mediated NF-κB transcription, whereas MOV10 and Rad18 inhibited it. Altogether, HBx-interacting host factors determine dynamic nuclear and cytoplasmic localization of HBx and regulate HBV replication and HBx-mediated transcription.

title_zh: 新型 HBx 相互作用宿主细胞因子调节乙型肝炎病毒 X 蛋白 (HBx) 的动态核和细胞质定位。
source_body_en: The hepatitis B virus (HBV) X protein (HBx) is a key player in viral transcription, replication, and HBV-associated hepatocarcinogenesis. Several novel HBx-interacting host cellular factors: DDX1, DDX3, MOV10 RNA helicases, INI1/hSNF5 chromatin-remodeling factor, Rad18 DNA repair enzyme, and CPSF6 cleavage factor were identified. DDX1, DDX3, and MOV10 colocalized with HBx in cytoplasmic foci or aggregates. In contrast, INI1/hSNF5 and CPSF6 relocalized with HBx in nuclear speckles, interchromatin granule clusters (IGCs), and/or PML-nuclear bodies. Rad18 sequestered HBx in the nucleoli. Importantly, DDX3, MOV10, and INI1/hSNF5 restricted HBV replication, whereas CPSF6 facilitated HBV replication. Furthermore, DDX1 enhanced HBx-mediated NF-κB transcription, whereas MOV10 and Rad18 inhibited it. Altogether, HBx-interacting host factors determine dynamic nuclear and cytoplasmic localization of HBx and regulate HBV replication and HBx-mediated transcription.
abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) X 蛋白 (HBx) 在病毒转录、复制和 HBV 相关肝癌发生中发挥关键作用。鉴定了几种新的 HBx 相互作用宿主细胞因子:DDX1、DDX3、MOV10 RNA 解旋酶、INI1/hSNF5 染色质重塑因子、Rad18 DNA 修复酶和 CPSF6 裂解因子。DDX1、DDX3 和 MOV10 与 HBx 共定位于细胞质灶或聚集体中。相反,INI1/hSNF5 和 CPSF6 与 HBx 一起重新定位于核斑点、染色质间颗粒簇 (IGC) 和/或 PML 核体中。Rad18 将 HBx 隔离在核仁中。重要的是,DDX3、MOV10 和 INI1/hSNF5 限制 HBV 复制,而 CPSF6 促进 HBV 复制。此外,DDX1 增强 HBx 介导的 NF-κB 转录,而 MOV10 和 Rad18 抑制它。总而言之,HBx 相互作用的宿主因子决定 HBx 的动态核和细胞质定位,并调节 HBV 复制和 HBx 介导的转录。
