analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the public-health problem of transfusion-transmitted infections in multi-transfused patients in southern Iran, where the knowledge gap was the seroprevalence of human T-cell lymphotropic virus (HTLV) in these high-risk groups. The stated objective was to determine HTLV seroprevalence among patients with β-thalassemia major and those on regular hemodialysis.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted in five cities in southern Iran (Dashtestan, Bushehr, Genaveh, Tangestan, and Kangan) between 2023 and 2024. It enrolled all patients with β-thalassemia major and those on regular hemodialysis receiving transfusions, alongside healthy controls.
analysis.methods: Serum samples were screened for HTLV-I/II antibodies using ELISA, with positive results confirmed by Western Blot. Hepatitis-related markers (anti-HCV, anti-HEV IgG, HBsAb, HBV infection criteria) were assessed using serological assays.
analysis.main_results: Among 134 thalassemia patients, 6 (4.48%, 95% CI: 1.83%-9.91%) were HTLV-I/II seropositive, all confirmed as HTLV-1 by Western blot. Hemodialysis patients and controls were HTLV-negative. Among HTLV-1 seropositive thalassemia patients, 4 (66.7%) were anti-HCV positive, 2 (33.4%) were anti-HEV IgG positive, and 5 (83.33%) had HBsAb.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the 4.48% HTLV-1 seroprevalence in thalassemia patients as relatively high and indicative of elevated exposure risk in this population. The novelty lies in documenting HTLV-1 seropositivity in a thalassemia cohort in southern Iran, contrasting with the absence of HTLV in hemodialysis patients and controls.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support targeted HTLV donor screening to reduce transfusion-transmitted HTLV-1 infection in thalassemia patients, given their reliance on frequent transfusions. The study also highlights co-infections (HCV, HEV) in HTLV-1 seropositive patients, underscoring the need for integrated screening.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, small sample size, and lack of adjustment for confounding factors in the association analyses. The evidence is moderate due to these constraints and the absence of longitudinal follow-up.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study in southern Iran assessed HTLV seroprevalence among multi-transfused patients with β-thalassemia major and those on hemodialysis. Among 134 thalassemia patients, 4.48% (95% CI: 1.83%-9.91%) were HTLV-1 seropositive by ELISA and Western blot, while hemodialysis patients and controls were negative. Co-infections with HCV (66.7%) and HEV (33.4%) were observed in HTLV-1 seropositive thalassemia patients, and 83.33% had HBsAb. The authors highlight a relatively high HTLV-1 exposure risk in thalassemia patients and recommend HTLV donor screening to mitigate transfusion-transmitted infection. Limitations include the small sample size, cross-sectional design, and lack of confounding adjustment, warranting cautious interpretation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了伊朗南部多次输血患者中输血传播感染的公共卫生问题,该地区的知识差距在于这些高危人群中人类 T 细胞淋巴细胞病毒 (HTLV) 的血清流行率。既定目标是确定重型 β 地中海贫血患者和定期血液透析患者的 HTLV 血清阳性率。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2023 年至 2024 年间,在伊朗南部的五个城市(达什泰斯坦、布什尔、热纳韦、坦格斯坦和坎甘)进行了一项横断面研究。该研究纳入了所有重型 β 地中海贫血患者、接受输血的定期血液透析患者以及健康对照者。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 ELISA 筛选血清样本中的 HTLV-I/II 抗体,并通过 Western Blot 证实阳性结果。使用血清学检测评估肝炎相关标志物(抗 HCV、抗 HEV IgG、HBsAb、HBV 感染标准)。
elements_zh.main_results: 134例地中海贫血患者中,6例(4.48%,95% CI:1.83%-9.91%)HTLV-I/II血清阳性,经Western blot证实均为HTLV-1。血液透析患者和对照组的 HTLV 均为阴性。HTLV-1血清阳性地中海贫血患者中,抗HCV阳性4例(66.7%),抗HEV IgG阳性2例(33.4%),HBsAb阳性5例(83.33%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将地中海贫血患者中 4.48% 的 HTLV-1 血清阳性率解释为相对较高,表明该人群的暴露风险较高。新颖之处在于记录了伊朗南部地中海贫血队列中的 HTLV-1 血清阳性,而血液透析患者和对照组中不存在 HTLV。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 鉴于地中海贫血患者依赖频繁输血,这些研究结果支持有针对性的 HTLV 供体筛查,以减少通过输血传播的 HTLV-1 感染。该研究还强调了 HTLV-1 血清阳性患者的合并感染(HCV、HEV),强调了综合筛查的必要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横断面设计、样本量小以及关联分析中缺乏对混杂因素调整的限制。由于这些限制和缺乏纵向随访,证据是中等的。

title: Vaccination status and associated factors among healthcare workers providing primary care: a cross-sectional study in Yaounde, Cameroon
abstract: Background: Healthcare workers (HCWs) are at increased risk of exposure to vaccine-preventable diseases, including hepatitis B, tuberculosis (TB), and tetanus, due to their occupational environment. Despite the availability of safe and effective vaccines, vaccination coverage among HCWs remains suboptimal in many low- and middle-income countries. This study aimed to determine the vaccination coverage for hepatitis B, tuberculosis, and tetanus among HCWs in district hospitals in Yaounde, Cameroon, and to identify factors associated with incomplete vaccination. Methods: A cross-sectional analytical study was conducted from January to June 2024 across all seven district hospitals in Yaounde. A total of 406 HCWs were enrolled using a structured, self-administered questionnaire. Incomplete vaccination status was defined as nit having received three doses for hepatitis B, at least two doses for TB, and at least three doses for tetanus. Data were analyzed using R Statistics version 4.3.3. Bivariate and multivariate logistic regression models were used to identify predictors of incomplete vaccination, with statistical significance set at p < 0.05. Results: Most of participants were female (75.6%) and aged 30-44 years (65.5%). Full vaccination coverage was 36.2% for hepatitis B, 15.8% for tuberculosis, and 53.4% for tetanus. Unvaccinated proportions were 43.1% for hepatitis B, 0.5% for tuberculosis, and 17.2% for tetanus. Multivariate analysis revealed that HCWs aged 55-66 years were significantly less likely to be incompletely vaccinated against hepatitis B compared to those aged 19-29 years (aOR = 0.07; 95% CI: 0.01-0.39; p = 0.004). Nurses and laboratory technicians were more likely to be incompletely vaccinated than doctors (aOR = 7.06; 95% CI: 3.82-13.6; p < 0.001 and aOR = 3.78; 95% CI: 1.73-8.52; p = 0.001, respectively). Longer professional experience was protective against incomplete vaccination for all three vaccines (p < 0.05). The main barriers to vaccination included high cost, doubts about the need for vaccination, and concerns about side effects. Conclusions: Vaccination coverage for hepatitis B, tuberculosis, and tetanus among HCWs in Yaounde remains suboptimal, particularly for hepatitis B. Addressing financial barriers, improving access to vaccines, and implementing targeted educational interventions are essential to enhance vaccine uptake and protect both HCWs and their patients from preventable occupational infections.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于其职业环境,医护人员 (HCW) 接触疫苗可预防疾病的风险增加,包括乙型肝炎、结核病 (TB) 和破伤风。本研究旨在确定喀麦隆雅温得地区医院医护人员的乙型肝炎、结核病和破伤风疫苗接种覆盖率,并确定与疫苗接种不完全相关的因素。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024 年 1 月至 6 月,在雅温得所有七家地区医院进行了一项横断面分析研究,使用结构化、自填式问卷调查总共招募了 406 名医护人员。
elements_zh.methods: 使用结构化、自填问卷收集数据,并使用 R Statistics 4.3.3 版进行分析。使用双变量和多变量逻辑回归模型来确定不完全疫苗接种的预测因素,统计显着性设置为 p < 0.05。
elements_zh.main_results: 乙型肝炎、结核病和破伤风疫苗的全面疫苗接种覆盖率分别为 36.2%、15.8% 和 53.4%。多变量分析显示,与 19-29 岁的医护人员相比,55-66 岁的医护人员未完全接种乙型肝炎疫苗的可能性明显较低(aOR = 0.07;95% CI:0.01-0.39;p = 0.004)。护士和实验室技术人员比医生更有可能未完全接种疫苗(分别为 aOR = 7.06;95% CI:3.82-13.6;p < 0.001;aOR = 3.78;95% CI:1.73-8.52;p = 0.001)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 雅温得医务人员的乙型肝炎、结核病和破伤风疫苗接种覆盖率仍然不够理想,特别是乙型肝炎。该研究确定了与疫苗接种不完整相关的具体因素,包括年龄、职业和专业经验长度。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调,需要采取有针对性的干预措施来提高医护人员的疫苗接种覆盖率,特别是解决财务障碍、改善疫苗的获取以及实施教育干预措施,以提高疫苗接种率并保护医护人员及其患者免受可预防的职业感染。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究没有报告研究结果对其他地区或医疗机构的普遍性。由于横截面设计和对自我报告数据的依赖,证据强度中等。

title_zh: 提供初级保健的医护人员的疫苗接种状况和相关因素:喀麦隆雅温得的一项横断面研究
source_body_en: Background: Healthcare workers (HCWs) are at increased risk of exposure to vaccine-preventable diseases, including hepatitis B, tuberculosis (TB), and tetanus, due to their occupational environment. Despite the availability of safe and effective vaccines, vaccination coverage among HCWs remains suboptimal in many low- and middle-income countries. This study aimed to determine the vaccination coverage for hepatitis B, tuberculosis, and tetanus among HCWs in district hospitals in Yaounde, Cameroon, and to identify factors associated with incomplete vaccination. Methods: A cross-sectional analytical study was conducted from January to June 2024 across all seven district hospitals in Yaounde. A total of 406 HCWs were enrolled using a structured, self-administered questionnaire. Incomplete vaccination status was defined as nit having received three doses for hepatitis B, at least two doses for TB, and at least three doses for tetanus. Data were analyzed using R Statistics version 4.3.3. Bivariate and multivariate logistic regression models were used to identify predictors of incomplete vaccination, with statistical significance set at p < 0.05. Results: Most of participants were female (75.6%) and aged 30-44 years (65.5%). Full vaccination coverage was 36.2% for hepatitis B, 15.8% for tuberculosis, and 53.4% for tetanus. Unvaccinated proportions were 43.1% for hepatitis B, 0.5% for tuberculosis, and 17.2% for tetanus. Multivariate analysis revealed that HCWs aged 55-66 years were significantly less likely to be incompletely vaccinated against hepatitis B compared to those aged 19-29 years (aOR = 0.07; 95% CI: 0.01-0.39; p = 0.004). Nurses and laboratory technicians were more likely to be incompletely vaccinated than doctors (aOR = 7.06; 95% CI: 3.82-13.6; p < 0.001 and aOR = 3.78; 95% CI: 1.73-8.52; p = 0.001, respectively). Longer professional experience was protective against incomplete vaccination for all three vaccines (p < 0.05). The main barriers to vaccination included high cost, doubts about the need for vaccination, and concerns about side effects. Conclusions: Vaccination coverage for hepatitis B, tuberculosis, and tetanus among HCWs in Yaounde remains suboptimal, particularly for hepatitis B. Addressing financial barriers, improving access to vaccines, and implementing targeted educational interventions are essential to enhance vaccine uptake and protect both HCWs and their patients from preventable occupational infections.
abstract_zh: 背景:由于其职业环境,医护人员 (HCW) 接触疫苗可预防疾病的风险增加,包括乙型肝炎、结核病 (TB) 和破伤风。尽管可以获得安全有效的疫苗,但许多低收入和中等收入国家医护人员的疫苗接种覆盖率仍然不够理想。本研究旨在确定喀麦隆雅温得地区医院医护人员的乙型肝炎、结核病和破伤风疫苗接种覆盖率,并确定与疫苗接种不完全相关的因素。方法:2024 年 1 月至 6 月在雅温得所有七家地区医院进行了一项横断面分析研究。共有 406 名医护人员通过结构化、自填式问卷进行了登记。不完整的疫苗接种状态定义为已接受三剂乙型肝炎疫苗、至少两剂结核病疫苗和至少三剂破伤风疫苗。使用 R Statistics 版本 4.3.3 分析数据。使用双变量和多变量逻辑回归模型来确定不完全疫苗接种的预测因素,统计显着性设置为 p < 0.05。结果:大多数参与者为女性(75.6%),年龄在 30-44 岁(65.5%)。乙型肝炎、结核病和破伤风疫苗的全面疫苗接种覆盖率分别为 36.2%、15.8% 和 53.4%。乙型肝炎未接种疫苗的比例为 43.1%,结核病未接种疫苗的比例为 0.5%,破伤风疫苗未接种的比例为 17.2%。多变量分析显示,与 19-29 岁的医护人员相比,55-66 岁的医护人员未完全接种乙型肝炎疫苗的可能性明显较低(aOR = 0.07;95% CI:0.01-0.39;p = 0.004)。护士和实验室技术人员比医生更有可能未完全接种疫苗(分别为 aOR = 7.06;95% CI:3.82-13.6;p < 0.001;aOR = 3.78;95% CI:1.73-8.52;p = 0.001)。较长的专业经验可以防止所有三种疫苗的疫苗接种不完全(p < 0.05)。疫苗接种的主要障碍包括成本高、对疫苗接种必要性的怀疑以及对副作用的担忧。结论:雅温得医护人员的乙型肝炎、结核病和破伤风疫苗接种覆盖率仍然不够理想,特别是乙型肝炎。解决经济障碍、改善疫苗的获取以及实施有针对性的教育干预措施对于提高疫苗接种率并保护医护人员及其患者免受可预防的职业感染至关重要。

title: Monitoring of the Cascade of Care in Patients With Chronic HBV in Primary Care Clinics in Australia.
abstract: To achieve hepatitis B virus (HBV) elimination in Australia, a shift from hospital to community-based care is needed. This study aimed to describe the prevalence of chronic HBV and uptake of the cascade of care in primary care patients. This prospective cohort study was conducted in 76 urban and regional primary care clinics across Victoria, Australia between 1/7/2020 and 30/6/2023. Anonymised socio-demographic, clinical and laboratory data from general practice (GP) clinics' electronic medical records (EMR) were extracted. Descriptive analysis of the cohort of clinic clients with HBV was performed. A total of 346,927 individuals attended appointments across the study period. Of these, 25,212 had records indicating HBV-related testing. 491 (0.14%) individuals had evidence of current HBV infection defined as HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) positive and/or HBV DNA positive. 469 attended the clinics during the study period, among whom 239 (51%) were female. In the GP EMR, only 59 (13%) had evidence of at least one HBV DNA test and at least one ALT test ordered. Fourteen patients (3%) had record of being reviewed for HBV management by the clinic nurse or GP and 78 (17%) reviewed by a viral hepatitis specialist. Ninety-two (20%) were on treatment for HBV. Of people receiving treatment, 23 (25%) had a record of linkage to specialist care. Our data show that significant gaps in the cascade of care remain for people with chronic HBV in primary care settings, with a low proportion of patients having evidence of participating in all stages of the HBV cascade of care.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in primary care settings in Australia, focusing on the cascade of care, including prevalence, testing, monitoring, and treatment uptake among patients in urban and regional clinics. The central question addresses the gaps in the HBV care continuum within primary care and the feasibility of shifting HBV management from hospital-based to community-based care to support elimination goals.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review synthesizes data from a prospective cohort study conducted in 76 primary care clinics across Victoria, Australia, between 1 July 2020 and 30 June 2023. It analyzed anonymized socio-demographic, clinical, and laboratory data extracted from general practice electronic medical records (EMR), including HBV-related testing, HBV DNA and ALT test orders, specialist reviews, and treatment records. The study performed descriptive analysis of clients with HBV.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review identifies a low proportion of patients with chronic HBV in primary care settings participating in all stages of the cascade of care. Only 13% had evidence of both HBV DNA and ALT testing, 3% were reviewed for HBV management by clinic staff, 17% by a viral hepatitis specialist, and 20% were on treatment. Among those treated, only 25% had a record of linkage to specialist care, highlighting significant gaps in monitoring and management.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights substantial heterogeneity in the uptake of HBV cascade of care stages, with very low rates of comprehensive testing (HBV DNA and ALT) and specialist linkage despite a defined cohort of 491 HBsAg/HBV DNA-positive individuals. The lack of standardized documentation in EMRs and the absence of detailed clinical outcomes or longitudinal follow-up limit the ability to assess sustained care quality or identify barriers to care.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review underscores the need for improved integration of HBV monitoring and management protocols within primary care EMR systems, including standardized testing and specialist linkage pathways. It calls for targeted interventions to enhance the cascade of care, particularly for patients on treatment, and for policy initiatives to support the transition of HBV care from hospital to community settings to meet elimination targets.

analysis.summary_en: This review examines the cascade of care for chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) in Australian primary care clinics, focusing on gaps in testing, monitoring, and treatment. Data from 76 clinics in Victoria (2020–2023) show that among 491 HBsAg/HBV DNA-positive patients, only 13% had both HBV DNA and ALT testing, 3% were reviewed for HBV management by clinic staff, 17% by specialists, and 20% were on treatment. Among those treated, only 25% had specialist linkage. These findings reveal significant deficiencies in the HBV care continuum, with heterogeneity in care participation and limited EMR documentation. The review emphasizes the urgent need for standardized primary care protocols, improved EMR integration, and policy-driven shifts from hospital to community-based HBV care to advance elimination goals.

analysis_en.scope_and_question: The review examines chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in primary care settings in Australia, focusing on the cascade of care, including prevalence, testing, monitoring, and treatment uptake among patients in urban and regional clinics. The central question addresses the gaps in the HBV care continuum within primary care and the feasibility of shifting HBV management from hospital-based to community-based care to support elimination goals.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review synthesizes data from a prospective cohort study conducted in 76 primary care clinics across Victoria, Australia, between 1 July 2020 and 30 June 2023. It analyzed anonymized socio-demographic, clinical, and laboratory data extracted from general practice electronic medical records (EMR), including HBV-related testing, HBV DNA and ALT test orders, specialist reviews, and treatment records. The study performed descriptive analysis of clients with HBV.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review identifies a low proportion of patients with chronic HBV in primary care settings participating in all stages of the cascade of care. Only 13% had evidence of both HBV DNA and ALT testing, 3% were reviewed for HBV management by clinic staff, 17% by a viral hepatitis specialist, and 20% were on treatment. Among those treated, only 25% had a record of linkage to specialist care, highlighting significant gaps in monitoring and management.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights substantial heterogeneity in the uptake of HBV cascade of care stages, with very low rates of comprehensive testing (HBV DNA and ALT) and specialist linkage despite a defined cohort of 491 HBsAg/HBV DNA-positive individuals. The lack of standardized documentation in EMRs and the absence of detailed clinical outcomes or longitudinal follow-up limit the ability to assess sustained care quality or identify barriers to care.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: The review underscores the need for improved integration of HBV monitoring and management protocols within primary care EMR systems, including standardized testing and specialist linkage pathways. It calls for targeted interventions to enhance the cascade of care, particularly for patients on treatment, and for policy initiatives to support the transition of HBV care from hospital to community settings to meet elimination targets.

title_zh: 澳大利亚初级保健诊所对慢性乙型肝炎患者的级联护理监测。
source_body_en: To achieve hepatitis B virus (HBV) elimination in Australia, a shift from hospital to community-based care is needed. This study aimed to describe the prevalence of chronic HBV and uptake of the cascade of care in primary care patients. This prospective cohort study was conducted in 76 urban and regional primary care clinics across Victoria, Australia between 1/7/2020 and 30/6/2023. Anonymised socio-demographic, clinical and laboratory data from general practice (GP) clinics' electronic medical records (EMR) were extracted. Descriptive analysis of the cohort of clinic clients with HBV was performed. A total of 346,927 individuals attended appointments across the study period. Of these, 25,212 had records indicating HBV-related testing. 491 (0.14%) individuals had evidence of current HBV infection defined as HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) positive and/or HBV DNA positive. 469 attended the clinics during the study period, among whom 239 (51%) were female. In the GP EMR, only 59 (13%) had evidence of at least one HBV DNA test and at least one ALT test ordered. Fourteen patients (3%) had record of being reviewed for HBV management by the clinic nurse or GP and 78 (17%) reviewed by a viral hepatitis specialist. Ninety-two (20%) were on treatment for HBV. Of people receiving treatment, 23 (25%) had a record of linkage to specialist care. Our data show that significant gaps in the cascade of care remain for people with chronic HBV in primary care settings, with a low proportion of patients having evidence of participating in all stages of the HBV cascade of care.

title: High-resolution mapping of chromatin conformation in HBeAg-treated macrophage provides insights into pathogenesis of HBV-related liver diseases
abstract: Background Hepatitis B virus (HBV) e antigen (HBeAg) plays a critical role in inducing macrophage activation and subsequent immune tolerance, which facilitates viral immune escape. However, the underlying spatial 3D genomic and epigenetic mechanisms driving this macrophage dysfunction remain largely unknown. Methods To map the topological and transcriptional regulatory landscape, we integrated RNA-sequencing (RNA-seq), high-throughput chromosome conformation capture (Hi-C), and chromatin immunoprecipitation-sequencing (ChIP-seq) to comprehensively analyze control and HBeAg-stimulated macrophages. Key findings were cross-validated using human HBV-infected datasets. Result HBeAg robustly activated pro-inflammatory transcriptional programs, prominently featuring the TNF signaling pathway as a central node. Hi-C analysis revealed profound global 3D chromatin reorganization accompanying this phenotypic shift. Specifically, inactive-to-active (B-to-A) compartment switching, coupled with de novo H3K27ac enhancer accumulation, directly drove the upregulation of functional genes such as MET and FHOD3. Furthermore, topologically associating domain (TAD) restructuring, particularly TAD merging, exposed new regulatory elements to upregulate FLNB and SESN2. Conversely, the disruption of specific intrachromosomal loops resulted in the targeted downregulation of genes like KBTBD11 and BLVRB. Mechanistically, targeted epigenetic reprogramming drove this 3D structural rewiring: H3K27ac enhancer deposition was enriched for AP-1/STAT motifs, CTCF coordinated with FOX-family factors to alter structural boundaries, and HLTF mediated targeted H3K27me3-associated gene silencing. Conclusion HBeAg orchestrates a highly coordinated hierarchical restructuring of the 3D genome and targeted epigenetic reprogramming to induce macrophage dysfunction. The identified structural variants and core spatial-target genes (such as MET, FLNB, and BLVRB) provide novel mechanistic insights and represent potential therapeutic targets for HBV-related liver diseases.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is associated with immune tolerance mediated by HBV e antigen (HBeAg), yet the spatial 3D genomic and epigenetic mechanisms underlying macrophage dysfunction remain poorly understood. The study aimed to elucidate how HBeAg reprograms macrophage chromatin architecture and transcriptional programs to drive immune evasion.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study integrated RNA-sequencing, high-throughput chromosome conformation capture (Hi-C), and chromatin immunoprecipitation-sequencing (ChIP-seq) to analyze control and HBeAg-stimulated macrophages. Key findings were cross-validated using human HBV-infected datasets.
analysis.methods: RNA-seq, Hi-C, and ChIP-seq were used to map the topological and transcriptional regulatory landscape in macrophages exposed to HBeAg. Epigenetic reprogramming was analyzed through H3K27ac enhancer deposition, CTCF-mediated structural boundary alterations, and HLTF-associated H3K27me3 gene silencing.
analysis.main_results: HBeAg stimulation robustly activated pro-inflammatory transcriptional programs, with the TNF signaling pathway identified as a central node. Hi-C revealed global 3D chromatin reorganization, including inactive-to-active compartment switching, de novo H3K27ac enhancer accumulation, and topologically associating domain (TAD) restructuring such as TAD merging.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that HBeAg orchestrates a hierarchical restructuring of the 3D genome and targeted epigenetic reprogramming to induce macrophage dysfunction. Novel mechanistic insights include the identification of structural variants and core spatial-target genes (e.g., MET, FLNB, BLVRB) as potential therapeutic targets.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that targeting the identified epigenetic and chromatin structural alterations may offer therapeutic strategies for HBV-related liver diseases by modulating macrophage-mediated immune tolerance.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro macrophage models and cross-validation with human datasets, which may not fully capture in vivo complexity. The evidence strength is moderate due to the abstract-only scope and lack of functional validation of identified targets.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated how HBV e antigen (HBeAg) reprograms macrophage chromatin architecture and transcriptional programs to drive immune evasion in chronic hepatitis B infection. Using RNA-seq, Hi-C, and ChIP-seq, the authors demonstrated that HBeAg robustly activates pro-inflammatory pathways, particularly TNF signaling, while inducing global 3D chromatin reorganization. Key mechanisms included inactive-to-active compartment switching, de novo enhancer accumulation, and topologically associating domain restructuring. Epigenetic reprogramming involved H3K27ac deposition, CTCF-mediated boundary alterations, and HLTF-associated gene silencing. The identified structural variants and spatial-target genes (e.g., MET, FLNB, BLVRB) were proposed as novel therapeutic targets for HBV-related liver diseases. However, the study’s abstract-only scope and reliance on in vitro models limit the generalizability of findings, warranting further in vivo validation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 慢性乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染与 HBV e 抗原 (HBeAg) 介导的免疫耐受相关,但巨噬细胞功能障碍背后的空间 3D 基因组和表观遗传机制仍知之甚少。该研究旨在阐明 HBeAg 如何重新编程巨噬细胞染色质结构和转录程序以驱动免疫逃避。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究整合了 RNA 测序、高通量染色体构象捕获 (Hi-C) 和染色质免疫沉淀测序 (ChIP-seq) 来分析对照和 HBeAg 刺激的巨噬细胞。使用人类 HBV 感染数据集对主要发现进行了交叉验证。
elements_zh.methods: RNA-seq、Hi-C 和 ChIP-seq 用于绘制暴露于 HBeAg 的巨噬细胞的拓扑和转录调控图谱。通过 H3K27ac 增强子沉积、CTCF 介导的结构边界改变和 HLTF 相关的 H3K27me3 基因沉默来分析表观遗传重编程。
elements_zh.main_results: HBeAg 刺激强有力地激活了促炎转录程序,其中 TNF 信号通路被确定为中心节点。Hi-C 揭示了全局 3D 染色质重组,包括非活性到活性区室转换、H3K27ac 增强子从头积累以及拓扑关联域 (TAD) 重组(例如 TAD 合并)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,HBeAg 精心策划了 3D 基因组的分层重组和有针对性的表观遗传重编程,以诱导巨噬细胞功能障碍。新颖的机制见解包括识别结构变异和核心空间靶基因(例如 MET、FLNB、BLVRB)作为潜在的治疗靶点。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,针对已确定的表观遗传和染色质结构改变可能通过调节巨噬细胞介导的免疫耐受为 HBV 相关肝病提供治疗策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外巨噬细胞模型以及与人类数据集的交叉验证,可能无法完全捕捉体内的复杂性。由于仅限抽象范围且缺乏对已识别目标的功能验证,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.main_results: HBeAg 刺激强有力地激活了促炎转录程序,其中 TNF 信号通路被确定为中心节点。Hi-C 揭示了全局 3D 染色质重组,包括非活性到活性区室转换、H3K27ac 增强子从头积累以及拓扑关联域 (TAD) 重组(例如 TAD 合并)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,HBeAg 精心策划了 3D 基因组的分层重组和有针对性的表观遗传重编程,以诱导巨噬细胞功能障碍。新颖的机制见解包括识别结构变异和核心空间靶基因(例如 MET、FLNB、BLVRB)作为潜在的治疗靶点。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,针对已确定的表观遗传和染色质结构改变可能通过调节巨噬细胞介导的免疫耐受为 HBV 相关肝病提供治疗策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外巨噬细胞模型以及与人类数据集的交叉验证,可能无法完全捕捉体内的复杂性。由于仅限抽象范围且缺乏对已识别目标的功能验证,证据强度中等。

title: Pegylated interferon for chronic hepatitis delta: does it still have a role in the bulevirtide era?
abstract: Chronic hepatitis delta is the most aggressive form of chronic viral hepatitis. Although pegylated interferon alfa (PegIFNα) has been the reference treatment for decades, the recent introduction of bulevirtide raises questions about its current role. To evaluate our real-world experience with PegIFNα, we conducted an observational, retrospective, single-centre study including patients with chronic hepatitis delta virus infection followed between 2014 and 2026. Fifteen patients were included, of whom 8 received PegIFNα. Toxicity was common, mainly due to haematological adverse effects, although flu-like symptoms and one serious neuropsychiatric event were also recorded. Of seven patients who completed treatment, two achieved a sustained virological response. Both patients also achieved HBV functional cure, being the only patients in the cohort to reach this endpoint. Our results confirm the considerable toxicity and limited efficacy of PegIFNα, but also its capacity to induce a sustained virological response and HBV functional cure in a subgroup of patients. In the bulevirtide era, PegIFNα remains a valid treatment option in selected patients given its curative potential.

title: HBV-Specific T Cell Responses for Short-Term Hepatitis Progression Prediction: A Comparative, Interpretable Machine Learning Study.
abstract: BACKGROUND & AIMS: As central determinants of viral control and immunopathology, hepatitis B virus (HBV)-specific T-cell responses provide more clinically meaningful information than routine biochemical and virological markers. Nevertheless, most existing prediction models rely primarily on clinical parameters and rarely incorporate HBV-specific T-cell responses, potentially limiting their predictive performance and biological interpretability. To develop an accurate and interpretable model for predicting hepatitis progression, we evaluated diverse machine learning (ML) methods integrating multisource data. METHODS: We enrolled a cohort of 479 patients and divided them into training and testing cohorts based on admission time. Clinical data, treatment regimens, and HBV-specific T-cell immune responses were collected. A comprehensive benchmarking of 10 ML models was conducted through 5-fold cross-validation on the training cohort across varying feature combinations and algorithmic performances. The ML models were independently evaluated on the testing cohort, and significant predictive factors were identified. RESULTS: Based on alanine aminotransferase (ALT) levels at 6- and 12-month follow-ups, the patients were stratified into hepatitis (ALT > 40 U/L) and non-hepatitis (ALT ≤ 40 U/L) groups. The predictive performance was significantly improved after integrating clinical indicator features (CIF) and HBV-specific T-cell features (STCF). An XGBoost model based on six selected features (three CIF and three STCF) demonstrated especially robust performance, achieving AUCs of 0.874 (validation) and 0.880 (testing) at 6 months follow up and 0.851 (validation) and 0.845 (testing) at 12 months. To facilitate clinical application, a web-based tool was developed for personalized risk assessment. CONCLUSIONS: Incorporating HBV-specific T-cell responses into the predictive framework improves the prediction of disease progression among HBV-infected individuals. The developed interpretable model is a potentially valuable tool for early risk stratification, facilitating proactive monitoring.

title_zh: 用于短期肝炎进展预测的 HBV 特异性 T 细胞反应:一项可比较、可解释的机器学习研究。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND & AIMS: As central determinants of viral control and immunopathology, hepatitis B virus (HBV)-specific T-cell responses provide more clinically meaningful information than routine biochemical and virological markers. Nevertheless, most existing prediction models rely primarily on clinical parameters and rarely incorporate HBV-specific T-cell responses, potentially limiting their predictive performance and biological interpretability. To develop an accurate and interpretable model for predicting hepatitis progression, we evaluated diverse machine learning (ML) methods integrating multisource data. METHODS: We enrolled a cohort of 479 patients and divided them into training and testing cohorts based on admission time. Clinical data, treatment regimens, and HBV-specific T-cell immune responses were collected. A comprehensive benchmarking of 10 ML models was conducted through 5-fold cross-validation on the training cohort across varying feature combinations and algorithmic performances. The ML models were independently evaluated on the testing cohort, and significant predictive factors were identified. RESULTS: Based on alanine aminotransferase (ALT) levels at 6- and 12-month follow-ups, the patients were stratified into hepatitis (ALT > 40 U/L) and non-hepatitis (ALT ≤ 40 U/L) groups. The predictive performance was significantly improved after integrating clinical indicator features (CIF) and HBV-specific T-cell features (STCF). An XGBoost model based on six selected features (three CIF and three STCF) demonstrated especially robust performance, achieving AUCs of 0.874 (validation) and 0.880 (testing) at 6 months follow up and 0.851 (validation) and 0.845 (testing) at 12 months. To facilitate clinical application, a web-based tool was developed for personalized risk assessment. CONCLUSIONS: Incorporating HBV-specific T-cell responses into the predictive framework improves the prediction of disease progression among HBV-infected individuals. The developed interpretable model is a potentially valuable tool for early risk stratification, facilitating proactive monitoring.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的:作为病毒控制和免疫病理学的核心决定因素,乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 特异性 T 细胞反应比常规生化和病毒学标志物提供更多具有临床意义的信息。然而,大多数现有的预测模型主要依赖于临床参数,很少纳入 HBV 特异性 T 细胞反应,这可能限制了它们的预测性能和生物学可解释性。为了开发准确且可解释的模型来预测肝炎进展,我们评估了集成多源数据的多种机器学习 (ML) 方法。方法:我们招募了 479 名患者,并根据入院时间将其分为训练组和测试组。收集临床数据、治疗方案和 HBV 特异性 T 细胞免疫反应。通过对不同特征组合和算法性能的训练队列进行 5 倍交叉验证,对 10 个 ML 模型进行了全面基准测试。机器学习模型在测试队列中进行了独立评估,并确定了重要的预测因素。结果:根据6个月和12个月随访时的丙氨酸转氨酶(ALT)水平,将患者分为肝炎组(ALT > 40 U/L)和非肝炎组(ALT ≤ 40 U/L)。整合临床指标特征(CIF)和 HBV 特异性 T 细胞特征(STCF)后,预测性能显着提高。基于六个选定特征(三个 CIF 和三个 STCF)的 XGBoost 模型表现出特别强大的性能,在 6 个月的随访中实现了 0.874(验证)和 0.880(测试)的 AUC,在 12 个月时实现了 0.851(验证)和 0.845(测试)的 AUC。为了促进临床应用,开发了一种基于网络的工具来进行个性化风险评估。结论:将 HBV 特异性 T 细胞反应纳入预测框架可以改善 HBV 感染者疾病进展的预测。开发的可解释模型是早期风险分层的潜在有价值的工具,有助于主动监测。

title: Electrophoresis-assisted SERS-LFA strip for simultaneous HIV and HBV detection.
abstract: This study presents an electrophoresis-assisted surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS)-based lateral flow assay (E-SERS-LFA) for the simultaneous detection of human immunodeficiency virus p24 antigen (HIV p24) and hepatitis B virus surface antigen (HBsAg), addressing early diagnostic needs in high-risk populations. The system applies a voltage to drive charged viral antigens across a nitrocellulose (NC) membrane, thereby improving separation and enrichment prior to detection using Raman-encoded SERS nanotags. This process effectively addresses limitations of conventional lateral flow assays, including low sensitivity and specificity at low antigen concentrations and within complex biological matrices. Compared to conventional colorimetric and SERS-LFA platforms, the E-SERS-LFA achieved over 15-fold lower detection limits and strong selectivity in mixed sera. These results demonstrate the considerable potential of the E-SERS-LFA for point-of-care diagnostics, enabling timely detection and management of HIV/HBV co-infections.

title_zh: 电泳辅助 SERS-LFA 条带可同时检测 HIV 和 HBV。
source_body_en: This study presents an electrophoresis-assisted surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS)-based lateral flow assay (E-SERS-LFA) for the simultaneous detection of human immunodeficiency virus p24 antigen (HIV p24) and hepatitis B virus surface antigen (HBsAg), addressing early diagnostic needs in high-risk populations. The system applies a voltage to drive charged viral antigens across a nitrocellulose (NC) membrane, thereby improving separation and enrichment prior to detection using Raman-encoded SERS nanotags. This process effectively addresses limitations of conventional lateral flow assays, including low sensitivity and specificity at low antigen concentrations and within complex biological matrices. Compared to conventional colorimetric and SERS-LFA platforms, the E-SERS-LFA achieved over 15-fold lower detection limits and strong selectivity in mixed sera. These results demonstrate the considerable potential of the E-SERS-LFA for point-of-care diagnostics, enabling timely detection and management of HIV/HBV co-infections.

title: AURKA regulates HBV-induced hepatic stellate cell inflammation and liver fibrosis by modulating K48-linked ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation of TLR3
abstract: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB), caused by persistent hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection, continues to pose a major global health threat. Aurora kinase A (AURKA) has been implicated in fibrosis, yet its role in HBV-induced liver fibrosis remains unclear. This study investigated the function and mechanism of AURKA in hepatic stellate cell (HSC) activation and fibrogenesis during CHB. Bioinformatics screening of GSE83148 dataset and validation in human CHB liver specimens, LX-2 HSCs treated with conditioned medium (CM) from HBV-replicating cells, and a persistent HBV recombinant cccDNA (rcccDNA) mouse model established by tail-vein injection of Ad/rcccDNA were performed. Gene and protein expression was analyzed by quantitative PCR and immunoblotting, respectively. Cytokine levels were measured by ELISA. Mitochondrial function was assessed via ROS and JC-1 assays. Protein interactions and ubiquitination were evaluated by co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP) and protein stability assays. In additional experiments, LX-2 cells were stimulated with purified HBV virions at varying MOIs to assess direct viral effects. AURKA was significantly upregulated in CHB patients and HBV-CM-treated LX-2 HSCs. In LX-2 HSCs, AURKA knockdown attenuated HBV-CM-induced inflammatory cytokine secretion (IL‐1β, IL‐6), mitochondrial dysfunction (mitochondrial ROS, mitochondrial membrane potential), HSC proliferation, and fibrotic marker expression (COL I, α-SMA). Mechanistically, AURKA interacted with TLR3 and was associated with its K48-linked polyubiquitination and degradation. TLR3 silencing abolished the protective effects of AURKA knockdown. In vivo, using a persistent HBV rcccDNA mouse model, AURKA knockdown ameliorated HBV-induced hepatic inflammation and fibrosis by upregulating TLR3. Notably, purified HBV virions alone were sufficient to dose-dependently induce AURKA expression and downstream fibrotic responses in HSCs. This study identifies a novel AURKA/TLR3 axis that regulates HBV-induced HSC activation and liver fibrosis, positioning AURKA as a potential therapeutic target for CHB-associated fibrosis.

title_zh: AURKA 通过调节 TLR3 的 K48 泛素化和蛋白酶体降解来调节 HBV 诱导的肝星状细胞炎症和肝纤维化
source_body_en: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB), caused by persistent hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection, continues to pose a major global health threat. Aurora kinase A (AURKA) has been implicated in fibrosis, yet its role in HBV-induced liver fibrosis remains unclear. This study investigated the function and mechanism of AURKA in hepatic stellate cell (HSC) activation and fibrogenesis during CHB. Bioinformatics screening of GSE83148 dataset and validation in human CHB liver specimens, LX-2 HSCs treated with conditioned medium (CM) from HBV-replicating cells, and a persistent HBV recombinant cccDNA (rcccDNA) mouse model established by tail-vein injection of Ad/rcccDNA were performed. Gene and protein expression was analyzed by quantitative PCR and immunoblotting, respectively. Cytokine levels were measured by ELISA. Mitochondrial function was assessed via ROS and JC-1 assays. Protein interactions and ubiquitination were evaluated by co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP) and protein stability assays. In additional experiments, LX-2 cells were stimulated with purified HBV virions at varying MOIs to assess direct viral effects. AURKA was significantly upregulated in CHB patients and HBV-CM-treated LX-2 HSCs. In LX-2 HSCs, AURKA knockdown attenuated HBV-CM-induced inflammatory cytokine secretion (IL‐1β, IL‐6), mitochondrial dysfunction (mitochondrial ROS, mitochondrial membrane potential), HSC proliferation, and fibrotic marker expression (COL I, α-SMA). Mechanistically, AURKA interacted with TLR3 and was associated with its K48-linked polyubiquitination and degradation. TLR3 silencing abolished the protective effects of AURKA knockdown. In vivo, using a persistent HBV rcccDNA mouse model, AURKA knockdown ameliorated HBV-induced hepatic inflammation and fibrosis by upregulating TLR3. Notably, purified HBV virions alone were sufficient to dose-dependently induce AURKA expression and downstream fibrotic responses in HSCs. This study identifies a novel AURKA/TLR3 axis that regulates HBV-induced HSC activation and liver fibrosis, positioning AURKA as a potential therapeutic target for CHB-associated fibrosis.
abstract_zh: 由持续乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染引起的慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)继续对全球健康构成重大威胁。极光激酶 A (AURKA) 与纤维化有关,但其在 HBV 诱导的肝纤维化中的作用仍不清楚。本研究探讨了 AURKA 在 CHB 期间肝星状细胞 (HSC) 激活和纤维形成中的功能和机制。对 GSE83148 数据集进行生物信息学筛选,并在人 CHB 肝脏标本、用来自 HBV 复制细胞的条件培养基 (CM) 处理的 LX-2 HSC 以及通过尾静脉注射 Ad/rcccDNA 建立的持久性 HBV 重组 cccDNA (rcccDNA) 小鼠模型中进行验证。分别通过定量PCR和免疫印迹分析基因和蛋白质表达。通过ELISA测量细胞因子水平。通过 ROS 和 JC-1 测定评估线粒体功能。通过免疫共沉淀 (Co-IP) 和蛋白质稳定性测定评估蛋白质相互作用和泛素化。在其他实验中,用纯化的 HBV 病毒粒子以不同的 MOI 刺激 LX-2 细胞,以评估直接病毒效应。AURKA 在 CHB 患者和 HBV-CM 治疗的 LX-2 HSC 中显着上调。在 LX-2 HSC 中,AURKA 敲低减弱了 HBV-CM 诱导的炎症细胞因子分泌(IL-1β、IL-6)、线粒体功能障碍(线粒体 ROS、线粒体膜电位)、HSC 增殖和纤维化标志物表达(COL I、α-SMA)。从机制上讲,AURKA 与 TLR3 相互作用,并与其 K48 连接的多聚泛素化和降解相关。TLR3 沉默消除了 AURKA 敲低的保护作用。在体内,使用持续性 HBV rcccDNA 小鼠模型,AURKA 敲低通过上调 TLR3 改善 HBV 诱导的肝脏炎症和纤维化。值得注意的是,单独纯化的 HBV 病毒体足以剂量依赖性地诱导 HSC 中的 AURKA 表达和下游纤维化反应。这项研究确定了一个新的 AURKA/TLR3 轴,可以调节 HBV 诱导的 HSC 激活和肝纤维化,将 AURKA 定位为 CHB 相关纤维化的潜在治疗靶点。

title: Development and validation of a novel prognostic score for HBV-related acute-on-chronic liver failure
abstract: Background Acute-on-chronic liver failure patients have high short-term mortality rates, and HBV infection is the most common cause. Current prognostic models for HBV-ACLF patients have limitations. Thus, the development of an ideal model remains an important unsolved problem. Aims To develop a new model and validate its prognostic predictive capacity. Methods Among 5854 liver failure patients admitted to the Second Affiliated Hospital of Chongqing Medical University from 2008 to 2023, 1170 HBV-ACLF cases were finally enrolled, which were randomly divided into a development cohort ( n = 822) or validation cohort ( n = 348). First, we obtained important predictive factors about 28-day and 90-day mortality using cox regression analysis and developed new prognostic scores. Second, the new scores were compared with current models through ROC curves, calibration curves and DCA curves. Third, using survival analysis, the new scores were risk-stratified according to optimal cut-off values. Results The AHF-MELD and AHN-MELD scores’ predictive capacity were stronger than MELD, MELD-sodium, CLIF-C OF and AARC scores and comparable to CLIF-C ACLF, COSSH ACLF and COSSH ACLF II scores. There was no significant difference between the observed and the predicted 28-day and 90-day mortality probabilities of new scores. The AHF-MELD and AHN-MELD scores have positive net benefits over a wide range of threshold probabilities and outperform conventional scores. The 28-day and 90-day survival rates were significantly lower in high-risk groups than in low-risk groups. Conclusion The AHF-MELD and AHN-MELD scores may serve as potential predictive tools for the short-term prognosis of HBV-ACLF patients. Our study may provide useful information for clinicians managing these patients.

analysis.research_question_and_background: HBV-related acute-on-chronic liver failure (HBV-ACLF) carries high short-term mortality, and existing prognostic models have limitations, leaving an unmet need for an improved predictive tool.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective cohort study enrolled 1,170 HBV-ACLF patients admitted to a single Chinese center between 2008 and 2023, randomly split into a development cohort (n=822) and a validation cohort (n=348).
analysis.methods: Predictive factors for 28-day and 90-day mortality were identified using Cox regression, and two new prognostic scores (AHF-MELD and AHN-MELD) were developed and compared against established models using ROC, calibration, and decision curve analyses.
analysis.main_results: The AHF-MELD and AHN-MELD scores showed stronger predictive capacity than MELD, MELD-sodium, CLIF-C OF and AARC scores and were comparable to CLIF-C ACLF, COSSH ACLF and COSSH ACLF II scores, with good calibration and net benefit across thresholds.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that AHF-MELD and AHN-MELD scores may serve as potential predictive tools for short-term prognosis in HBV-ACLF, representing an advance over conventional models by demonstrating superior or comparable performance.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These scores could inform risk stratification and clinical decision-making for HBV-ACLF patients, potentially improving short-term prognostic accuracy in resource-limited settings where advanced models are unavailable.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The single-center, retrospective design and lack of external validation limit generalizability, and reliance on abstract-only evidence constrains detailed assessment of statistical robustness and potential biases.

analysis.summary_en: This study developed and validated two novel prognostic scores (AHF-MELD and AHN-MELD) for HBV-related acute-on-chronic liver failure (HBV-ACLF) using a retrospective cohort of 1,170 patients from a single Chinese center. Cox regression identified predictors of 28-day and 90-day mortality, and the new scores outperformed conventional models (MELD, MELD-sodium, CLIF-C OF, AARC) while matching more advanced scores (CLIF-C ACLF, COSSH ACLF, COSSH ACLF II) in predictive capacity. Calibration and decision curve analyses indicated good model fit and clinical net benefit across thresholds. The authors conclude these scores may serve as potential tools for short-term prognosis in HBV-ACLF, offering a practical alternative where complex models are impractical. However, the single-center design, retrospective nature, and absence of external validation limit generalizability, and reliance on abstract-only evidence constrains a full assessment of methodological rigor.

title_zh: 乙型肝炎相关慢加急性肝衰竭的新型预后评分的开发和验证
source_body_en: Background Acute-on-chronic liver failure patients have high short-term mortality rates, and HBV infection is the most common cause. Current prognostic models for HBV-ACLF patients have limitations. Thus, the development of an ideal model remains an important unsolved problem. Aims To develop a new model and validate its prognostic predictive capacity. Methods Among 5854 liver failure patients admitted to the Second Affiliated Hospital of Chongqing Medical University from 2008 to 2023, 1170 HBV-ACLF cases were finally enrolled, which were randomly divided into a development cohort ( n = 822) or validation cohort ( n = 348). First, we obtained important predictive factors about 28-day and 90-day mortality using cox regression analysis and developed new prognostic scores. Second, the new scores were compared with current models through ROC curves, calibration curves and DCA curves. Third, using survival analysis, the new scores were risk-stratified according to optimal cut-off values. Results The AHF-MELD and AHN-MELD scores’ predictive capacity were stronger than MELD, MELD-sodium, CLIF-C OF and AARC scores and comparable to CLIF-C ACLF, COSSH ACLF and COSSH ACLF II scores. There was no significant difference between the observed and the predicted 28-day and 90-day mortality probabilities of new scores. The AHF-MELD and AHN-MELD scores have positive net benefits over a wide range of threshold probabilities and outperform conventional scores. The 28-day and 90-day survival rates were significantly lower in high-risk groups than in low-risk groups. Conclusion The AHF-MELD and AHN-MELD scores may serve as potential predictive tools for the short-term prognosis of HBV-ACLF patients. Our study may provide useful information for clinicians managing these patients.

title: Potentially Functional Variants of DCTD and ENTPD2 in the Metabolism of Nucleotide Pathway Genes Predict Survival of HBV-Related Hepatocellular Carcinoma Patients
abstract: Purpose: Nucleotide metabolism plays a critical role in cancer development, but the prognostic significance of genetic variants in nucleotide metabolism genes for hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) patients remains unclear. Methods: We performed Cox proportional hazards regression analyses to evaluate the association between genetic variants in 94 nucleotide metabolism-related genes and overall survival (OS) in 866 HBV-HCC patients. To assess the potential biological relevance of the identified variants, the Bayesian false discovery probability and false-positive report probability were applied for multiple testing correction. Results: Two independent SNPs, DCTD rs17074255 G>A (HR = 1.22, 95% CI: 1.06–1.40, p = 0.005) and ENTPD2 rs3763662 G>A (HR = 1.18, 95% CI: 1.03–1.34, p = 0.015), were significantly associated with OS. A significant dose-dependent association between the number of risk genotypes and poorer OS was observed (Ptrend < 0.001). Luciferase reporter assays demonstrated allele-specific regulatory effects of rs3763662 on ENTPD2 expression (p < 0.001). DCTD and ENTPD2 mRNA expression levels were significantly elevated in HCC tumors in the UALCAN database and in our 103 paired samples. Higher expression levels of both genes were associated with poorer survival in the TCGA cohort (p = 0.003 and p < 0.001). Conclusions: Our findings suggest that ENTPD2 rs3763662 (supported by direct functional evidence) and DCTD rs17074255 (supported by eQTL and expression associations) may serve as potential prognostic indicators for HBV-HCC through the regulation of mRNA expression. These findings provide new insights into the role of nucleotide metabolism-related genetic variation in HBV-HCC progression and may facilitate prognostic assessment, pending replication in independent cohorts.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated whether genetic variants in nucleotide metabolism genes predict survival in 866 HBV-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) patients using Cox regression and multiple testing corrections. Two SNPs, DCTD rs17074255 and ENTPD2 rs3763662, were significantly associated with poorer overall survival, with a dose-dependent effect observed for the number of risk genotypes. Functional assays showed allele-specific regulatory effects of rs3763662 on ENTPD2 expression, and elevated expression of both genes correlated with worse survival in external datasets. The authors propose these variants as potential prognostic indicators, though replication in independent cohorts is needed to confirm utility.

title_zh: DCTD 和 ENTPD2 在核苷酸途径基因代谢中的潜在功能变异可预测 HBV 相关肝细胞癌患者的生存
source_body_en: Purpose: Nucleotide metabolism plays a critical role in cancer development, but the prognostic significance of genetic variants in nucleotide metabolism genes for hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) patients remains unclear. Methods: We performed Cox proportional hazards regression analyses to evaluate the association between genetic variants in 94 nucleotide metabolism-related genes and overall survival (OS) in 866 HBV-HCC patients. To assess the potential biological relevance of the identified variants, the Bayesian false discovery probability and false-positive report probability were applied for multiple testing correction. Results: Two independent SNPs, DCTD rs17074255 G>A (HR = 1.22, 95% CI: 1.06–1.40, p = 0.005) and ENTPD2 rs3763662 G>A (HR = 1.18, 95% CI: 1.03–1.34, p = 0.015), were significantly associated with OS. A significant dose-dependent association between the number of risk genotypes and poorer OS was observed (Ptrend < 0.001). Luciferase reporter assays demonstrated allele-specific regulatory effects of rs3763662 on ENTPD2 expression (p < 0.001). DCTD and ENTPD2 mRNA expression levels were significantly elevated in HCC tumors in the UALCAN database and in our 103 paired samples. Higher expression levels of both genes were associated with poorer survival in the TCGA cohort (p = 0.003 and p < 0.001). Conclusions: Our findings suggest that ENTPD2 rs3763662 (supported by direct functional evidence) and DCTD rs17074255 (supported by eQTL and expression associations) may serve as potential prognostic indicators for HBV-HCC through the regulation of mRNA expression. These findings provide new insights into the role of nucleotide metabolism-related genetic variation in HBV-HCC progression and may facilitate prognostic assessment, pending replication in independent cohorts.

title: Potential Risks and Benefits of Low-Barrier Access and Monitoring for HIV Preexposure Prophylaxis: A Modeling Study.
abstract: Abstract Background PrEP prevents HIV acquisition, but its population-level impact is limited by access barriers. Low-barrier delivery of daily oral tenofovir disoproxil fumarate/emtricitabine (TDF/FTC), such as over-the-counter (OTC) availability, could improve access by eliminating clinic visits, though reduced monitoring may increase risks including drug resistance, renal toxicity, and hepatitis B virus (HBV) reactivation. We estimated the benefits and risks of OTC PrEP. Methods Using a stochastic network-based model of HIV/STI transmission among gay, bisexual, and other men who have sex with men (GBMSM) in Atlanta, we simulated two delivery pathways: clinic-based PrEP and OTC PrEP with simplified initiation and reduced monitoring. We modeled 10–50% increases in PrEP coverage over 10 years. Outcomes included HIV infections averted, STI incidence, contraindicated PrEP use (GFR 90% without reducing prevention benefits, and frequent renal monitoring reduced renal risk. Conclusions OTC PrEP could produce population-level HIV prevention benefits if it expands coverage beyond clinic-based care. However, its net public health impact depends on implementation choices that preserve safety functions, particularly HIV testing at initiation and renal monitoring, without undermining access gains.

title_zh: 低障碍获取和监测艾滋病毒暴露前预防的潜在风险和益处:建模研究。
source_body_en: Abstract Background PrEP prevents HIV acquisition, but its population-level impact is limited by access barriers. Low-barrier delivery of daily oral tenofovir disoproxil fumarate/emtricitabine (TDF/FTC), such as over-the-counter (OTC) availability, could improve access by eliminating clinic visits, though reduced monitoring may increase risks including drug resistance, renal toxicity, and hepatitis B virus (HBV) reactivation. We estimated the benefits and risks of OTC PrEP. Methods Using a stochastic network-based model of HIV/STI transmission among gay, bisexual, and other men who have sex with men (GBMSM) in Atlanta, we simulated two delivery pathways: clinic-based PrEP and OTC PrEP with simplified initiation and reduced monitoring. We modeled 10–50% increases in PrEP coverage over 10 years. Outcomes included HIV infections averted, STI incidence, contraindicated PrEP use (GFR 90% without reducing prevention benefits, and frequent renal monitoring reduced renal risk. Conclusions OTC PrEP could produce population-level HIV prevention benefits if it expands coverage beyond clinic-based care. However, its net public health impact depends on implementation choices that preserve safety functions, particularly HIV testing at initiation and renal monitoring, without undermining access gains.
abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 PrEP 可预防 HIV 感染,但其对人群的影响因获取障碍而受到限制。每日口服富马酸替诺福韦二吡呋酯/恩曲他滨 (TDF/FTC) 的低门槛给药,例如非处方药 (OTC),可以通过消除门诊就诊来改善可及性,但减少监测可能会增加风险,包括耐药性、肾毒性和乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 重新激活。我们评估了 OTC PrEP 的益处和风险。方法 使用亚特兰大同性恋、双性恋和其他男男性行为者 (GBMSM) 中 HIV/STI 传播的随机网络模型,我们模拟了两种传递途径:基于临床的 PrEP 和 OTC PrEP,简化了启动并减少了监测。我们模拟了 10 年内 PrEP 覆盖率增加 10-50% 的情况。成果包括避免 HIV 感染、性传播感染发病率、禁忌使用 PrEP(GFR 90%,而不降低预防效益,以及频繁的肾脏监测降低肾脏风险)。结论:如果非处方药 PrEP 将覆盖范围扩大到临床护理之外,则可以产生人群层面的 HIV 预防效益。然而,其净公共卫生影响取决于保留安全功能的实施选择,特别是在不损害获得收益的情况下,在开始时进行 HIV 检测和肾脏监测。

title: Ancient whole genomes reveal regional selection during adaptation to Neolithic lifestyle in Western Eurasia
abstract: The introduction of agriculture in Western Eurasia during the Mesolithic-Neolithic transition reshaped human lifestyle, demography and pathogen exposure. Yet, the associated selective pressures remain incompletely resolved because previous ancient DNA studies relied on targeted SNP panels and yielded non-overlapping results. Here, using high-coverage whole-genome data from 152 ancient individuals, including 12 newly sequenced genomes from the Iron Gates, we show that adaptation during this transition was geographically structured and involved selection of both Early Farmer and Hunter-Gatherer alleles. By combining scans of population differentiation, extended haplotype homozygosity, and adaptive admixture, we identify candidate loci under selection in ancestral and admixed populations. Extending the analysis beyond SNPs, we also detect differential copy-number variants, ancestry-associated shifts in transposable-element abundance, and an early Neolithic hepatitis B infection. Functional analyses including effects on gene expression suggested selection on immune, metabolic, reproductive, sensory, and behavioural processes. Taken together, our results reveal a broader and more regionally variable adaptive landscape than previously appreciated.

title: Diffuse Large B Cell Lymphoma of Hard Palate-A Rare Case Entity with Literature Review
abstract: Introduction: The most common Non-Hodgkin’s Lymphoma in the oral cavity is Diffuse Large B Cell Lymphoma (DLBCL), followed by mantle cell lymphoma, extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of Mucosa-Associated Lymphoid Tissue (MALT lymphoma) and Burkitt lymphoma. The literature shows a very few case reports of primary MALT lymphoma. Primary involvement of the oral cavity by NHL is very rare. Extranodal DLBCL of the palate are extremely rare, with isolated case reports in the literature. Case Report: Here we are discussing about a case of an 84-year-old male known case of Hepatitis B infection (since 2014) and a chronic tobacco chewer for the last 9 years presented with a complaint of toothache (bilateral lower molar) of 06 months duration and a non-healing ulcer on the hard palate of 04 months duration. Patient underwent an incisional biopsy and was diagnosed with extra-nodal diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, GCB type. Conclusion: DLBCL have several subtypes with different clinical courses. Identification of these subtypes has prognostic and therapeutic significance. They are aggressive tumours that can be rapidly fatal if left untreated. So early diagnosis plays an important role. Complete remission can be achieved with early diagnosis and intensive chemotherapy.
journal: Journal of Oncology Research Review & Reports

abstract_zh: 简介:口腔最常见的非霍奇金淋巴瘤是弥漫性大B细胞淋巴瘤(DLBCL),其次是套细胞淋巴瘤、粘膜相关淋巴组织结外边缘区淋巴瘤(MALT淋巴瘤)和伯基特淋巴瘤。文献报道原发性MALT淋巴瘤的病例报道极少。NHL 原发性累及口腔的情况非常罕见。上颚结外 DLBCL 极其罕见,文献中有孤立的病例报告。病例报告:这里我们讨论的是一名 84 岁男性已知乙型肝炎感染病例(自 2014 年以来),过去 9 年长期咀嚼烟草,主诉牙痛(双侧下臼齿)持续 06 个月,硬腭溃疡不愈合,持续 04 个月。患者接受了切开活检,诊断为结外弥漫性大 B 细胞淋巴瘤,GCB 型。结论:DLBCL有多种亚型,临床过程各异。这些亚型的鉴定具有预后和治疗意义。它们是侵袭性肿瘤,如果不及时治疗可能会迅速致命。因此早期诊断起着重要作用。通过早期诊断和强化化疗可以实现完全缓解。

title: HBV, HCV and HIV Infections among Pregnant Women Attending Antenatal Care at the Health Facilities in Ekiti South, Nigeria
abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) are blood-borne infections with the potential for mother-to-child transmission and remain important concerns in antenatal care in sub-Saharan Africa. This cross-sectional study determined the seroprevalence of HBV, HCV, and HIV among pregnant women attending selected health facilities in Ekiti South Senatorial District, Nigeria. A total of 710 pregnant women were recruited from six Local Government Areas: Ekiti South West, Ikere, Ise, Emure, Ekiti East, and Gbonyin. Sociodemographic data and information on knowledge, awareness, and attitudes were collected using a structured questionnaire. Venous blood specimens were obtained aseptically and screened for hepatitis B surface antigen, anti-HCV antibodies, and HIV antibodies. Descriptive statistics and chi-square tests were used to assess prevalence and associations at p
journal: Asian Journal of Research in Infectious Diseases

title: Comparative efficacy and safety of postoperative adjuvant therapies after curative resection for hepatocellular carcinoma: a network meta-analysis
abstract: Abstract Purpose Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) has a high risk of recurrence even after curative-intent hepatic resection. Although several postoperative adjuvant therapies have been investigated, the optimal strategy remains uncertain because direct head-to-head comparisons are limited. This study aimed to compare and rank the efficacy and safety of adjuvant therapies for HCC using a network meta-analysis (NMA). Methods A systematic search of MEDLINE via PubMed, Embase, CENTRAL, Web of Science, Scopus, regional databases, clinical trial registries, and conference proceedings was conducted to identify randomized controlled trials evaluating postoperative adjuvant therapies after curative-intent hepatic resection for HCC. The primary outcome was recurrence-free survival (RFS); secondary outcomes included overall survival (OS) and safety. A frequentist NMA was performed to estimate pooled hazard ratios (HRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Treatments were ranked using P -scores. Results Twenty-eight randomized controlled trials involving 4,830 participants were included. Most patients had hepatitis B virus-related HCC and preserved liver function (Child–Pugh A). For OS, adjuvant 125 I-brachytherapy (HR = 0.36, 95%CI 0.17–0.78), IMRT (HR = 0.44, 95%CI 0.23–0.86), and 131 I-metuximab (HR = 0.46, 95%CI 0.28–0.77) were associated with the greatest reductions in mortality compared with observation. For RFS, autologous formalin-fixed tumor vaccine (AFTV) ranked highest ( P -score = 0.92), followed by adjuvant Cidan capsule plus TACE (0.90), 125 I-brachytherapy (0.84), and IMRT (0.80). Most therapies showed manageable toxicity. Immune checkpoint inhibitors demonstrated a favorable benefit-risk profile, while locoregional therapies were associated with expected procedure-related adverse events. Conclusion Internal radiation and brachytherapy approaches ( 125 I-brachytherapy, IMRT, and 131 I-metuximab) were associated with the greatest OS benefit, whereas AFTV and adjuvant Cidan capsule plus TACE showed the strongest RFS in the network. However, this finding is based on limited evidence (single small trial) and should be considered hypothesis-generating rather than definitive. These findings support risk-adapted integration of radiotherapy and immunotherapy after resection, although further large-scale head-to-head trials are needed.

The central question addresses the comparative ranking of adjuvant therapies in terms of recurrence-free survival (RFS), overall survival (OS), and adverse events.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: A systematic review with network meta-analysis (NMA) was conducted, including randomized controlled trials identified via searches of MEDLINE (PubMed), Embase, CENTRAL, Web of Science, Scopus, regional databases, clinical trial registries, and conference proceedings. The review included 28 randomized controlled trials involving 4,830 participants and employed a frequentist NMA to estimate pooled hazard ratios (HRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Treatments were ranked using P-scores.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Internal radiation and brachytherapy approaches (125 I-brachytherapy, IMRT, and 131 I-metuximab) were associated with the greatest reductions in mortality compared with observation. For RFS, autologous formalin-fixed tumor vaccine (AFTV) ranked highest, followed by adjuvant Cidan capsule plus TACE, 125 I-brachytherapy, and IMRT. Most therapies demonstrated manageable toxicity, with immune checkpoint inhibitors showing a favorable benefit-risk profile.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The evidence for the strongest OS benefit (125 I-brachytherapy, IMRT, and 131 I-metuximab) is based on limited data from single small trials, which the authors consider hypothesis-generating rather than definitive. The review does not report subgroup analyses by etiology (e.g., hepatitis B vs. C) or liver function status beyond Child–Pugh A classification.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The findings support risk-adapted integration of radiotherapy and immunotherapy after resection, but further large-scale head-to-head trials are needed to validate these results. Priority should be given to trials comparing AFTV, adjuvant Cidan capsule plus TACE, and internal radiation therapies directly against standard observation or placebo.

Most therapies had manageable toxicity, with immune checkpoint inhibitors demonstrating a favorable benefit-risk profile. However, the strongest OS benefits were derived from single small trials, limiting definitive conclusions. The review supports risk-adapted integration of radiotherapy and immunotherapy but emphasizes the need for large-scale head-to-head trials to validate these findings.

elements_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: A systematic review with network meta-analysis (NMA) was conducted, including randomized controlled trials identified via searches of MEDLINE (PubMed), Embase, CENTRAL, Web of Science, Scopus, regional databases, clinical trial registries, and conference proceedings. The review included 28 randomized controlled trials involving 4,830 participants and employed a frequentist NMA to estimate pooled hazard ratios (HRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Treatments were ranked using P-scores.
elements_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Internal radiation and brachytherapy approaches (125 I-brachytherapy, IMRT, and 131 I-metuximab) were associated with the greatest reductions in mortality compared with observation. For RFS, autologous formalin-fixed tumor vaccine (AFTV) ranked highest, followed by adjuvant Cidan capsule plus TACE, 125 I-brachytherapy, and IMRT. Most therapies demonstrated manageable toxicity, with immune checkpoint inhibitors showing a favorable benefit-risk profile.
elements_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The evidence for the strongest OS benefit (125 I-brachytherapy, IMRT, and 131 I-metuximab) is based on limited data from single small trials, which the authors consider hypothesis-generating rather than definitive. The review does not report subgroup analyses by etiology (e.g., hepatitis B vs. C) or liver function status beyond Child–Pugh A classification.
elements_en.research_and_practice_implications: The findings support risk-adapted integration of radiotherapy and immunotherapy after resection, but further large-scale head-to-head trials are needed to validate these results. Priority should be given to trials comparing AFTV, adjuvant Cidan capsule plus TACE, and internal radiation therapies directly against standard observation or placebo.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述评估了根治性肝切除术后肝细胞癌(HCC)的术后辅助治疗,重点关注疗效和安全性结果。核心问题涉及辅助治疗在无复发生存期 (RFS)、总生存期 (OS) 和不良事件方面的比较排名。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 进行了网络荟萃分析 (NMA) 的系统评价,包括通过搜索 MEDLINE (PubMed)、Embase、CENTRAL、Web of Science、Scopus、区域数据库、临床试验注册和会议记录确定的随机对照试验。该评价包括 28 项随机对照试验,涉及 4,830 名参与者,并采用频率论 NMA 来估计具有 95% 置信区间 (CI) 的汇总风险比 (HR)。使用 P 分数对治疗进行排名。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 与观察相比,内部放射和近距离放射治疗方法(125 I-近距离放射治疗、IMRT 和 131 I-美妥昔单抗)与死亡率的最大降低相关。对于RFS,自体福尔马林固定肿瘤疫苗(AFTV)排名最高,其次是辅助Cidan胶囊加TACE、125I近距离放射治疗和IMRT。大多数疗法表现出可控制的毒性,免疫检查点抑制剂显示出良好的获益-风险特征。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 最强 OS 获益(125 I 近距离放射治疗、IMRT 和 131 I-美妥昔单抗)的证据基于单个小型试验的有限数据,作者认为这些试验是假设生成而非确定性的。该综述未报告按病因学(例如乙型肝炎与丙型肝炎)或超出Child-Pugh A分类的肝功能状态进行的亚组分析。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果支持切除后放疗和免疫治疗的风险适应整合,但需要进一步的大规模头对头试验来验证这些结果。应优先考虑将 AFTV、辅助 Cidan 胶囊加 TACE 和内部放射治疗直接与标准观察或安慰剂进行比较的试验。

title_zh: 肝细胞癌根治性切除术后辅助治疗的疗效和安全性比较:网络荟萃分析
source_body_en: Abstract Purpose Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) has a high risk of recurrence even after curative-intent hepatic resection. Although several postoperative adjuvant therapies have been investigated, the optimal strategy remains uncertain because direct head-to-head comparisons are limited. This study aimed to compare and rank the efficacy and safety of adjuvant therapies for HCC using a network meta-analysis (NMA). Methods A systematic search of MEDLINE via PubMed, Embase, CENTRAL, Web of Science, Scopus, regional databases, clinical trial registries, and conference proceedings was conducted to identify randomized controlled trials evaluating postoperative adjuvant therapies after curative-intent hepatic resection for HCC. The primary outcome was recurrence-free survival (RFS); secondary outcomes included overall survival (OS) and safety. A frequentist NMA was performed to estimate pooled hazard ratios (HRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Treatments were ranked using P -scores. Results Twenty-eight randomized controlled trials involving 4,830 participants were included. Most patients had hepatitis B virus-related HCC and preserved liver function (Child–Pugh A). For OS, adjuvant 125 I-brachytherapy (HR = 0.36, 95%CI 0.17–0.78), IMRT (HR = 0.44, 95%CI 0.23–0.86), and 131 I-metuximab (HR = 0.46, 95%CI 0.28–0.77) were associated with the greatest reductions in mortality compared with observation. For RFS, autologous formalin-fixed tumor vaccine (AFTV) ranked highest ( P -score = 0.92), followed by adjuvant Cidan capsule plus TACE (0.90), 125 I-brachytherapy (0.84), and IMRT (0.80). Most therapies showed manageable toxicity. Immune checkpoint inhibitors demonstrated a favorable benefit-risk profile, while locoregional therapies were associated with expected procedure-related adverse events. Conclusion Internal radiation and brachytherapy approaches ( 125 I-brachytherapy, IMRT, and 131 I-metuximab) were associated with the greatest OS benefit, whereas AFTV and adjuvant Cidan capsule plus TACE showed the strongest RFS in the network. However, this finding is based on limited evidence (single small trial) and should be considered hypothesis-generating rather than definitive. These findings support risk-adapted integration of radiotherapy and immunotherapy after resection, although further large-scale head-to-head trials are needed.

title: Contemporary global epidemiology of cirrhosis
abstract: Cirrhosis remains a major global cause of morbidity and mortality, with rapidly evolving etiologic drivers. This review summarizes the contemporary global epidemiology of cirrhosis, highlighting regional patterns and major transitions in underlying causes to inform prevention and policy. In 2021, cirrhosis and chronic liver disease accounted for ~1.4 million deaths worldwide. Although age-standardized mortality rates have declined in many regions, the absolute burden continues to rise due to population growth and aging. Reductions in hepatitis B and C–related cirrhosis, driven by vaccination, screening, and antiviral therapy, have been offset by a growing contribution from steatotic liver disease. High–sociodemographic index (SDI) regions exhibit lower mortality but increasing prevalence, reflecting improved survival and expanding metabolic risk, whereas low- and lower-middle–SDI regions continue to experience high mortality. Addressing the global burden of cirrhosis will require sustained public health investment focused on viral hepatitis elimination, alcohol-associated harm reduction, metabolic risk management, and equitable access to early detection and care.

title: HBx Downregulates TFEB via the CUL4A/CUL4B–DDB1 Axis to Disrupt Lysosomal Function in Hepatocellular Carcinoma Cells
abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major global health burden, with chronic infection leading to severe liver diseases including cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). HBV-encoded X protein (HBx) plays a critical role in viral replication and pathogenesis by modulating host cellular processes, including autophagy and lysosomal function. However, the molecular mechanisms by which HBx disrupts lysosomal biogenesis and autophagic degradation remain elusive. In this study, we show that HBx downregulates the transcription factor EB (TFEB), a master regulator of lysosomal biogenesis, which leading to impaired lysosomal acidification and autophagosome–lysosome fusion. Mechanistically, HBx-mediated TFEB downregulation involves the CUL4A (Cullin 4A)/CUL4B (Cullin 4B)-DDB1 (DNA damage-binding protein 1) E3 ubiquitin ligase complex and is dependent on the DDB1-interacting motif in HBx. HBx mutants defective in DDB1 binding (HBxR96E and HBxΔDBD) fail to downregulate TFEB or impair lysosomal function. Collectively, our findings identify a pathway by which HBx disrupts lysosomal function via CUL4A/CUL4B–DDB1-dependent TFEB downregulation, providing insights into HBV-associated liver pathogenesis and highlighting potential targets for therapeutic intervention.

HBV-encoded X protein (HBx) plays a critical role in viral replication and pathogenesis by modulating host cellular processes, including autophagy and lysosomal function. However, the molecular mechanisms by which HBx disrupts lysosomal biogenesis and autophagic degradation remain elusive. In this study, we show that HBx downregulates the transcription factor EB (TFEB), a master regulator of lysosomal biogenesis, which leading to impaired lysosomal acidification and autophagosome–lysosome fusion. Mechanistically, HBx-mediated TFEB downregulation involves the CUL4A (Cullin 4A)/CUL4B (Cullin 4B)-DDB1 (DNA damage-binding protein 1) E3 ubiquitin ligase complex and is dependent on the DDB1-interacting motif in HBx. HBx mutants defective in DDB1 binding (HBxR96E and HBxΔDBD) fail to downregulate TFEB or impair lysosomal function. Collectively, our findings identify a pathway by which HBx disrupts lysosomal function via CUL4A/CUL4B–DDB1-dependent TFEB downregulation, providing insights into HBV-associated liver pathogenesis and highlighting potential targets for therapeutic intervention.

abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染仍然是全球主要的健康负担,慢性感染会导致严重的肝脏疾病,包括肝硬化和肝细胞癌(HCC)。HBV 编码的 X 蛋白 (HBx) 通过调节宿主细胞过程(包括自噬和溶酶体功能)在病毒复制和发病机制中发挥关键作用。然而,HBx 破坏溶酶体生物发生和自噬降解的分子机制仍然难以捉摸。在这项研究中,我们发现 HBx 下调转录因子 EB (TFEB),这是溶酶体生物发生的主要调节因子,从而导致溶酶体酸化和自噬体-溶酶体融合受损。从机制上讲,HBx 介导的 TFEB 下调涉及 CUL4A (Cullin 4A)/CUL4B (Cullin 4B)-DDB1(DNA 损伤结合蛋白 1)E3 泛素连接酶复合物,并且依赖于 HBx 中的 DDB1 相互作用基序。DDB1 结合缺陷的 HBx 突变体(HBxR96E 和 HBxΔDBD)无法下调 TFEB 或损害溶酶体功能。总的来说,我们的研究结果确定了 HBx 通过 CUL4A/CUL4B–DDB1 依赖性 TFEB 下调来破坏溶酶体功能的途径,为了解 HBV 相关肝脏发病机制提供了见解,并强调了治疗干预的潜在目标。

title: Balancing Long-Term Efficacy and Immunological Safety: Serious Infection Risk during Extended Ocrelizumab Therapy in Multiple Sclerosis
abstract: Highly efficient treatments for Multiple sclerosis (MS) have changed the treatment strategy in a way that relapse rates are minimized and clinical disease activity is prevented. The use of the Ocrelizumab over a longer period, however, raises the issue of immunological safety and infection risks. This review looked at all the information about infections that people got when they used Ocrelizumab for a long time. Additionally, we reviewed the effectiveness of ocrelizumab therapy within the term and the types of infections suffered by individuals. In addition, we considered a disease known as hypogammaglobulinemia and the ways it is presently screened. In this paper we used PubMed and Google Scholar as our databases to identify relevant data between (2016-2026). Twenty articles concerning the topic of adult sclerosis have been identified. These adults have been diagnosed with sclerosis based on the McDonald criteria. Ocrelizumab is a drug that is an anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody. It works well for people with relapsing and progressive MS. It reduces the number of relapses and stops the disease from getting worse plus, it decreases the number of lesions on the MRI. However, within long-term taking of this medication, depletion of B cells happened, and it could lead to the gradual suppression of humoral immunity due to IgM and then IgG depletion. Decreased IgG is associated with the high risk of infections; however, the suggested guidelines for monitoring (IgG < 4 g/L and change in therapy if IgG drops to 3-3.5 g/L) lack evidence. Common infections include respiratory and soft tissue infections, UTIs, and herpes zoster. Rare opportunistic infections include hepatitis B infection reactivation and progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy, which is more often caused by prior disease-modifying treatments. Monitoring should consist of baseline evaluation of tuberculosis, hepatitis B, and HIV infection; regular complete blood counts and immunoglobulin levels; immunization prior to therapy; and the possibility of extending dosing intervals, immunoglobulin replacement, or switching therapy for recurrent infections or severe reduction in IgG levels. In general, prolonged ocrelizumab is an effective treatment of MS, although the risk of infection is significant, cumulative, and requires personalized immune monitoring.

title_zh: 平衡长期疗效和免疫安全性:多发性硬化症延长 Ocrelizumab 治疗期间的严重感染风险
source_body_en: Highly efficient treatments for Multiple sclerosis (MS) have changed the treatment strategy in a way that relapse rates are minimized and clinical disease activity is prevented. The use of the Ocrelizumab over a longer period, however, raises the issue of immunological safety and infection risks. This review looked at all the information about infections that people got when they used Ocrelizumab for a long time. Additionally, we reviewed the effectiveness of ocrelizumab therapy within the term and the types of infections suffered by individuals. In addition, we considered a disease known as hypogammaglobulinemia and the ways it is presently screened. In this paper we used PubMed and Google Scholar as our databases to identify relevant data between (2016-2026). Twenty articles concerning the topic of adult sclerosis have been identified. These adults have been diagnosed with sclerosis based on the McDonald criteria. Ocrelizumab is a drug that is an anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody. It works well for people with relapsing and progressive MS. It reduces the number of relapses and stops the disease from getting worse plus, it decreases the number of lesions on the MRI. However, within long-term taking of this medication, depletion of B cells happened, and it could lead to the gradual suppression of humoral immunity due to IgM and then IgG depletion. Decreased IgG is associated with the high risk of infections; however, the suggested guidelines for monitoring (IgG < 4 g/L and change in therapy if IgG drops to 3-3.5 g/L) lack evidence. Common infections include respiratory and soft tissue infections, UTIs, and herpes zoster. Rare opportunistic infections include hepatitis B infection reactivation and progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy, which is more often caused by prior disease-modifying treatments. Monitoring should consist of baseline evaluation of tuberculosis, hepatitis B, and HIV infection; regular complete blood counts and immunoglobulin levels; immunization prior to therapy; and the possibility of extending dosing intervals, immunoglobulin replacement, or switching therapy for recurrent infections or severe reduction in IgG levels. In general, prolonged ocrelizumab is an effective treatment of MS, although the risk of infection is significant, cumulative, and requires personalized immune monitoring.
